raw.description:
We’re Auros—the leader in human insight. Our mission is to help organizations craft exceptional customer experiences through fast, actionable feedback.


We empower teams to build the best products and experiences by embedding real human perspectives into every stage of the development process—from ideation to launch. With the world’s strongest participant network, AI-powered analysis, expert services, and seamless integrations, we help companies eliminate guesswork, align stakeholders, and bring customer needs into sharp focus.


Trusted by more than 3,000 organizations worldwide—including 75 of the Fortune 100— Auros delivers measurable business outcomes, reduces risk, and helps teams deliver with confidence. Joining our team means being part of a passionate group focused on transforming how companies understand and connect with their customers.


Let’s build experiences people love—together.

The Opportunity


We’re looking for a Director, Revenue Accounting to lead, scale and escalate our global revenue, commission accounting and accounts receivable functions. This role sits at the intersection of Accounting, Finance, Legal, and GTM, ensuring that customer contracts are structured, billed, and collected in a way that is both operationally efficient and compliant with ASC 606.


You will own the end-to-end revenue lifecycle from pre-deal structuring, best business practice, policy enforcement through revenue recognition, commissions, invoicing, collections, and cash application. This role is critical in enabling the business to move quickly while maintaining strong financial controls, predictable cash flow, and accurate reporting.


Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop high-performing accounting and quote analyst teams
  • Own ASC 606 and ASC 340 application across SaaS, professional services, and usage-based models
  • Partner with Sales, Deal Desk, RevOps, Legal, and Professional Services to provide guidance on complex contract structure, evaluating revenue, billing/tax, commissions and GTM implications
  • Own and continuously evolve revenue, billing, and AR policies, reporting, and controls
  • Lead commissions accounting, including accruals, payouts, and alignment with bookings and revenue
  • Drive collection strategy, reducing DSO, own billing, cash application, and PO/portal compliance
  • Own audit readiness and execution, including multiple international external audits
  • on complex deals
  • Provide the executive team with actionable financial revenue and AR insights
  • Support strategic initiatives, including M&A, revenue predictability, and board reporting.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in Revenue Accounting, Commissions, Quoting, and Accounts Receivable within a SaaS environment
  • Deep expertise in ASC 606, ASC 340 and subscription-based revenue models
  • Experience owning billing and collections, including DSO and cash flow management
  • Strong understanding of quote-to-cash systems (Salesforce/CPQ, NetSuite)
  • Proven ability to partner cross-functionally with Finance, GTM and Executive leadership
  • Experience building and scaling processes in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

Preferred

  • CPA or equivalent
  • Experience leading combined Revenue, Commissions, Quote Review, and AR functions
  • Background in complex deal structures (pricing, multi-entity, global operations)
  • Experience using AI/automation to drive system and process automation across quote-to-cash

Don’t meet every single requirement but excited about the role? We encourage you to apply. Research shows that some candidates are less likely to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications—but you may be exactly who we’re looking for. Diverse perspectives drive innovation, and we’re committed to building a team with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.


Application Process

  • Meet with a Recruiter
  • Meet the Hiring Manager
  • Participate in a Panel Interview
  • Final Interview (if applicable)
  • Offer Stage

Accommodations

At Auros, we’re committed to creating inclusive and accessible experiences for all candidates. We believe diverse perspectives are essential to building exceptional products and experiences. If you require accommodations or would like us to tailor the interview process to better meet your needs, please contact us at .


Auros is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. Women, minorities, individuals with disabilities and protected veterans are encouraged to apply. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Auros will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, as applicable.

Job Title: Director, Global Content Production

Job Location: Washington D.C., District of Columbia, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Director, Global Content Production

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role the Director, Global Content Production is responsible for operationalizing Amgen's content supply chain and leading the global production capability that delivers content at scale across brands, markets, and channels.

This leader oversees a global team and network of production partners responsible for delivering thousands of content production projects annually across web, CRM, Veeva, digital, print, localization, and omnichannel channels. The role is accountable for production quality, speed, compliance, cost efficiency, partner performance, and the successful adoption of automation and AI-enabled production capabilities.

Success in this role will be measured through improvements in production efficiency, cycle time reduction, content reuse, automation adoption, cost optimization, and the ability to scale content production globally.

Global Content Production Leadership

  • Lead a global team of production operations leaders across North America, Europe, and Asia responsible for production delivery and operational excellence.
  • Establish the operating model, governance framework, and service levels for the Global Content Production organization.
  • Build strategic partnerships across Content Excellence, Brand, Technology, Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and Commercial teams to align production capabilities with business needs.
  • Develop organizational capabilities and talent, fostering a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Content Supply Chain Operations

  • Lead the delivery of thousands of content production projects annually across web, CRM, Veeva, print, localization, modular content, and omnichannel production services.
  • Ensure efficient, compliant, and high-quality content delivery through standardized workflows, resource planning, and production controls.
  • Drive operational consistency across regions, brands, and partners to improve speed, scalability, and stakeholder experience.
  • Define and monitor KPIs related to production speed, quality, compliance, cost, content reuse, capacity utilization, and stakeholder satisfaction.

Partner, Vendor & Financial Management

  • Oversee a global ecosystem of production agencies, creative partners, localization providers, and content operations vendors supporting content delivery at scale.
  • Manage production budgets, forecasting, and resource allocation to ensure cost-effective and efficient operations.
  • Establish vendor performance frameworks and governance processes to ensure partners meet quality, service, and business expectations.
  • Optimize external spend and partner performance while improving scalability and service delivery.

Automation, AI & Capability Evolution

  • Partner with Content Transformation and Technology teams to operationalize new production capabilities, workflows, and platforms.
  • Drive adoption of automation, modular content, and AI-enabled production solutions that improve productivity, quality, speed, and scalability.
  • Serve as a key business advocate for production technologies, helping maximize value realization from content supply chain and AI-enabled production platforms.
  • Identify and scale GenAI and automation use cases that increase content throughput, improve content reuse, and support business growth without proportional increases in cost or resources.

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The content production professional we seek is a collaborative leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 4 years of experience in global content production operations, content supply chain management, and digital/omnichannel content delivery

OR

Master’s degree and 7 years of experience in global content production operations, content supply chain management, and digital/omnichannel content delivery

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of experience in global content production operations, content supply chain management, and digital/omnichannel content delivery

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills with a record of successful cross functional collaboration
  • Proven ability to translate strategy into action through detailed implementation plans
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to track executional performance and recommend improvements
  • Exceptional communication skills—both written and verbal—to influence across levels
  • Experience working with agencies, operations teams, and brand teams in matrixed environments
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity and leading change in evolving marketing environments
  • Familiarity with life sciences or regulated industries

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

careers.amgen.com

In any materials you submit, you may redact or remove age-identifying information such as age, date of birth, or dates of school attendance or graduation. You will not be penalized for redacting or removing this information.

Application deadline

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Sponsorship

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

The RCM Senior Data Analyst supports the Revenue Cycle Management Analytics team by providing reporting, analysis, and data insights that help improve operational and financial performance. This role partners with Revenue Cycle Operations, clients, and the analytics team to understand business needs, develop reports, validate data accuracy, and communicate findings. The Senior Data Analyst performs complex analyses, supports reporting initiatives, and contributes to data-driven decision making across Revenue Cycle Operations.

This position requires a solid understanding of Revenue Cycle processes, healthcare reporting, and analytical techniques. The Senior Data Analyst works independently on assigned projects while collaborating with team members and business partners to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable reporting. This position does not have direct supervisory responsibility.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform and support analytical projects that help Revenue Cycle Operations monitor performance and achieve business objectives.
  • Develop and maintain a working knowledge of Revenue Cycle processes and reporting solutions.
  • Analyze operational and financial data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Work with operational stakeholders to understand reporting needs and assist in developing reporting requirements.
  • Present analytical findings and reporting results to department leaders and business partners.
  • Collaborate with Business Intelligence Developers to support report development, testing, and ongoing enhancements.
  • Build collaborative working relationships with operational teams and business partners.
  • Support consistent reporting definitions and validate KPI calculations across assigned reports.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Highly detail oriented and organized with critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • Knowledge of healthcare systems such as Meditech, Oracle, Medhost, FinThrive, SSI, Experian or similar platforms a plus.
  • Understanding of Revenue Cycle metrics, operational reporting, and KPI measurement.

Benefits:

The Account Insight Manager (AIM) partners with a Consultative Account Manager (CAM) to support an assigned book of business within the National Accounts segment. In addition to providing support, this position delivers technical, data-driven insights that shape client solutions and renewal strategies. This role owns the delivery of end-to-end analytics and reporting support across an assigned book of business, including requirements intake, data extraction and validation, metric definition, and analysis (e.g., trend/variance analysis, utilization and performance drivers) to inform renewal strategies, client solutions/insights, and retention/upsell opportunities. The AIM utilizes dashboards and develops recurring deliverables, ensuring data quality, documentation, and consistent methodologies across sources and reporting periods. The role coordinates internal cross-functional workstreams, managing timelines, stakeholders, dependencies, and approvals to deliver client-ready materials on time. The position translates complex findings into clear narratives and executive-ready presentations while proactively managing risks, assumptions, and follow-ups. This position is responsible for consistent monitoring of performance metrics and Performance Guarantee dashboards to inform the CAM, management, clients, and internal stakeholders of emerging trends. The successful candidate will also perform administrative duties in support of the CAM and the book of business. This position has client-facing responsibilities with limited travel requirements.

Job Title: Software Engineer, New Grad

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

This is a fullstack software engineering role designed for recent graduates and early-career engineers looking to accelerate their growth by building production systems. You'll contribute to — and grow into owning — core internal platform capabilities and product features end-to-end.

You'll work across internal tools, services, workflows, and AI-powered products that support our engineering, operations, and recruiting platforms. As you grow, you'll take increasing ownership of critical systems while collaborating closely with experienced engineers.

What You'll Own

  1. Contribute to the design and development of end-to-end fullstack systems powering critical internal workflows and platform capabilities.
  2. Build clean, maintainable backend services and APIs while learning scalable engineering best practices.
  3. Develop high-quality frontend interfaces used by internal teams and end users.
  4. Participate in data modeling and database optimization efforts, including schema design and query performance.
  5. Collaborate with product, operations, and design teams to translate ideas into reliable, production-ready features.
  6. Improve engineering quality through code reviews, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement.
  7. Help troubleshoot production issues while learning how to build resilient, observable systems.
  8. Develop sound engineering judgment by making thoughtful tradeoffs between speed, scalability, and maintainability.

What We're Looking For

  1. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field (recent graduate or graduating soon).
  2. Internship, co-op, research, or meaningful personal/project experience building software applications.
  3. Strong fundamentals in JavaScript and/or TypeScript.
  4. Familiarity with frontend development using React or similar frameworks.
  5. Familiarity with backend development using Node.js (NestJS is a plus).
  6. Understanding of relational databases such as PostgreSQL and core data modeling principles.
  7. Familiarity with RESTful APIs and how distributed applications communicate.
  8. Exposure to Git and modern software development workflows.
  9. Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, attention to detail, and a growth mindset.
  10. Excited to learn quickly and contribute in a fast-moving engineering environment.

Preferred

  1. Internship or professional software engineering experience.
  2. Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  3. Familiarity with CI/CD, deployment pipelines, or DevOps fundamentals.
  4. Exposure to modern architectures such as microservices, serverless, or event-driven systems.
  5. Interest in AI-powered products, workflow automation, or data-intensive applications.
  6. Experience contributing to team projects, hackathons, open-source software, or startup environments.

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $110,000 –$150,000 USD. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to .

raw.description:
Company Introduction

Based in Irvine, CA, PSD Underwear is a designer, marketer, and distributor of high quality, affordable, and premium briefs, boxers, sports bras, and loungewear. The company serves a diverse customer base (men’s, women’s, and youth) through company-owned web, wholesale, and international distributors. PSD is renowned for its specialty designs and for collaborating with the biggest brands from Warner Bros., Nickelodeon, DC, Hooters, and Naruto. Additionally, the company has an unmatched and growing roster of celebrities, social media influencers, and top-tier athletes including, Bronny James, Jimmy Butler, Ja Morant, Marshawn Lynch, and Tyler Herro.

General Summary

PSD isn't built to be a brand that only shows up when we have something to sell.

We're looking for a Director, Social & Experiential to lead the part of PSD that keeps us connected to the consumer, culture and community every single day.

This role leads two critical workstreams: Social Media & Influencers and Events & Ambassadors and is fluent in culture knowledge and community building.

If Marketing Strategy owns much of the planned world, culture & community owns the part that doesn't fit neatly into a calendar. This is where PSD reacts to culture, finds the next thing, gets into the community, creates conversations and turns the brand into something people want to be part of.

You will build the strategy, lead the team and set the standard, but you also need to be a player. You should be comfortable capturing content, jumping into social, building relationships with creators, attending events, pitching ideas and figuring things out in real time.

This is the heartbeat of PSD..

What You’ll Own

Social & Cultural Strategy

  • Own PSD's organic social strategy and cultural point of view across platforms.
  • Build an always-on approach that keeps PSD culturally relevant and connected to our consumer.
  • Identify trends, creators, memes, communities, conversations and opportunities that can move the brand forward.
  • Establish platform-specific best practices and continually evolve how PSD shows up.
  • Partner with Marketing Strategy to ensure social and community insights inform larger campaign strategies.

Influencers & Creators

  • Build and lead PSD's influencer and creator strategy.
  • Identify creators who are culturally relevant and brand-right.
  • Develop creative partnerships that prioritize interesting ideas and organic reach over traditional paid endorsement.
  • Build long-term relationships with creators, tastemakers and communities.
  • Create a point of view on who PSD should be in culture and why.

Ambassadors

  • Build and evolve PSD's Ambassador program.
  • Develop a network of brand-right people who authentically represent PSD.
  • Create programs that drive both community and measurable commercial value.
  • Establish the distinction between creators we collaborate with and ambassadors who participate through affiliate relationships.
  • Develop systems that make the program scalable without losing authenticity.

Events & Community

  • Own the strategy for PSD's events and community presence.
  • Develop a portfolio of events and grassroots activations that make PSD matter beyond traditional marketing moments.
  • Willing to roll up the sleeves, set up a tent, pack boxes, run the POS and troubleshoot on the fly.
  • Ensure events are culturally relevant, experiential and rooted in the communities we're trying to serve.
  • Build relationships with local communities, schools, athletes, creators, venues and cultural partners.
  • Create a point of view on where PSD should show up and where we shouldn't.

Lead at the pace of culture

  • Be the person who sees something happening on Tuesday and asks, What can PSD do about this by Friday?
  • Move quickly without sacrificing brand quality.
  • Make decisions with imperfect information.
  • Create content and participate in the culture rather than simply observe it.
  • Know when something needs a plan and when it simply needs someone to go do it.

Lead and develop the team

  • Build and eventually lead a team of 4-5 across Social, Influencers, Events and Ambassadors.
  • Coach the team to be both strategically sharp and highly hands-on.
  • Establish a culture of experimentation, speed, accountability and creativity.
  • Raise the standard for how PSD participates in culture.

Who you Are

  • You are obsessed with the consumer and youth culture.
  • You know what people are talking about before it becomes a trend report.
  • You understand platforms because you actually create for them.
  • You know creators because you know their work, not because you have a spreadsheet of their follower counts.
  • Obsessed with Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Discord (and willing to find new platforms to leverage)
  • You're creative, but you're also a leader.
  • You're comfortable directing a strategy meeting at noon., shooting content at 2 pm and standing in the middle of an event at 10 pm
  • You don't need everything figured out before you start.
  • You thrive in the chaos.

What you Bring

  • 8+ years of experience across social, culture, community, influencer marketing, events and/or brand marketing
  • Deep expertise in social platforms, content and emerging cultural trends.
  • Experience developing and executing social strategy for a consumer-facing brand.
  • Strong creator/influencer relationships and experience developing partnerships.
  • Experience building ambassador, affiliate and/or grassroots community programs.
  • Experience developing events and experiential activations.
  • Strong creative instincts and an ability to identify what is culturally relevant.
  • Experience managing and developing teams.
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Willingness to travel frequently and work nontraditional hours when the moment requires it.
  • A genuine passion for being in the culture, not just marketing to it.
  • You must be brand-right. This is not negotiable.

This position is open for Remote or Hybrid, based on candidate location. Preferred candidate locations: Los Angeles, Portland, NYC or Nashville.

Benefits

PSD offers a comprehensive benefits package for regular, full-time employees designed to support overall well-being and work-life balance. Eligible team members can participate in:

• Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Plan

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• Paid Time Off and Company Holidays

• Enjoy additional perks and opportunities for growth within a collaborative, lifestyle-focused culture.

Physical Requirements

Seeing: Must be able to see well enough to read reports.

Hearing: Must be able to hear well enough to communicate with customers, vendors and employees.

Climbing/Stooping/Kneeling: Must be able to stoop or kneel to pick up products.

Lifting/Pulling/Pushing: Must be able to lift up to 10 pounds.

Fingering/Grasping/Feeling: Must be able to type and use technical sources.

PSD provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals in compliance with federal, state, and local laws. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Equal opportunity applies to all aspects of employment, including hiring, training, promotion, compensation, and termination. PSD is committed to maintaining a workplace free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation, and to fostering an inclusive, respectful environment where all employees can thrive.

The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and are not an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel in this position. This job description does not constitute a contract for employment, and the Company reserves the right to modify, interpret, or apply it in any way the Company desires at any time. Employment with PSD is at-will.

The Department of Economic Security (DES), and the Division of Technology Services (DTS), is seeking an experienced and highly motivated professional to join our team as a Systems Administrator Senior. The Systems Administrator Senior (Junior Security Architect) will support IT Security management in the technical assessment of new and existing services and solutions within the agency. This includes documentation of solutions, as well as providing recommendations and guidance concerning proper Security Architecture implementation. This role regularly reviews existing agency IT policies and procedures, identifies deficiencies, and recommends changes based upon current regulations and best practices. Active participation in the development, maintenance, and improvement of agency Security standards is required.

This position may offer the ability to work remotely, within Arizona only, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures.

raw.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As a product-focused Senior Frontend Developer on our AI track, you'll own frontend delivery end-to-end for products that directly affect how patients access mental health care and how our clinicians and staff work day-to-day. Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. You'll work in a small cross-functional product team, taking features from requirement refinement through production release.

﻿Why this role:

  • Real product ownership in autonomous cross-functional team, you shape what gets built, not just how.
  • Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond).
  • Modern Angular at scale: an actively evolving monorepo on the latest Angular versions, not a legacy graveyard.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release.
  • Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine.
  • Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and platform health: performance, framework upgrades, NX monorepo structure, CI/CD improvements.
  • Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself.
  • Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community.

﻿This role is not for you if:

  • You're waiting for someone else to define what to build,we expect you to come up with ideas, take them through discovery and development, ship them, and own the results after launch.
  • You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you
  • You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred).
  • Experience owning a product end-to-end, including analysing the metrics that tell you whether it actually worked.
  • Strong product and UX judgment, you can recognize when an interaction doesn't feel right and propose a better solution.
  • Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework.
  • Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing complex Angular application architectures at scale, module and component boundaries, decisions that hold up as the codebase grows.
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing (Vitest preferred, Jest acceptable) as a regular part of the daily routine, not an afterthought.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development. For us this is a must, not a bonus: active daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), the ability to write effective skills, prompts, and instructions for them, understanding of the principles behind how agents operate (context, tools, feedback loops), and structuring code and documentation so agents can work with the codebase effectively.
  • Comfort working across the backend boundary: writing or fixing a SQL query, adjusting endpoint validation, or tracing an issue through the API layer. You don't need to be a backend engineer, but stopping at the frontend border isn't an option.
  • Intermediate English (B1+) and fluent Russian.
  • Full overlap with CET working hours.

Would be a plus:

  • Experience building UI for AI/LLM-powered features.
  • Deep understanding of responsive design, our patients access the platform primarily from mobile devices, and interfaces must be flawless across screen sizes.
  • Proficiency in optimizing web application performance across different surfaces: patient-facing product and internal tools for doctors, managers, and admins (data-heavy interfaces, large tables and lists, real-time updates).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

﻿Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

﻿MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Patient Consult Staff Pharmacist


This is a remote position. Candidates must reside and be licensed in one of the following states: Arizona, Indiana, Florida, or Ohio and preferably reside within an hour of our local sites.


The start date for this position is 11/2/2026. Training period: 8 to 10 weeks.


During the training period, the hours will be Monday through Friday 9am - 5:30pm ET. Once training is completed, schedules will be assigned as noted below:


Consult: Monday through Friday

  • AZ- 9:30 am - 6 pm (Winter AZ time) and 8:30 am – 5 pm (Summer AZ time)
  • FL- 11:30 am – 8 pm ET
  • OH- 11:30 am – 8 pm ET
  • IN- 11:30 am – 8 pm ET
  • There will also be 1-evening shift per week from 2:30 pm -11 pm ET and a Saturday rotation 10 am - 6:30 pm every 4-weeks. When working a Saturday shift there would be a weekday off.

**Candidates must be able to commit to the training and future schedules noted.


POSITION SUMMARY

The Staff Pharmacist interprets physicians’ prescriptions, contacts doctors or other prescribers and/or patients to verify information on prescriptions and expedite processing of order.

The Staff Pharmacist may track order status and outstanding issues as well as consult with patients regarding the use of medications and potential drug interactions.

This individual may take calls from customers regarding lost orders or dispensing errors, maintain daily production, quality and service levels, vary work priorities and activities to accommodate business needs.

The Staff Pharmacist may also train less experienced pharmacists.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS Consult with patients regarding the use of medications and potential drug interactions. Contact physicians for new and/or transfer authorization. Collaborate with physicians to convert prescriptions to generic or preferred drugs whenever possible. Interpret physicians’ or prescribers’ prescriptions. Contact doctors and/or patients to verify information on prescriptions such as drug strength, prescription sig., and drug name in order to expedite processing of orders. Provide oversight and quality assurance to pharmacy technicians. Verify and confirm validity of controlled substances. Verify prescription information entered in the system by data entry or order entry. Back up other pharmacists as needed, perform additional duties as assigned by management, or train less experienced pharmacists.


QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy required, PharmD preferred

Current active resident pharmacist license in good standing.

Advanced problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other departments to resolve issues.

Good oral and written communication skills.

Ability to read and interpret prescriptions.

Strong focus on customer service, quality and accuracy.

Ability to manage timelines and meet tight client deadlines.

Ability to adapt in a changing environment.

Ability to work a flexible schedule for peak volume times.

raw.excerpt: The Challenge:JCTM is increasing the size, complexity, and strategic importance of the federal services opportunities it pursues across prime, subcontract, joint venture, IDIQ, GWAC, and task-order environments.
raw.description:
The Challenge:

JCTM is increasing the size, complexity, and strategic importance of the federal services opportunities it pursues across prime, subcontract, joint venture, IDIQ, GWAC, and task-order environments. As our federal portfolio grows, JCTM is strengthening its pricing capability to bring competitive pricing analysis earlier into capture, improve proposal economics, protect execution feasibility, and give leadership better information for pursuit and investment decisions.

The successful candidate will be able to analyze available customer, competitor, labor-market, contract, and cost information and clearly explain: “Here is the likely competitive range, here is where our current price sits, here are the major drivers, here are the available levers, and here is the pricing approach I recommend.”

JCTM is looking for an experienced, hands-on federal pricing professional who understands that successful pricing goes beyond completing a cost model. This person will help JCTM understand what a competitive price may look like, how the proposed solution and staffing model affect that price, and what adjustments may improve both competitiveness and execution.

Build Your Career:

This role is an opportunity for an experienced Senior Pricing Analyst, Pricing Manager, Senior Pricing Manager, or similarly qualified federal pricing professional to take on greater ownership, work directly with senior leadership, and help mature JCTM’s strategic pricing capability. You will remain close to the work, building and reviewing pricing models, analyzing competitive ranges, evaluating staffing and labor assumptions, supporting BOEs, and pricing major federal pursuits, while gaining increased responsibility for pricing strategy and executive-level recommendations.

Challenging Projects:

As the Senior Federal Pricing Manager, you will lead hands-on pricing activities for significant federal pursuits and help mature JCTM’s competitive pricing and Price-to-Win capabilities. You will develop and evaluate pricing scenarios, conduct competitive pricing analysis, assess staffing and solution economics, review BOEs, and translate incomplete market and acquisition information into defensible recommendations.

Working with Growth, Capture, Finance, Operations, Proposal, Recruiting, HR, and technical SMEs, you will help leadership understand where JCTM’s proposed pricing sits relative to the competitive environment and identify practical levers that can improve competitiveness without undermining successful execution. This position offers significant visibility to JCTM leadership while providing room to grow into broader ownership of the company’s pricing strategy, processes, tools, and competitive-pricing infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:

Federal Proposal Pricing & Financial Modeling

  • Independently develop, maintain, audit, and troubleshoot complex federal proposal pricing and financial models.
  • Develop pricing for labor-intensive federal professional services opportunities, including complex multi-year pursuits and task orders.
  • Support FFP, FFP-LOE, T&M/Labor Hour, CPFF/cost-reimbursable, IDIQ, GWAC, and task-order pricing environments.
  • Model and analyze direct labor, fully burdened rates, fringe, overhead, G&A, escalation, subcontractors, consultants, travel, ODCs, fee/profit, gross margin, and total contract value.
  • Perform mathematical, formula, compliance, reasonableness, and sensitivity checks before executive review and proposal submission.
  • Develop multiple executable pricing scenarios and clearly explain the financial, competitive, staffing, and margin implications of each.

Competitive Pricing & Price-to-Win Analysis

  • Conduct or materially contribute to Price-to-Win analyses for priority federal pursuits using both top-down and bottom-up methodologies.
  • Develop defensible likely competitive or winning ranges based on available customer, competitor, acquisition, labor-market, historical-award, and pricing information.
  • Clearly document assumptions, confidence levels, known facts, analytical estimates, and material uncertainties.
  • Compare JCTM’s estimated price against likely competitive ranges and identify the principal labor, staffing, indirect-rate, fee, subcontractor, workshare, and solution drivers creating variance.
  • Reconcile top-down competitive analysis with bottom-up solution and cost modeling.
  • Help mature JCTM’s approach to incorporating competitive pricing analysis earlier in capture as additional experience and intelligence are developed.

Capture, Qualification & Pricing Strategy

  • Engage with Capture before final RFP release when sufficient information exists to begin meaningful pricing analysis.
  • Evaluate draft RFPs, PWS/SOWs, RFIs, acquisition strategy, historical awards, incumbent position, customer budgets, evaluation methodology, staffing assumptions, and available competitive intelligence.
  • Use pricing and competitive intelligence to inform or influence capture strategy, staffing, teaming, solution design, and Bid/No-Bid decisions.
  • Identify and professionally challenge unsupported pricing, staffing, labor-mix, margin, teaming, and execution assumptions when the available analysis indicates a material concern.
  • Provide pricing analysis and recommendations for significant pursuits and participate in applicable gate and Bid/No-Bid reviews.

BOE, Solution Economics & Staffing Analysis

  • Work with technical, capture, proposal, and operations leaders to develop and review Basis of Estimate documentation.
  • Maintain alignment and traceability between solicitation requirements, technical solution, staffing plan, BOE, hours, labor categories, and pricing assumptions.
  • Work with Operations, Program Management, Recruiting, HR, and technical SMEs to develop defensible labor categories, labor mixes, staffing levels, hours, phasing, and rate assumptions.
  • Evaluate staffing models for competitiveness, affordability, and execution feasibility.
  • Identify areas where labor mix, experience bands, staffing levels, phasing, or teaming may be adjusted without undermining technical execution.

Competitive, Customer & Labor-Market Intelligence

  • Research federal award history, incumbent contracts, customer buying patterns, competitor positioning, probable competitor rates and indirect structures, market compensation, public job postings, BLS data, government databases, and available commercial market-intelligence sources.
  • Use partner and subcontractor intelligence when useful and validate material assumptions where practical.
  • Clearly distinguish known information, inferred information, and analytical estimates.
  • Help develop and maintain reusable competitor-pricing, labor-rate, historical-award, and competitive-pricing intelligence so lessons from each pursuit strengthen future pricing decisions.
  • Incorporate relevant win/loss and debrief information into future pricing analysis.

Teammate, Subcontractor & Workshare Pricing

  • Coordinate pricing inputs and data calls with subcontractors, teaming partners, consultants, and joint venture participants.
  • Evaluate teammate pricing for competitiveness, labor-category alignment, indirect treatment, escalation, ODCs, period-of-performance consistency, workshare requirements, and pass-through/margin impact.
  • Analyze the pricing implications of labor allocation, teammate rates, workshare, pass-through, and subcontractor economics.
  • Support teammate and subcontractor pricing discussions and negotiations as required.

Executive Pricing Communication

  • Prepare concise, decision-quality pricing analyses for Growth, Finance, Operations, and executive leadership.
  • Clearly communicate likely competitive pricing ranges, JCTM’s estimated pricing position, significant assumptions, key cost and staffing drivers, margin implications, uncertainties, and available pricing levers.
  • Recommend pricing approaches based on available evidence and explain the assumptions and tradeoffs underlying those recommendations.
  • Defend pricing recommendations under questioning and professionally challenge unsupported assumptions.

Compliance, Process & Pricing Infrastructure

  • Apply working knowledge of FAR, DFARS, federal acquisition requirements, and government contract pricing principles to pricing activities.
  • Support compliance with solicitation-specific pricing instructions and applicable requirements concerning allowability, allocability, reasonableness, labor standards, and cost or pricing data.
  • Help develop and improve pricing models, rate libraries, templates, assumption logs, review checklists, and version-control practices appropriate for a growing small/mid-market GovCon.
  • Protect proprietary, procurement-sensitive, source-selection-sensitive, and contractor bid/proposal information.
  • Help capture lessons from awards, losses, and debriefs to improve future pricing analysis and processes.

Room to Grow:

This position provides meaningful exposure to JCTM’s CEO, CGO, CFO, Capture leadership, Operations, and other key decision-makers. You will have the opportunity to take increasing ownership of JCTM’s pricing strategy and infrastructure as the company grows. A successful individual can help shape how JCTM approaches competitive pricing, opportunity qualification, capture strategy, pricing posture, and investment decisions. This role is particularly well suited for a strong Senior Pricing Analyst, Pricing Manager, Senior Pricing Manager, or comparable federal pricing professional who has performed substantive pricing work on major federal pursuits and is ready for greater ownership and executive visibility.

You Have:

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible federal government contracting pricing, cost analysis, proposal pricing, competitive pricing/Price-to-Win analysis, or closely related experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own complex federal pricing models and proposal-pricing activities.
  • Experience conducting or materially contributing to federal competitive pricing/Price-to-Win analyses and developing defensible likely competitive or winning ranges.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform and reconcile top-down and bottom-up pricing analysis.
  • Significant experience pricing labor-intensive federal professional services.
  • Experience supporting significant federal services pursuits, including complex multi-year opportunities and task orders.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to independently build, audit, and troubleshoot complex pricing and financial models.
  • Strong understanding of labor-rate development, compensation markets, indirect rates, wrap, escalation, fee/profit, gross margin, and sensitivity analysis.
  • Experience developing and reviewing BOEs and aligning the technical solution, staffing, hours, and pricing assumptions.
  • Experience using pricing and competitive intelligence to inform or influence capture strategy, staffing, teaming, solution design, and Bid/No-Bid decisions.
  • Working knowledge of FAR, DFARS, federal acquisition requirements, and government contract pricing principles.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain and defend pricing recommendations under questioning and professionally challenge unsupported assumptions.
  • Ability to operate hands-on in a lean small/mid-market GovCon environment without requiring a large pricing department around you.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent pursuits and compressed proposal timelines.
  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience leading subcontractor or JV pricing, workshare analysis, rate comparison, and pricing negotiations.
  • Direct DoD and/or Intelligence Community pricing experience.
  • Experience with OASIS+, SeaPort-NxG, GSA MAS/Schedules, STARS, Polaris, or other GWAC/IDIQ and task-order environments.
  • Experience working with joint ventures and mentor-protégé arrangements.
  • Experience pricing 8(a), SDVOSB, small-business set-aside, and other socioeconomic acquisition strategies.
  • Knowledge of limitations on subcontracting and small-business workshare requirements.
  • Experience with LPTA and best-value tradeoff evaluation strategies.
  • Experience participating in Black Hat, competitive assessment, pre-RFP capture, and formal gate-review processes.
  • Experience with GovWin or comparable federal market-intelligence tools and public award/compensation databases.
  • Experience with Deltek Costpoint/GCS, Unanet, JAMIS, or comparable GovCon accounting/ERP platforms.
  • Experience responding to DCAA, DCMA, or government pricing information requests.
  • Experience helping build or materially improve a corporate pricing capability, model library, competitive-intelligence repository, or formal competitive-pricing process.

Compensation:

JCTM is committed to fair and transparent compensation practices. The anticipated compensation for this position will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, which may include the candidate’s relevant education, training, certifications, security clearance and access requirements, years and depth of relevant experience, specialized skills and qualifications, position level, assigned responsibilities, work location, applicable contract or customer requirements, internal equity, and the approved compensation budget for the position. Where required by applicable state or local law, JCTM will include the applicable good-faith salary or hourly pay range, along with any required information regarding benefits and other compensation, in the job posting.

Are you ready to make a lasting impact on literacy?

At Really Great Reading, we are building a bright, diverse, and passionate team dedicated to leading the industry in improving literacy scores nationwide. With nearly two decades of leadership bringing the Science of Reading to thousands of schools, we design innovative products, training, and materials that transform how educators teach and how students learn. Here, we empower our team with the tools, support, and professional growth opportunities they need to thrive in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment—where your work truly makes a difference.

Why This Role Matters

Literacy is foundational to student success, and as a Regional Sales Partner, you are the crucial bridge connecting school districts with our best-in-class educational solutions. By driving our national growth strategy and expanding our reach, you directly impact classrooms and educators, ensuring they have the tools necessary to improve literacy outcomes. You are not just closing deals; you equip districts with transformative education solutions.

The Role

The Regional Sales Partner - Pacific is a quota-carrying, territory-owning revenue leader responsible for driving annual bookings sales growth across California, Washington, Oregon, Alaska, and Hawaii. This role has dedicated ownership of the Pacific territory and is responsible for developing new district relationships, expanding existing accounts, and building a sustainable pipeline specifically within these states. Candidates must be based in California.

What You’ll Do

  • Revenue & Territory Ownership: Own the Pacific territory across CA, WA, OR, AK, and HI, with direct accountability for new and expansion bookings within these states. Maintain 2-3 times pipeline coverage and achieve >100% annual quota attainment with quarter-over-quarter growth, driving multi-year contract opportunities to increase Average Contract Value.
  • Demand Generation & Pipeline Creation: Source 70% of pipeline through self-generated outbound activity. Execute structured prospecting cadences to generate ~25 qualified meetings per month and $600k-$1M per quarter in additional pipeline.
  • Relationship Building & Deal Advancement: Cultivate strong, lasting relationships with decision-makers to become their trusted advisor. Build and maintain key relationships across 50 Strategic Districts at any given time.
  • Dynamic Presentations & Product Positioning: Deliver compelling presentations remotely, at customer locations, and at events. Demonstrate a deep understanding of models tied to district literacy metrics, MTSS outcomes, and funding alignment.
  • Sales Execution & Closing: Independently manage pricing, procurement navigation, proposals, and contracting. Qualify and progress opportunities through formal stages to achieve a 35% close rate.
  • Pipeline Management: Maintain CRM (HubSpot) accuracy of >95% and deliver accurate weekly forecasts, tracking and improving stage-to-stage conversion rates.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with pedagogy, marketing, and implementation teams to close complex instructional deals and ensure seamless client handoffs.
  • Travel: Travel up to 50% within the assigned territory to conduct client visits, evaluate needs, and attend industry events.

What You’ll Bring

  • Passion for Education: Genuine enthusiasm for improving educational outcomes and a strong belief in the value of our products.
  • Sales Drive: Proactive, self-motivated, and goal-oriented, with the ability to work independently to manage a dynamic sales territory.
  • Exceptional Communication: Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to deliver engaging presentations to both small and large audiences.
  • Data Fluency: The ability to confidently speak to ROI, funding pathways, instructional impact metrics, and district compliance requirements.

Required Education / Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience in selling in the education field.
  • 3+ years of quota-carrying education or enterprise B2B sales experience with a documented record of annual quota attainment success.
  • Expertise with HubSpot, forecasting tools, structured deal management, and Google Workspace.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously.

Preferred Experience

  • Prior experience successfully navigating complex instructional and compliance-driven deals within the K-12 education space.

Physical Requirements

This is a fully remote role. Team members work primarily at a computer and regularly engage in video conferencing, document review, and digital collaboration. The ability to work at a screen for extended periods, use standard input devices, and participate in virtual meetings is required.

We believe diverse perspectives strengthen innovation, improve learning outcomes, and advance educational equity nationwide.

Overview

The national offices of the Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.), A Corporation (“A Corp”) “PC(USA)”, based in Louisville Kentucky, serve with mid-councils, congregations, worshipping communities, and partner organizations to carry forth the mission of Jesus Christ. Approximately 400 individuals, diverse in race, age, gender, sexual orientation, faith, skills, and more, come together as colleagues to work for a world where justice reigns, peace prevails, and God’s love extends to all people. This community comprises the staff of national entities: the Presbyterian Life & Witness, the Presbyterian Publishing Corporation, Presbyterian Women, Investment and Loan Program, and the Administrative Services Group.

Basic Commitment: This position calls for a commitment to the mission of the Presbyterian Church (U.S.A.) as noted in its theological confessions, the Book of Order, and the actions of the General Assembly.

Organizational Purpose:

The General Assembly’s Presbyterian Life & Witness (PL&W) is called as a partner to convene, connect, equip, and empower the whole church as disciples journeying toward God’s wholeness – in the PC(USA) and beyond. Justice, love, equity, and inclusion (representation and full participation) are core and foundational values already embedded in the theology, polity, and confessional life of the PC(USA). The four values below are how PL&W lives out those foundational commitments: Nimble, Trustworthy, Learning, Courageous.

Purpose of Position:

This position is an Individual Contributor who performs complex to highly complex non-routine duties. Responsibilities that coordinate work of a specific program to ensure that implementation and prescribed activities of a larger program or ministry are carried out to achieve specified objectives. Plans and develops methods and procedures for implementing programs, directs and coordinates program activities. Confers and/or collaborates both internally and externally on projects or to educate/communicate programmatic information. Prepares and/or reviews reports and records of activities to ensure progress and make modifications or changes in methodology as required to attain objectives. Uses discretion and independent judgment in completing activities. Operates under general supervision.

The Associate for Assessment and Recruitment is the primary contact on the 1001 team for individuals discerning a call to start a new worshiping community, and/or in the early stages of starting. They take primary responsibility for 1001’s leadership assessment and discernment programs and collaborate with the rest of the 1001 Team and other PL&W colleagues to create resources for new worshiping communities, NWC leaders, and mid councils supporting that work.

Roles and Responsibilities (list in order of priority):

  1. Lead and execute (in partnership with mid councils, seminaries, or other partners) 1001 Leadership Assessments, including Discerning Missional Leadership assessments or its successor programs.
  2. Educate mid councils on the needed qualities and competencies for new worshiping community leadership. Partner and consult with mid councils as they develop these qualities and competencies within their bounds.
  3. Create vocational discernment opportunities and introductions to the work of 1001NWCs in partnership with mid councils, seminaries, PCUSA racial ethnic caucuses, and other constituency groups.
  4. Facilitate consultation and coaching with individual prospective NWC leaders in the discernment of their call.
  5. In collaboration with the 1001 team and other PL&W colleagues, develop and update resources for the starting and sustaining of new worshiping communities.
  6. Interpret the vision of 1001 NWCs and PL&W to mid councils, congregations, and other constituency groups.
  7. Participate regularly in evaluation of the 1001 NWCs program.

Essential Position Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; master’s degree
  • 4-7 years of increasingly responsible related programmatic experience
  • 4 or more years of experience leading a new worshiping community, or providing significant support of one.
  • Experience with 1001’s Discerning Missional Leadership assessment. Past experience as a contracted assessor strongly preferred.
  • Certification or familiarity with inventories used in 1001 assessment programs (Clifton Strengths, TKI, etc.)

Required Skills:

  • Proficiency using the Microsoft Suite (including Outlook, Word, Teams, PowerPoint, and Excel) and other appropriate software.
  • Familiarity with Canva, Jotform, and Basecamp or similar project management software is helpful.

Helpful Skills:

  • Understanding and knowledge of PC(USA) and it’s organizational structure.
  • The ability to speak one or more languages other than English is very helpful.
  • Familiarity with the history and programs of the 1001 New Worshiping Communities office.
  • Familiarity with current thought leadership in the areas of church planting and leadership development.

Additional Information/Benefits:

We believe a balanced life, with time for work, leisure, and spiritual nurture, makes us healthier and more productive colleagues.

Physical Requirement / Essential Functions:

  • This is largely a sedentary position that may require occasional lifting up to 15 pounds. Requires the ability to see, hear, speak, type, write, walk, stand, bend, and lift
  • Sensory and physical requirements include the ability to communicate verbally in person and through technology and use the computer for extended periods of time. Ability to communicate via telephone, via Zoom, and other computer technologies required
  • Able to read and understand written materials.
  • Ability to communicate in a manner suitable to a church office environment
  • Requires regularly (typically monthly) overnight, out-of-town travel

  • Medical
  • Dental

  • Basic Life Insurance

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

raw.description:
About PlanITROI

For more than 25 years, PlanITROI has helped organizations maximize the value of their retired technology through secure IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), lifecycle management, reverse logistics, refurbishment, repair, redeployment, and re-marketing services. Every device we recover creates financial value for our clients while extending technology life and helping provide affordable devices to individuals, schools, nonprofits, and businesses worldwide. PlanITROI is a recognized leader in sustainable IT lifecycle solutions, helping enterprise organizations improve financial performance, strengthen security, and advance ESG initiatives through our circular economy model.

Business Development Manager Position Overview

PlanITROI is seeking a proven Business Development Manager with deep experience selling IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), IT Lifecycle Services, Reverse Logistics, and Enterprise Technology Solutions. This is a true hunter role focused on acquiring new enterprise clients and developing long-term strategic relationships. The ideal candidate already possesses an extensive network of enterprise IT decision-makers and has successfully sold complex technology services, including IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), Device Buyback & Trade-In Programs, Lifecycle Management, Depot Repair Services, Device Refresh & Deployment, Asset Recovery, Circular Economy Programs, Sustainability & ESG Initiatives, and Managed Device Services. You understand how to engage CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, Procurement Leaders, IT Asset Managers, Infrastructure Executives, and Supply Chain leaders while positioning technology lifecycle programs that reduce cost, maximize asset recovery, improve security, and support sustainability objectives.

This role is based in the United States, and works on EST only.

Mission of the role:

Lead the expansion of PlanITROI's enterprise market presence by acquiring new strategic clients, building trusted executive relationships, and delivering innovative IT lifecycle solutions that maximize financial value, reduce environmental impact, and help close the digital divide. Through consultative selling and industry expertise, this role will accelerate revenue growth while positioning PlanITROI as the premier enterprise partner for IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), lifecycle management, and circular economy solutions.

The problem we're trying to solve:

Enterprise organizations invest billions of dollars in technology, yet many continue to lose significant value when managing retired IT assets. They often face fragmented vendor relationships, security and compliance risks, inefficient logistics, rising sustainability expectations, and underperforming asset recovery programs. At the same time, many organizations are unaware that a strategic IT lifecycle partner can transform retired technology into measurable financial returns while advancing ESG initiatives and creating meaningful social impact.

PlanITROI is solving this challenge by providing a comprehensive, end-to-end technology lifecycle solution that securely manages every stage of a device's journey, from deployment and refresh to asset recovery, refurbishment, re-marketing, and responsible reuse.

The Business Development Leader is responsible for identifying these opportunities, educating enterprise leaders on the hidden value within their technology assets, and converting them into long-term strategic partnerships that drive growth for both our clients and PlanITROI.

This role is more than winning new business; it's about changing how enterprises think about technology lifecycle management by demonstrating that secure ITAD, sustainability, and profitability are not competing priorities but powerful business advantages when delivered through the right partner.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategic business development plans targeting enterprise organizations with 10,000+ computing users
  • Generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, industry events, and strategic outreach
  • Build executive-level relationships with enterprise IT and procurement leaders
  • Position PlanITROI's comprehensive IT lifecycle services, including IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), Secure Data Destruction, Device Buyback Programs, Redeployment, Depot Repair, Asset Recovery, Refurbishment, and Device Re-marketing
  • Identify enterprise refresh cycles, lease expiration, mergers, acquisitions, and technology initiatives that create lifecycle opportunities
  • Deliver compelling executive presentations demonstrating financial, operational, and sustainability value
  • Manage complex sales opportunities from prospecting through contract execution
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Operations, Client Success, and Executive Leadership throughout the sales process
  • Maintain accurate pipeline forecasting, opportunity management, and sales activity within Salesforce
  • Respond to RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and enterprise procurement requests
  • Represent PlanITROI at conferences, trade shows, technology events, and industry associations
  • Consistently exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue objectives

Required Experience

  • 5+ years of enterprise business development experience within the following: IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), Enterprise Hardware Sales, Managed IT Services, Device Lifecycle Management, Depot Repair, Circular Economy Solutions, Enterprise Technology Services
  • Existing relationships with enterprise IT decision-makers across Fortune 1000, Global 2000, healthcare, education, financial services, government, manufacturing, or large commercial organizations
  • Demonstrated success selling six- and seven-figure enterprise solutions
  • Proven history of consistently meeting and exceeding sales quotas
  • Experience managing long enterprise sales cycles with consistent touch points
  • Experience building and executing strong executive presentations and negotiation skills
  • Experience identifying enterprise device refresh opportunities and technology lifecycle initiatives
  • Knowledge of IT procurement processes, leasing, asset recovery, and hardware refresh strategies
  • Strong understanding of data security, compliance, and sustainability within enterprise IT environments
  • Experience usine AI Tools and technology ( Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, etc. )
  • Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Experience with Zoom Info & LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • Experience with Apollo AI or similar modern Lead Generation tools

What Makes You Successful

  • A relentless hunter who enjoys opening new enterprise accounts
  • Highly connected within the ITAD and enterprise technology ecosystem
  • Passionate about solving customer challenges through consultative selling

About Lydian Energy

Lydian is an established energy development company specializing in the development and construction of utility-scale solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) projects in North America. Lydian owns 14 assets in development, construction or under operation, consisting of both solar and storage, which reached or are expected to reach FNTP from 2024-2028.

Lydian is backed by Excelsior Energy Capital (“EEC”), a leading private equity fund manager with more than $1.5B in assets under management, that is exclusively focused on north American middle market renewables investing. Lydian’s relationship with EEC provides several critical advantages, including access to (i) a specialized team of value-add investor-operators with decades of renewables development, construction, and transaction experience and (ii) committed discretionary equity capital, strong relationships with debt and tax equity investors, and deep experience structuring tax equity and project financings.

Lydian has built a team of seasoned, passionate energy infrastructure professionals with deep expertise in project development, construction, financing, and M&A. This is an opportunity to join a fully capitalized development platform that is running at full capacity, but still at an early-enough stage for you to have a real impact on company culture and commercial outcomes.

Job Scope

The Senior Electrical Engineer will provide technical leadership across the development and pre-construction phases of utility-scale solar PV and BESS projects throughout the United States. This is a multi-faceted role suited for an engineer with experience managing concurrent projects across multiple phases of the project lifecycle. The Senior Electrical Engineer will serve as the primary technical resource on assigned projects from early-stage development through construction readiness, coordinating across internal teams and external partners to advance projects on schedule and within scope. Core functions include project-level technical diligence, design optimization, development engineering, pre-construction support, and risk analysis.

Experience creating utility scale PV / BESS layouts and preliminary plan sets in AutoCAD a plus.

About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LPCC, LMFT, LCSW) in New Mexico to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

Who You Are
