Zelh is a fast-growing, passionate outsourcing company.
Our mission is to be the most reliable partner by delivering consistently high-quality services.

We build long-term relationships with our customers, employees, and vendors through personal attention, clear communication, and respect. That’s the foundation of everything we do.

Now we are looking for Accounting Assistant for one of our logistics client.

The Accounting Assistant supports the company's daily financial and accounting operations through the management of accounts receivable (A/R), accounts payable (A/P), collections, financial reporting, vendor/carrier record maintenance, and special projects.

This role plays a critical part in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting cash flow management, ensuring timely invoicing and collections, and providing executive leadership with actionable financial visibility.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounts Receivable & Billing Administration

  • Delivered Not Invoiced (DNI) Management: Maintain and monitor DNI reports. Identify delivered shipments lacking billing documentation, communicate missing items to operations, and distribute updated DNI reports every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

  • Daily Invoicing: Ensure all eligible shipments are billed daily (Monday–Friday). Verify all required documentation prior to invoicing and maintain strict adherence to billing accuracy standards.

  • Aging & Terms: Set invoice aging to begin on the shipment pickup date (unless otherwise directed). Monitor customer payment terms, maintain billing profiles, and recommend improvements to billing processes that impede collections.

  • Payment Application: Accurately record customer payments, apply receipts to open invoices, and reconcile unapplied cash or payment discrepancies.

2. Collections Management

  • Process Coordination: Serve as primary coordinator for customer collections. Routinely monitor aging reports, identify delinquent accounts, and conduct polite, firm outreach via telephone and email.

  • Record Keeping: Maintain detailed, up-to-date log notes regarding all outreach, customer responses, and payment promises.

  • Escalations: Identify high-risk accounts or payment disputes and escalate them promptly to executive leadership with actionable recommendations. (Note: This role executes collections but does not independently authorize payment plans, discounts, terms revisions, or write-offs).

  • Weekly A/R Reporting: Prepare and distribute a comprehensive weekly A/R report sorted from oldest to newest open balance, including:

    • A/R Aging Summary: Current, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, and 91+ days past due.

    • Open Invoice Detail: Customer name, invoice number/date, shipment/load number, due date, balance, and days outstanding.

    • High-Priority Collections Section: Detailed tracking for over-terms accounts, major balances, disputes, non-responsive accounts, and special watchlist accounts.

    • Cash Flow Projections: Expected collection forecasts for 7-day and 30-day windows, along with risk assessments and trend analysis.

3. Accounts Payable & Carrier Management

  • Invoice Verification: Review carrier and vendor invoices against delivery documentation for accuracy and complete supporting records before marking items eligible for payment.

  • Documentation & Onboarding: Maintain organized carrier/vendor records (including W-9 forms, payment details, and contact information). Follow up on missing or incomplete billing documentation.

  • Payable Administration: Monitor upcoming payment due dates, track payment terms, and prioritize payables according to operational impact.

  • Weekly A/P Reporting: Prepare and distribute a weekly A/P report categorized into:

    • All Payables: Complete list of obligations sorted by due date (oldest to newest).

    • High-Priority Payables: Dedicated tracking for factoring companies, active payment inquiries, operationally critical carriers, and leadership-designated urgent payables.

  • Payment Posting: Accurately log approved vendor/carrier payments in the accounting software and maintain clean ledger histories.

4. Financial Reporting & Administrative Support

  • Prepare recurring financial and operational reports as assigned (e.g., monthly volume/load activity reports).

  • Assist with accounting process improvements, reporting automation initiatives, and system organization.

  • Maintain clean, organized digital accounting files and supporting documentation.

5. Special Projects

  • Support accounting, operational, technology, and reporting initiatives as assigned.

  • Assist with administration within QuickBooks Online and associated financial software tools.

Authority & Decision-Making Guidelines

The Accounting Assistant executes, monitors, and reports on accounting procedures but does not possess independent authority to bind the company financially or alter terms.

Prior Approval from Executive Leadership is required for:

  • Execution of carrier and vendor payments.

  • Vendor payments outside standard approved procedures.

  • Modifications to customer or carrier payment terms.

  • Settlement agreements, payment plans, credits, or account write-offs (A/R or A/P).

  • Any new financial commitments or material process alterations to billing/accounting workflows.

Qualifications & Expectations

  • Accuracy & Detail: High level of precision in data entry, financial reconciliation, and record keeping.

  • Communication: Clear, professional written and verbal communication for outreach with customers, carriers, vendors, and internal teams.

  • Time Management: Strong sense of urgency and ability to consistently meet weekly reporting, billing, and collection deadlines.

  • Software Proficiency: Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online and core accounting workflows (A/R, A/P, Collections).

  • Integrity & Discretion: Proven ability to handle confidential financial records with care and exercise sound judgment when escalating critical issues.

Working Conditions

  • Schedule: Mon–Fri, 07.00-16.00 CST

  • Competitive Salary in USD

  • Work type: Remote

  • 10+ business days of paid time off, 15 after 2 years

  • Equipment provided

We're on a mission to help the world work Anywhere. Whether working from home, an office, or Anywhere, we offer products and services designed to help people work and learn together, whether they're across a table or across the world. Work is what we do, not where we do it.

We're hiring BilingualClient Experience Associates to join our team!


Your Role

  • Watch first:A Day in the Life of a Client Experience Associate

  • Answer inbound calls for our clients' businesses from home. You'll capture leads, take orders, schedule appointments, and send messages to clients.

  • Handle a range of call types, including standard answering, Active Response (where a message pops up and you are to make an outbound call to someone), live chat, relay calls, appointment setting, and legal intake calls. You'll be trained on each one.

  • Expect a steady, fast pace. Calls often come in back-to-back, and we measure performance by quality, accuracy, ready %, and after-call work time.

Your Schedule

  • 40 hours per week, mostly scheduled between 5:00 am and 8:00 pm Pacific Time.

  • A minimum of 8 hours every Friday and Saturday is required for the first 8-12 weeks after training.

  • You choose your own shifts each week, but choice is ranked by performance tier. Higher tiers pick first, so new associates should expect the least choice at the start. Flexibility is a must.

  • Attendance is tracked with a points system. Being reliable is very important!

Training

  • 2 weeks of paid training, followed by 8–12 weeks of Learning & Development, where you’ll take live calls with ongoing support.

  • During this period, you'll need full availability for 40 hours a week and can't block off holidays or vacation time.


Your Skills

  • Excellent verbal and written communication in both English & Spanish (fluent in both languages).

  • A warm, upbeat tone and a genuine interest in helping people

  • A good listener who stays calm and efficient under pressure

  • Dependable: you show up for every scheduled shift, on time

  • Strong computer skills and typing at a minimum of 30 WPM

  • A growth mindset and eagerness to learn new call types and tools

Requirements

Compensation & Benefits

  • Starting at $16.00/hour

  • Benefits start after 60 days: [e.g., medical, dental, vision, EAP, PTO]

  • 401(k) with matching after one year of employment

Your System

We use a Bring Your Own Device policy. Your computer and internet connection must meet oursystem and internet requirements before you start.

About AnywhereWorks

Work is what you do, not where you do it. We’re on a mission to help the world work Anywhere. We believe people should be able to work and learn together, whether they’re communicating across a table or across the world.

We offer a diverse set of products and services to a variety of businesses, from live answering services to scheduling and payment platforms to shared working spaces. We empower people to communicate, collaborate and produce. We’re committed to building a more inclusive future of work, where people can contribute from Anywhere.


What "Anywhere" Means to Us

Other terms out in the world are “remote” “distributed” “telecommuting” – for us, these words do not speak to the experience we hope you will have working with us Anywhere.

Isolation and a lack of social interaction are common concerns when people think about Remote working. The word “Remote” itself can conjure up ideas of loneliness and being disconnected from your colleagues. That’s why we like the more empowering language of “working Anywhere”, with Anywhere representing an unconstrained, plugged-in destination.

AnywhereWorks is committed to providing equal opportunity employment; creating, managing, and valuing diversity in our workforce; providing a safe work environment; and fostering a culture of belonging where all employees are included, treated with dignity and respect, promoted on their merits, and placed in positions to contribute to our future success.

Background Check

Please note that all candidates who receive a conditional offer of employment will be required to undergo a background check as part of the pre-employment screening process. This is to ensure the safety and integrity of our workplace and to comply with our company policies.

We comply with all requirements of the Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) to ensure the privacy and rights of our applicants are protected.

Equal Opportunity

AnywhereWorks is committed to providing equal opportunity employment; creating, managing, and valuing diversity in our workforce; providing a safe work environment; and fostering a culture of belonging where all employees are included, treated with dignity and respect, promoted on their merits, and placed in positions to contribute to our future success.

raw.description:
We are looking for an ambitious Business Development Manager to join our growing TLT Electronics international Sales team. This is a remote position based in Europe, focused on supporting the commercial growth of our Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) business across the European market.

The role can be based in Germany or another well-connected European location with convenient access to an international airport. While we have a particular focus on the DACH region, we are open to candidates across Europe. The position requires frequent business travel across Germany and other European countries to meet customers, develop new business opportunities, and represent TLT Electronics at industry events.

At TLT, we are committed to continuous growth and staying at the forefront of manufacturing innovation. Our 55-hectare high-tech manufacturing park, equipped with advanced automation and robotics, enables us to turn even the most complex electronics and plastics ideas into real, impactful products used around the world.

We foster a strong, winning culture where collaboration, ownership, and ambition drive real results. By working closely across engineering, project management, and manufacturing teams, we create solutions that truly make a difference.

At TLT, we invest in our people. Here, you'll have the opportunity to strengthen your project management expertise, expand your technical understanding, and grow professionally while working on challenging ODM projects from concept to production.

Ready to create impact? Join our team and help shape the future of Electronics Manufacturing Services in Europe.

In this role, you will:

  • Contribute to market research by identifying target clients, understanding their needs, and identifying opportunities for market growth across Europe.
  • Develop new business opportunities through proactive outreach, customer visits, presentations, and business case analysis.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective customers across Germany and other European markets.
  • Prepare commercial offers, manage contract processes, and achieve assigned sales development goals.
  • Represent TLT Electronics at exhibitions, customer meetings, and industry events across Europe.
  • Work closely with and report to the Sales Group Manager and collaborate with Key Account Managers and internal teams to achieve results.
  • Travel frequently across Germany and Europe to develop customer relationships and new business opportunities.

What we expect of you:

  • 5+ years of B2B sales or business development experience in Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS), contract manufacturing, or industrial manufacturing environments.
  • Previous experience in international or European B2B sales is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English, both spoken and written. No additional language is required.
  • An organized and results-oriented approach with a challenge-driven personality.
  • Strong commercial drive and motivation to achieve ambitious sales targets.
  • Strong presentation and business communication skills.
  • Strong negotiation skills, organizational proficiency, and expertise in business project management.
  • Valid driving license.
  • Willingness and ability to travel frequently across Germany and Europe.
  • Residence in Europe with convenient access to an international airport.

What we offer:

  • A benefit package consisting of unlimited commissions based on your performance.
  • A remote working setup, giving you flexibility while staying closely connected with customers and our international team.
  • Structured onboarding, internal training, and continuous support for your successful start.
  • Team-building events, summer festivals, and other occasions where we celebrate achievements together.
  • Generous bonuses for participation in our referral program.
  • Additional bonuses for successfully implemented projects.
  • Recognition and rewards for long-term commitment and dedication.

Salary:

Recognizing each candidate's experience and expertise, we offer a competitive compensation package reflecting your skills and background.

Please submit your CV in English.

raw.description:
🧡 Coverflex

Work changed. Pay didn’t.

Coverflex exists to make compensation work for everyone.
Pay is still rigid, fragmented, and hard to feel.
We turn compensation into choice — one platform, one card, one app — for benefits, meal allowance, insurance and more.

Our platform is simple for HR and meaningful for employees.
We provide choice, smarter compensation tools and empowerment.

⚙️ TL;DR (The Essentials)

Role: Business Development Representative (BDR)
Seniority Level: Junior
Type: Individual Contributor
Languages: English (main) / Italian (C2/native)
Main Tools: HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach, Notion, Slack
Location: Remote (Italy)
Compensation:

  • Base Salary: €21,000 – €28,000

  • Bonus / Commissions:Uncapped

  • Meal Vouchers:10€/day

  • Equity: Yes – Stock Options under our Equity Incentive Plan

  • Benefits: you can check them below (at the end of the page)

  • Contract Type: Fixed Term - 6 months

💥 Your Impact

Your role will play a major role in our success because you’ll be one of the first BDRs dedicated to the Italian market, directly fueling our sales pipeline and revenue growth.

You’ll be the engine behind new opportunities — opening doors, creating conversations, and ensuring our Account Executives spend their time on high-quality, well-qualified meetings.

You’ll know you’re successful when, after 90 days, you’ve:

  • Built a strong outbound rhythm with consistent, high-quality activity

  • Started booking qualified meetings for AEs

  • Become autonomous in prospecting, CRM hygiene, and handover

How we’ll measure success:

  • Main KPI 1: Number of outbound activities (calls)

  • Main KPI 2: Number of meetings booked (SQL)

  • Main KPI 3: Number of qualified meetings (SAL)

  • Secondary KPI 1: Pipeline and revenue influenced

  • Secondary KPI 2: CRM data quality and feedback loops

⚡ Reality Check - What Makes This Role Hard

Let’s be real — here’s what makes this role challenging:

  • High volume of outreach with frequent rejection

  • A strong focus on phone-based prospecting (cold calls are key)

  • You need resilience, consistency, and energy — even on hard days

  • You’ll be measured on inputs and outputs, not just effort

  • Fast feedback loops: you’ll constantly adapt based on results

This role is not about comfort — it’s about growth, grit, and momentum.

👤 You

Must-haves (evidence, not years)

  • Iterative, curious, and entrepreneurial mindset — you bring solutions, not just problems

  • Self-driven, proactive, and motivated to continuously improve

  • Outcome-focused: “good enough” beats perfect, impact beats process

  • You’re not afraid of hearing “no” — and you don’t take it personally

  • You find new ways in when the obvious path is blocked

  • Fluent Italian (C2 / native) and fluent English

  • Strong verbal communication skills

Nice-to-have

  • Solid CRM usage habits (HubSpot experience is a plus)

  • Exposure to tech, HR, finance, or benefits-related ICPs

  • SMB outbound sales experience

  • Benefits market knowledge

🧬 Your DNA

  • Proactive, energetic, and resilient

  • Persuasive without being aggressive

  • Comfortable handling objections and pushback

  • Calm and grounded

  • Coachable and open to continuous feedback

You’ll probably find this frustrating if…

  • You lack ambition

  • You struggle with feedback

  • You give up easily after rejection

  • You prefer low-activity, low-pressure roles

👥 Manager & Team

Meet Your Manager

Hiring Manager: Stefano Alicicco - Head of Business Development
Location: Italy
LinkedIn Profile:

Profile Snapshot:

  • Energy: positive, relaxed, optimistic, but highly focused and results-oriented

  • Communication: direct and informal

  • Feedback Style: gentle, honest, and straightforward

How to work with me - in the Manager's own words:

“I see myself as part of the team, not above it. My job is to help you succeed — I work for you. We’ll have fun, push hard, and aim high together. I’m friendly and accessible, but I expect full commitment, precision, and a winning attitude every day. If you bring energy and ownership, you’ll always have my trust and support.”

Your Team

You’ll work day-to-day with:

  • Tommaso Villani, BDR Team Lead,

  • Elia Barozzi, BDR,

  • Giorgia Bertotto, BDR,

  • Andrea Burchiella, BDR,

  • Samuele Campagna, BDR,

  • Andrée Dametti, BDR,

  • Matteo Dolcini, BDR,

  • Marilù La Monica, BDR,

  • Naual Monssif, BDR,

  • Ivan Niccolò, BDR,

  • Niko Panozzi, BDR,

  • Claudia Pasquino, BDR,

  • Jacopo Puliserpio, BDR,

  • Giulia Sciacca, BDR,

  • Federico Tasini, BDR,

Key Stakeholders:

  • Account Executive Team

  • Marketing Team

  • Growth Team

Team Rituals:

  • Weekly training sessions (Friday)

  • Regular roleplay calls (30 min)

  • Ongoing 1:1s focused on activity, follow-up, and improvement

💜 Access & Belonging (Equal Opportunity)

We hire for impact and potential, not pedigree.
We welcome applications from people with non-linear careers, career breaks, caregiving gaps, and those changing fields.

No discrimination on the basis of age, disability, gender identity/expression, marital or family status, pregnancy, neurodivergence, race/ethnicity, religion/belief, gender, sexual orientation, or any other protected ground.

Assessment fairness:
We anchor on evidence of outcomes (what you shipped, moved, or influenced).
We actively de-bias by using structured rubrics, multiple assessors, and blind screening most of the time (we won’t know your name, gender, or personal info until the interview stage).

📬 Application Clarity

No cover letter required.

Apply with your LinkedIn or upload your CVin English.
You may be asked a few short, relevant questions.

Total candidate time investment: ~2 hours end-to-end.

🧩 Hiring Stages (What to Expect, Why & How Long)

1. CV / LinkedIn Screen — Signal check vs must-haves

Done by People + Hiring Manager.

You’ll hear from us within 7 business days.

2. Quick Interview (Intro Call) - Mutual fit & context • 30 min
With People. Covers role scope, salary, location, and timeline.

3. Hiring Manager Interview - Deep dive into your work • 45 min
With Stefano Alicicco. Structured around outcomes, decisions, and collaboration.
Includes a roleplay focused on: strategy, objection handling, booking meetings

4. Team Chat - Meet the Team + Q&A • 30 min

With Andrea Guffanti or Alex Andres.

🤖 AI & Hiring Tools Transparency

We use a few tools to reduce bias and improve documentation, not to make hiring decisions.

  • Teamtailor anonymisation: profiles are reviewed without relying on names/personal identifiers.

  • Meeting recorder (e.g., ): may be used to capture interviews so we can focus on the conversation.

  • ChatGPT: may be used to turn interview notes/transcripts into clear, structured summaries.

Important: every application is reviewed by a human, and no decision or rejection is made by AI. If recording is used, we’ll be transparent and (where required) ask for consent.

⏱️ Speed & Communication

  • Decision: within 4 weeks of your application.

  • Updates: weekly if the process runs longer.

  • Scheduling:interviews between 10:00–16:00 CET (flexible across Europe).

Feedback:from the Case stage onwards, you’ll always receive written or verbal feedback - what went well, and what to strengthen next time.

raw.description:
About ev.energy
We are building the world's largest EV-centric virtual power plant (VPP). By connecting to vehicles, chargers, batteries, solar, and other distributed energy resources, we turn households into flexible grid assets that balance supply and demand, preventing blackouts and reducing reliance on fossil fuels.
We are scaling rapidly across North America and Europe. We are moving fast, we are AI-first, and we are looking for builders who want to power the grid of the future.

About the role
Our core platform is built in Python and Django, so we're looking for experienced backend software engineers with strong Python skills; Django experience would be beneficial but we’re open to other frameworks.

You'll be the person who takes a product idea and builds the systems, services, and infrastructure that make it real — reliable, scalable, and fast to iterate on. We're not looking for generalists who dabble across the stack — we're looking for someone with deep backend craft who can move fast, build with AI as a core part of how they work, and take genuine ownership of what they ship.

We're hiring for a number of roles across both of our Technology teams: new product development and customer delivery. We'd love to talk to you about both teams, understand what excites you, and place you into the team where we think you'll thrive best.

What you’ll do

Backend engineering and architecture
  • Design, build, and own backend services and APIs that power our product — from data models to infrastructure to production reliability
  • Make sound architectural decisions that balance shipping speed against long-term maintainability and scale
  • Take ownership of significant technical areas — from identifying the right approach to shipping and iterating in production
Building and shipping with AI
  • Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) as a core, daily part of how you write and ship code — not an occasional add-on
  • Build working backend prototypes fast — good enough to validate with real usage, not over-engineered before it's proven
  • Know when a rough implementation is right for the moment and when production-grade engineering is needed — and apply that judgment confidently
  • Ship, measure, learn, iterate — kill what isn't working, double down on what is
Product and stakeholder collaboration
  • Work closely with product, design, and commercial stakeholders to translate customer problems into technical solutions
  • Act as a credible engineering voice in cross-functional discussions, pilot programmes, and technical scoping conversations
  • Partner with Customer Support, Program Management, and Demand Generation to understand how customers find, adopt, and stay with ev.energy
Raising the bar
  • Share what you learn openly, challenge how things are built, and raise the technical bar for the engineers around you
  • Model what AI-native backend engineering looks like in practice — not in theory
  • Contribute to a culture of experimentation, velocity, and commercial impact

Our tech stack
  • Python and Django for our core platform
  • Django REST Framework for our APIs
  • React, React Native and TypeScript for our web and mobile app
  • PostgreSQL, Redis and DynamoDB for data storage
  • AWS for hosting, with infrastructure managed as code using Terraform

Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES,Tô.que.tô, TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz, Casa Magalhães e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.


Vem fazer beleza com a gente!


Como Gerente SecOps, você será o responsável pela operação de Segurança da Informação do Grupo Boticário, liderando uma área 24x7 que combina automação, IA agêntica e uma gestão de recursos financeiros relevantes para proteger o negócio e construir a melhor plataforma de defesa integrada e autônoma, rumo a uma segurança invisível e orientada à dados.

O que você vai fazer

  • Definir a estratégia de SecOps a partir dos objetivos da organização, com autonomia para traçar o caminho até a ambição da área;
  • Liderar a operação 24x7, mantendo o time sempre pronto para agir e modernizando processos com automação e IA para tornar a operação e a resposta a incidentes mais rápidas e eficientes;
  • Liderar gestores e suas equipes, com profissionais em diferentes momentos de carreira, priorizando eficiência operacional e bem-estar das pessoas;
  • Cuidar do orçamento de SecOps, revisando contratos, negociando SLAs com fornecedores e gerando valor continuamente em grande escala;
  • Atuar diretamente em crises complexas que vão além da tecnologia (como vazamento de dados, fórmulas ou impactos em lançamentos), articulando Líderes de Tecnologia, VPs, Diretoria, Jurídico, DPO, Marketing e P
  • Preparar infraestrutura e processos para enfrentar ameaças potencializadas por IA, usando a própria tecnologia a favor da defesa;
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas operacionais como MTTD, MTTR, SLAs e OKRs de eficiência;
  • Garantir estabilidade, observabilidade e governança de ambientes críticos: cloud, redes, servidores e pipelines;
  • Conduzir o planejamento de capacidade e a gestão contínua de riscos operacionais cibernéticos;
  • Alinhar estrategicamente parceiros, prestadores de serviço e terceiros.
  • Visão estratégica e experiência em traduzir objetivos de negócio em planos e prioridades de segurança e operação;
  • Formação superior completa em Tecnologia, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em Tecnologia, com trajetória em Segurança da Informação, Infraestrutura, DevOps ou operação de ambientes críticos;
  • Experiência na liderança de gestores e times, com foco em desenvolvimento de carreira e sucessão;
  • Vivência em gestão de crise em tempo real, com exposição à alta liderança (Diretores e VPs), mantendo clareza e equilíbrio na tomada de decisão e na condução do time em momentos críticos;
  • Domínio técnico de infraestrutura, redes, servidores, cloud, pipelines e observabilidade em ambientes 24x7;
  • Conhecimento em automação de processos operacionais (scripting, IaC, SOAR ou equivalentes) e aplicação de IA em operações;
  • Experiência relevante em gestão orçamentária, forecast, fornecedores e controle de SLAs;
  • Inglês técnico para leitura e diálogo com parceiros e fornecedores globais.


Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Experiência com times de Operação de Segurança, SOC, CSIRT ou Threat Intelligence;
  • Conhecimento de tecnologias de defesa (NGFW, SIEM, SOAR, EDR, WAF, SASE) e frameworks de segurança (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, MITRE ATT
  • Experiência com IA aplicada à segurança (copilotos de SOC, LLMs para triagem, ML para detecção de anomalias);
  • Certificações como CISSP, CISM ou pós/MBA em Segurança ou Gestão;
  • Inglês avançado.

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que cuidam e se diferenciam:

No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.

Para sua família

  • Auxílio material escolar e crédito nutrição infantil

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

The Support Services Analyst (Level 2) ensures that all customer needs are promptly and professionally addressed by responding to customers’ requests, problems, questions, and concerns in a timely and accurate manner, while exercising the highest level of service and quality.

The Support Services Analyst (Level 2) is also responsible for contributing to the analysis of customer problems and requirements, the development of the solutions and workarounds, and for testing and configuring Noggin software to implement those solutions on behalf of customers.

This position will require providing coverage on Saturday and Sunday, with rest days during the Monday to Friday timeframe.


Job Description

# Customer Support

  • 1.1 Provide accurate, timely and professional support to the customer’s satisfaction using phone, email, portal, forums, and chat tools.

  • 1.2 Gather information about customer problems and needs and analyze to help determine the cause.

  • 1.3 Contribute to the knowledge about a customer to help with future support interactions.

  • 1.4 Promptly resolve issues and questions meeting SLA requirements.

  • 1.5 Confirm that technical workarounds and resolutions are satisfactory before asking the customer to confirm themselves.

  • 1.6 Produce reports of customer support and system usage as required.

  • 1.7 Act as the first point of escalation for the offshore team

  • 1.8 Assist the offshore team to answer their questions related to the system, support processes and general best practices

# Product Knowledge

  • 2.1 Proactively advance product knowledge to an expert level including self-education and experimentation with new product features, common tasks, and problems, and how these are applied or used within different solution settings.

  • 2.2 Assist with maintaining Noggin’s knowledge base by contributing content and insights into common questions, and opportunities for improvement.

  • 2.3 Share product feature requests and functionality gaps with internal teams to assist in defining the product roadmap and developing highly requested features.

# Internal Collaboration & Support

  • 3.1 Be the customer advocate within Noggin and take responsibility for driving issue resolution and a shared understanding of the customer perspective.

  • 3.2 Coordinate and collaborate with Noggin staff (DevOps, engineering etc.) to ensure SLA requirements are understood and met, and to help achieve the best solution.

  • 3.3 Investigate issues, document your findings, and attempt to find a resolution before escalating to other teams.

  • 3.4 Add value to internally escalated support tickets to include replication steps, links to relevant locations, and a conversion from the Customer’s terminology into Noggin terminology.


Basic Requirements

Qualifications & Experiences

The pre-requisite qualifications and experiences necessary for success in this job are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business / commerce / information technology / computer

  • science, or equivalent qualifications or experience

  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience in support services and analysis

  • Experience in providing support to non-technical users of software

  • Experience in software requirements or problem analysis

  • Experience with modern service management practices and systems

Technical Capabilities

  • Technically adept with support tools, including communication and support desk software (ticketing, self-service options, and customer support features).

  • Deep product knowledge, including how it works, how to resolve common problems, how to configure it and how customers in different solution settings use it.

Language Requirements

  • Complete fluency in English language, both written and spoken is required.

None

Yes

raw.title: Senior Platform Engineer, Voice Infrastructure
raw.excerpt: Who We AreAt Conquer, we help go-to-market teams connect more meaningfully, act more effectively, and grow more predictably.
raw.description:
Who We Are

At Conquer, we help go-to-market teams connect more meaningfully, act more effectively, and grow more predictably. As a leader in intelligent revenue engagement, we empower our customers to orchestrate the right message at the right time across every channel.

We believe bold ideas, authentic collaboration, and a growth mindset are essential to conquering your day and your goals. If that excites you, we would love to meet you.

Why This Role Matters

Real-time communication sits at the heart of the Conquer platform. As our Senior Platform Engineer, Voice Infrastructure, you will own and evolve the systems that power how sales teams connect with customers through calling, routing, and intelligent workflows.

Voice at Conquer is more than communications infrastructure. It is foundational to how we understand customer interactions and increasingly how we deliver real-time, intelligent experiences across our platform.

This is not a traditional telecom operations or high-level architecture role. We are looking for an engineer who combines deep telephony expertise with strong software and platform engineering skills. You should be equally comfortable designing how the platform should evolve and getting into the code, FreeSWITCH, SIP routing layer, containers, and production infrastructure to build it.

Your work will directly impact call quality and reliability today while helping build the voice foundation for the next generation of Conquer's platform.

What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and scale Conquer’s telephony infrastructure and the software services that support it

  • Work directly within FreeSWITCH, including call logic, dialplans, ESL integrations, and complex production troubleshooting

  • Build and evolve OpenSIPS routing logic and signaling infrastructure

  • Own integrations with domestic and international SIP trunking providers

  • Write, review, debug, and maintain production backend and platform code

  • Work directly in production environments, troubleshooting complex issues across SIP signaling, RTP/media paths, carriers, networking, and application services

  • Improve observability across the voice stack, including SIP, RTP, and media paths

  • Develop and evolve call routing, dialing workflows, and real-time communication services

  • Build, deploy, and operate containerized voice and platform workloads using Docker and Kubernetes

  • Partner closely with Engineering and Product leadership to shape the longer-term architecture and technical roadmap for Conquer's voice platform

  • Help ensure the voice platform can support emerging real-time intelligence, automation, and AI-driven experiences

  • Document systems and create tooling and runbooks that improve team understanding and operational readiness

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of software, platform, or infrastructure engineering experience, including significant hands-on experience with production telephony systems

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with FreeSWITCH, including dialplans, call logic, ESL, and complex production troubleshooting

  • Strong hands-on experience with OpenSIPS or comparable SIP proxy technology, including personally building or modifying routing logic

  • Deep understanding of SIP and RTP and experience diagnosing signaling, media-path, NAT, codec, and call-quality issues using packet captures and SIP traces

  • Experience owning real-time communication systems in production environments

  • Strong software engineering skills and demonstrated experience designing, writing, reviewing, and debugging production backend or platform code

  • Experience with Go, Python, or another backend/systems programming language

  • Hands-on experience building, deploying, troubleshooting, and operating containerized production workloads using Docker and Kubernetes

  • Experience designing reliable, scalable systems with a focus on performance, resilience, and uptime

  • Strong experience with observability, monitoring, and production incident response

  • Ability to move comfortably between high-level architecture and hands-on implementation

  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly across Engineering, Product, and other teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with WebRTC end-to-end, including ICE, STUN, TURN, and DTLS-SRTP

  • Background with browser-based softphones or CRM-embedded calling experiences

  • Experience building or operating low-latency, real-time media systems

  • Experience with streaming audio, speech-to-text, transcription, or real-time inference pipelines

  • Experience building infrastructure that supports AI-driven voice or agentic experiences

  • Experience with real-time media observability and monitoring

  • Experience with VoIPmonitor, Homer, or similar voice observability tooling

  • Experience with call recording and transcription

  • Exposure to telephony-related compliance considerations such as TCPA, STIR/SHAKEN, call recording laws, and consent management

What Success Looks Like

  • You have improved call reliability, performance, and uptime across the platform

  • You have closed gaps in observability and improved visibility into real-time signaling and media performance

  • You are contributing production code and platform improvements, not simply recommending them

  • Engineering and Product teams rely on you as the subject matter expert for telephony and real-time communications

  • You proactively identify and resolve issues before they impact customers

  • You help define and execute a clear, forward-looking architecture and technical strategy for Conquer's voice platform

  • You have strengthened the voice foundation needed to support new real-time, intelligent, and AI-enabled product experiences

  • You build systems with scalability, resilience, security, and compliance in mind

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation. U.S.-based candidates can expect a range of $180,000 to $225,000 depending on experience and geography. Compensation for international candidates will be aligned with local market benchmarks.

  • Equity Opportunities so we all share in Conquer’s growth

  • Remote-First Flexibility so you can work where you thrive

  • Comprehensive Benefits for US candidates including health, dental, vision, and 401(k) with company match

  • A growth-focused culture with learning budgets, mentorship, and internal mobility

  • Generous PTO

Our Commitment to Diversity

We believe diverse teams win. At Conquer, we are building a culture where everyone can show up as their full self, contribute meaningfully, and grow beyond their comfort zone. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

While we welcome and will consider highly qualified candidates based outside of the United States, we are not able to provide visa sponsorship at this time. Applicants must have current authorization to work in their country of residence without employer sponsorship.

raw.description:
ABOUT ADOBE

Adobe Population Health (APH) is a women-owned health solutions company founded in 2018 with a mission of positively impacting the lives we touch. Headquartered in Phoenix, AZ, with satellite locations across multiple states, APH fosters a culture rooted in inclusivity, human kindness, and high-quality care.

Recognized by Inc. 5000 as one of America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies and honored for a fifth consecutive year as a“Best Place to Work” by the Phoenix Business Journal, APH continues to expand its reach and impact.

APH partners with health plans, providers, hospitals, and families to deliver tailored programs including case management, in-home and in-clinic wellness assessments, preventative care, transitional care, and social services. As one of the nation’s few fully integrated healthcare organizations, APH delivers comprehensive, coordinated medical and social support through a wide range of specialized service lines.

With continued growth on the horizon, APH is seeking mission-driven individuals who are passionate about improving health outcomes and supporting those in need.

POSITION PURPOSE

The Director, Adobe Provider Group (APG) Program is a strategic and operational leader responsible for overseeing field-based teams, including Nurse Practitioners (NP), Registered Nurses (RNs), Care Navigators and LVN Community Care Coordinators, and ensuring the delivery of integrated, whole-person care. This NP-licensed leader will be responsible for program development, clinical quality, team supervision, regulatory compliance, HIPAA compliance, and direct oversight of palliative care initiatives for medically complex and socially vulnerable populations. The Director ensures high-quality, equitable, and cost-effective care delivery in alignment with Adobe’s mission and contractual obligations.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership, Hiring & Supervision

  • Directly supervise a multidisciplinary team including, NPs, RNs, Care Navigators and LVNs.
  • Hire, onboard, train, and mentor new staff; manage performance, implement corrective actions, and terminate when appropriate.
  • Foster a culture of clinical excellence, compassion, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Lead regular team meetings, one-on-one check-ins, and performance evaluations.
  • Continually improve clinical care and oversight provided by the clinical team.

Program & Operational Management

  • Oversee the daily operations of APG’s field-based care programs across medical, behavioral, and social domains.
  • Ensure all contractual Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are consistently met or exceeded.
  • Implement performance dashboards and quality assurance protocols to monitor productivity, compliance, and outcomes.
  • Lead the design and administration of a palliative care program for members with advanced or end-of-life conditions.
  • Partner with leadership to align program goals, allocate resources, and adapt to evolving population health needs.

Strategic & Clinical Partnerships

  • Partner with the Senior Leadership to guide clinical quality and performance.
  • Work closely with Senior Leadership to develop and execute strategies aimed at achieving performance, quality, and outcome targets.

raw.excerpt: About the rolePlan Left is hiring a Video Editor to turn our long-form content (webinars, podcasts, interviews and talks) into short, scroll-stopping clips that grow our B2B audience.
raw.description:
About the role

Plan Left is hiring a Video Editor to turn our long-form content (webinars, podcasts, interviews and talks) into short, scroll-stopping clips that grow our B2B audience. You'll work closely with the marketing team, owning the edit from raw recording to platform-ready video for LinkedIn, YouTube and other channels.

This is a marketing role as much as an editing role: we want someone who knows what makes a business audience stop, watch and click.

What you'll do

  • Review webinars, podcasts and recorded talks (30–90 minutes) and pull the strongest moments into short clips (15–90 seconds)
  • Produce 15–25 short-form videos per week from each long-form piece, plus highlight reels and trailers
  • Write or refine hooks, on-screen text, captions and titles that land with business buyers
  • Format and optimize every clip for its platform: LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, Instagram, TikTok and paid ads
  • Add motion graphics, subtitles, b-roll, branded intros and lower thirds consistent with our brand guidelines
  • Partner with marketing to align clips with campaigns, product launches and demand-gen goals
  • Track clip performance (views, watch time, engagement, clicks) and use it to improve the next batch
  • Keep an organized library of source files, templates and finished assets

The creative side

We don't want clips that look like a webinar recording with captions slapped on. We want short-form content with a point of view that feels native to each platform and still fits a credible B2B brand.

You'll get creative ownership to:

  • Find the story. Spot the surprising stat, the contrarian opinion or the honest moment in an hour of talk, then build a clip with a clear beginning, tension and payoff
  • Hook in the first 2 seconds. Try cold opens, pattern interrupts, bold text and smart reordering so viewers keep watching
  • Bring talking heads to life. Use punch-ins, jump cuts, b-roll, kinetic typography, emoji and icon callouts, split screens and simple animations to keep the energy up
  • Use sound well. Pick music, sound effects and pacing that match the mood, from punchy and fast to calm and authoritative
  • Develop a visual style. Help shape and evolve recognizable templates, caption styles, color treatments and series formats for our channels
  • Pitch new formats. Suggest series, recurring segments, carousel-to-video ideas and trend-based edits that suit a B2B audience
  • Experiment and learn. Test different hooks, lengths, aspect ratios and styles, and double down on what works

We'd love to see you add your own taste to the work. Bring ideas, not just edits.

What we're looking for

Listed in order of priority.

  1. Fluent English. Excellent written and spoken English. You'll write captions, hooks and on-screen copy, and you need to catch the nuance in what speakers say to find the best moments.
  2. Marketing experience. 2+ years editing video for a marketing team or agency. You understand hooks, audience retention, calls to action and how content supports a funnel.
  3. Long-form to short-form repurposing. A proven track record of turning webinars, podcasts or interviews into short clips. Your portfolio should show both the source and the clips you cut from it.
  4. B2B marketing content. Experience editing for B2B brands such as SaaS, professional services or tech. You know how to make expert conversations engaging for decision-makers without losing credibility.
Salary: $12 – $16 / hour

Job Summary:

  • Provide insights to improve our knowledge articles.
  • Interactions with customers are entered into Salesforce.

Qualifications:

  • Axalta solvent and waterborne experience.
  • Able to diagnose paint application concerns, identify probable failure causes, and explain corrective actions in a way that is practical for working technicians.

  • Strong technical aptitude and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve customer issues.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey technical and color information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on quality assurance and continuous improvement.

As an expert, you will create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test an AI model’s ability to design, deploy, troubleshoot, secure, scale, and recover production-grade cloud infrastructure. You will develop realistic scenarios involving distributed systems, networking, IAM, queues, durable storage, observability, rolling deployments, and disaster recovery, then build reproducible environments, deterministic validation tests, golden reference solutions, and intentionally defective variants.

  • JAVA

Scope of Work

  • Develop deterministic validation tests and golden reference solutions to ensure the reliability and accuracy of reinforcement learning environments.

About ImpactAssets Services
ImpactAssets is the leading impact investing partner for individuals, families and philanthropists seeking to effect real change for people and planet. Bold yet pragmatic in our approach, ImpactAssets’ creativity and investment expertise ignites a deeply personal impact investing journey for clients - while we manage the complexities. Founded in 2010, ImpactAssets’ mission is to increase flows of capital to impact investing. Together, with our clients, we are catalyzing investment capital into mission driven business models solving the worlds’ biggest challenges.
The result? A fast growing, dynamic organization with more than $5 billion in assets under management and an activated community of 1,900+ clients.
ImpactAssets Services is an affiliate of ImpactAssets. Impact Assets also is the parent of ImpactAssets Capital Partners, PB LCC. Together, we have a combined powerhouse of talent, expertise, and service to support a high level of growth and vision.
*ImpactAssets Services is not a 501(c)(3) organization.

The Opportunity
The Senior Associate, Sales Operations is the engine behind our client acquisition growth, building and running the infrastructure that lets our Client Solutions team perform at its best. You will support the systems, data analytics, CRM workflows, and training frameworks that scale our reach across family offices, foundations, corporations, and ultra-high net worth individuals. This is a highly collaborative, high-visibility role for someone who is energized by building the operational backbone that supercharges a growing Client Solutions team.
The Senior Associate, Sales Operations role is a full time, remote position and can work from anywhere in the US with work hours aligning with Eastern Standard Time (with some flexibility). As a remote, people-first culture, we care deeply about our team members’ connections to one another and as such, travel 2-3 times per year to company events will be required.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Sales Support & Execution
  • Serve as the first point of contact for inbound leads, triaging and routing opportunities so every prospect gets a fast, strong start, and coordinating on prospect opportunities and other team projects.
  • Build and maintain pipeline dashboards and standardized reporting, turning CRM and other data into insights that sharpen the team's focus and prioritization.
  • Build outbound target lists, research prospects, and prepare background packets that set the stage for high-impact client outreach.
  • Partner with Product and Marketing to keep the team equipped with sharp, current outreach collateral and tools that clearly showcase our value and impact, surfacing prospect and market feedback to inform the client feedback loop.
  • Partner with the Managing Director to drive the Client Solutions team’s OKRs, and help build and maintain the playbooks, standard operating procedures, and internal knowledge base that keep our best practices documented and repeatable.
  • Coordinate account-opening, DAF application tracking, and funding/transfer status through client handoff, and lead or support project-based work as needed.
Business Intelligence & Data Management
  • Own and continuously refine the CRM to power complex, relationship-driven business development, from enriching contact records and surfacing warm-intro paths to maintaining day-to-day data hygiene and record accuracy.
  • Integrate business intelligence tools and dashboards with the CRM to give the team real-time visibility into prospect touchpoints, pipeline, and asset flows.
  • Leverage AI and automation tools to streamline prospect research, meeting preparation, and reporting workflows, freeing the team to focus on high-value client engagement.
  • Collaborate across the team to improve scalability, knowledge management, and workflow design that fuels sustained client growth.
  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Investment Solutions, Client Engagement, and Client Service to streamline and accelerate the prospect-to-client transition.
  • Support cross-functional initiatives with Marketing, including shared events, content calendars, and firm visibility efforts.
  • Deliver regular pipeline and activity reporting to the Head of Client Solutions, keeping open initiatives visible and on track.
  • Any other projects as needed.

Qualifications

Experience:
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sales operations, business development support, or CRM administration within investment management, wealth advisory, private markets, philanthropy, or impact investing, and a bachelor's degree in a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience building and managing CRM systems, sales infrastructure, and reporting processes that support client acquisition among institutional or private investors, such as family offices, foundations, corporations, or ultra-high-net-worth individuals.
  • Experience managing a pipeline, tracking prospect and client interactions, and supporting multi-stakeholder philanthropic or investment decision processes.
Knowledge and Skill Requirements:
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and automation tools to enhance client acquisition effectiveness, including prospect research, market intelligence synthesis, meeting preparation, personalized outreach, pipeline management, and workflow efficiency.
  • Strong experience in CRM systems, pipeline reporting, and investor communications, with a systems-thinking approach to how data, tools, and workflows connect across the business development stack; high personal bar for data integrity, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Fluency in private markets and impact investment strategies across asset classes, with the ability to engage credibly with investment professionals and clients.
  • Familiarity with impact investing and/or values-aligned investment strategies and the ability to communicate impact value propositions credibly and compellingly.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to collaborate with cross functional teams.
  • Proactive self-starter who anticipates needs and takes ownership without waiting for direction; strong follow-through and sound judgment in ambiguous situations, with the discretion to know when to resolve issues independently versus escalate; manages timelines with urgency and accountability.
  • Collaborative mindset with a willingness to adapt and contribute across evolving team needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to design, document, and continuously improve repeatable processes, standard operating procedures, and playbooks that scale beyond a single person and hold up under handoff or audit.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Proficiency with cloud-based collaboration tools Box and Asana preferred.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to run multiple initiatives simultaneously, track dependencies and deadlines, and prioritize competing demands with minimal oversight. Experience working in a virtual environment preferred.
  • Demonstrated knowledge and interest in leveraging capital for social and environmental impact.

Benefits and Perks

  • Unique benefits, including virtual work stipend and contribution to employee’s own Donor Advised Fund
  • Competitive total compensation, including discretionary bonus, 401(k) plan, and generous time off plan
  • Base salary ranges from $88,000 - $98,000 and is highly dependent on experience and location
  • Comprehensive benefits package including full health and wellness coverage, professional development funding, and generous paid family and parental leave
  • Opportunities for training and career development in a fast-paced, progressive organization
  • Values-driven culture
ImpactAssets is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We know our organization is at its best when we include, celebrate and embrace difference. We strive to be a diverse workforce that is representative of our mission, and where all can thrive and belong. We are committed to building a team that includes and respects a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives!

raw.description:
Expression of Interest · Inquire First

We are meeting senior leaders for this planned function as we fundraise. This is an exploratory conversation, not an immediately funded salaried vacancy or a guaranteed start date. No cash salary is available today; any equity arrangement must be agreed separately. You are not being asked to begin work by expressing interest.

Use the Apply form below to introduce yourself and indicate your interest. We can discuss mutual fit, scope, funding, compensation, and timing before either side makes a commitment.

Remote · United States · Full time · Functional leadership

Turn simulation research into an experimental engine that can be inspected, reproduced, and improved. Lead the engineering function at the boundary between scientific methods and dependable software.

Why Subconscious

Subconscious is building the intelligence to run the economy. We start with a simulator for business decisions, using causal experiments on simulated markets to test products, pricing, messaging, and go-to-market choices before capital is committed. The long-term ambition is to help businesses discover unmet demand and build around what people actually need.

The function you will build

Own simulation implementation, experiment execution semantics, reproducibility standards, and the simulation engineering hiring plan. Partner with causal research on method design, evaluation on quality, and infrastructure on reliable operation.

This is a hands-on leadership role. Set the functional roadmap and propose staffing and spending priorities with the founding team. Hiring and budget commitments depend on approved resources; an established team or funded budget is not assumed.

Proposed first 90 days after joining

Use these as an initial agenda, refined with the founders against the product, customer needs, and resources at your start.

  • Trace an experiment from configuration to output and document which inputs, model versions, random states, and artifacts are required to reproduce it.

  • Establish an implementation contract for treatments, populations, execution, and result aggregation, with meaningful correctness checks.

  • Profile a representative workload and improve its largest quality, throughput, or cost constraint without silently changing the experimental question.

  • Build a research-to-production path with versioned interfaces, reviewable changes, and explicit failure handling.

How we will judge progress

Research ideas become reusable capabilities with explainable behavior. Track reproducibility, correctness under independently specified test cases, experiment throughput, and cost. Make changes in model behavior distinguishable from execution defects.

What you bring

  • You have led research engineering, simulation, scientific computing, or ML systems work and shipped robust implementations of complex methods.

  • You can reason about stochastic systems, numerical behavior, experiment design, and performance while writing and reviewing production code.

  • You can lead a technical roadmap across researchers and engineers and make explicit tradeoffs between exploration and stability.

We are looking for evidence of judgment, execution, and leadership. A particular company pedigree or previous executive title is not a substitute for that evidence.

Compensation and funding

We are actively fundraising. Only equity-based compensation is currently available; no cash salary is available today. The equity grant and its terms have not been set for this role and must be agreed before joining. Any future salary, incentive plan, benefits, hiring budget, or paid start date depends on financing and written agreement. Funding and its timing are not guaranteed.

Before deciding to join, discuss the grant structure, fully diluted ownership basis, vesting, dilution, applicable exercise terms, company funding position, and working arrangement. A company valuation is not the cash value of an equity grant.

How we work

Remote · United States. The planned role is full time; timing is to be agreed. Expect direct collaboration with the founders, work across scientific and commercial boundaries, and responsibility for doing the early work yourself. The current role does not include visa sponsorship. Confirm practical collaboration hours and any travel expectations during the initial conversation.

Start with work you already own

Describe a research method you brought into production. What could go wrong in the translation, how did you test correctness, and what did you change after real use?

Please do not share confidential employer or customer materials. Bring your questions about our product, evidence, team, finances, and the authority attached to the role. Mutual diligence matters for a decision of this size.

raw.description:
About Future Group
Future Group is not your traditional financial services company – we're a collective of super funds and services committed to changing our planet now for a better tomorrow. When you join us, you’ll become part of a team united by a clear and important mission: to lead the investment movement by advocating and campaigning for a future worth retiring into.
We are looking for someone to join our purpose-led high-growth scale-up in a Senior Investment Risk Analyst position. The role exists to strengthen Future Group’s mission of shifting capital into sustainable investments by ensuring investment portfolio construction is robustly risk informed. You’ll support the Head of the Investment Risk and Analytics and wider team to implement our investment risk discipline, develop risk analytics, support portfolio construction and provide analysis that informs investment decision-making. And the best bit, you’ll get to work with some fantastic work mates! You’ll work closely with Portfolio Managers, investment and risk analysts and other teams across Future Group.
Future Group values diverse lived experience and identities, and we strongly encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander backgrounds, those with caring responsibilities, from culturally and racially marginalised groups, with disabilities, who experience ageism, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and those who face social exclusion due to their social class.

We recognise that the recruitment journey may present unique challenges for trans and gender diverse folk, and we are committed to ensuring an inclusive and accessible recruitment process for all. We will happily make any reasonable adjustments to accommodate diverse needs, so if there is anything we can do to support you at any stage of your application, please let us know. For more information about DEIB at Future Group, please contact us at

The Role As the Senior Investment Risk Analyst, you’ll help build Future Group’s investment risk capability and provide analysis that supports robust, sustainable portfolio construction. Working closely with the Head of Investment Risk and Analytics, Portfolio Managers and other analysts, you’ll:
  • Generate regular analysis and reporting across factor risk exposures, active risk and performance attribution, as well as ad hoc deep-dive risk exposure, performance and stress test analysis
  • Drive automation and scalability of the risk analytics platform, while contributing to data integrity, quantitative analysis tools, programming tools and SQL design
  • Contribute to AASB S2 reporting of sustainability risk exposures
  • Collaborate with Portfolio Managers and other analysts to support consistent risk analysis across investment strategies
  • Peer-review quantitative models and programming developed by other teams and AI, including work supporting the DAA process and listed markets portfolio construction.

You'll love this job if

  • You find superannuation opaque and frustrating, if you had the chance to revolutionise the industry to be better for people, you would
  • You’re curious, analytical and enjoy turning complex investment data into clear insights
  • You’re comfortable constructively challenging ideas, collaborating with Portfolio Managers and contributing to thoughtful investment debate
  • You love sharing your ideas and seeing what happens. At this scale-up, you're not just a small fish in a big pond. Your contributions have a direct influence on our impact and how we work
  • You like to be kept on your toes - change is inevitable here. You like to tackle new challenges, and maybe even discover talents you never knew you had.

We're looking for someone who

  • Believes in Future Group’s mission and has a passion for moving Australia’s money out of fossil-fuels and into renewable energy
  • Believes in using the power of money to build a sustainable and equitable world
  • Has 4–7 years’ relevant investment or quantitative analysis experience, excellent quantitative analytical skills, and good programming and SQL skills
  • Has achieved or is working towards a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) qualification or similar, and has experience with AI use cases for risk or quantitative analysis.
Some nice-to-haves but are not essential are:
  • Exposure to MSCI Barra or MSCI One
  • Experience with investment risk systems, portfolio construction, performance attribution or stress testing.
Don’t tick all the boxes? That’s okay, we like thinking outside the box anyway. We value skills, passion and who you are over what you’ve done or where you’ve studied. So if this job strikes a chord, we want to hear from you!

Why would you enjoy working at Future Group?

  • A purpose-driven organisation - spend your days working on making this world a better place! The more we grow, the bigger the impact we are making on climate change and inequality
  • A B Corp organisation that cares about how it behaves inside and out
  • AFR's Best Place to Work 2026! Proud winners of TWO awards: Best Medium Organisation, and our industry category of Banking, Superannuation and Financial Services (an award we also won in 2022!)
  • Flexibility to fit work into your life (not your life around our work). School drop-offs/pick-ups and lunch-time gym sessions are a thing here
  • The choice to work from home, from one of our co-working spaces, from anywhere within Australia or even from overseas (for a short period of time)
  • The potential to own a piece of the Future Group pie with our unique Employee Share Ownership Program (with some fineprint)
  • Fun company-wide events
  • Progressive, people-focused policies and benefits including Menstrual and Menopausal Leave, Public holidays swaps, Cultural Leave, Self Care Leave and Gender Affirmation Guidelines and Leave
  • We offer employee network groups for people from diverse backgrounds: SuperGenders for cisgender women, trans men and women and non-binary folks; SuperGlobal for culturally diverse folks; and SuperPride for LGBTQIA+ folks. The groups are a safe, supportive space for people to share experiences and ideas
  • An inclusive parental leave package, with 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for birthing and non-birthing parents of all genders
  • A laptop you can use to work remotely plus an allowance to make your working from home setup comfortable
  • Other perks such as access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), the ability to purchase leave, novated leasing arrangements for electric vehicles, and a few more to find out!
