raw.title: Psychological Health and Safety Lead
raw.excerpt: SWITCH BC is a collaborative organization that influences, invests in, and supports provincewide activities to improve occupational health and safety.
raw.description:
SWITCH BC is a collaborative organization that influences, invests in, and supports provincewide activities to improve occupational health and safety. Our organizational model, unique in Canada, brings together health employers, unions, physicians, the Ministry of Health, and WorkSafeBC on SWITCH BC’s Board of Directors making consensus, strategic decisions.

Our purpose is to: 

  • Promote safe and healthy workplaces throughout British Columbia’s healthcare sector.
  • Collaborate with unions, employers, and Doctors of BC to develop and pursue a provincial framework, systems and programs aimed at improving the health, safety, and wellbeing of B.C.’s health care workers. 

SWITCH BC is an inclusive organization, focused on advancing Indigenous cultural safety, anti-racism, diversity, equity, and inclusion in our policies and practices. We are helping create an environment that addresses systemic barriers, biases and inequities that exist for First Nations, Inuit and Métis peoples, racialized individuals, individuals with disabilities and complex health conditions, immigrants, 2SLGBTQIA+, and other underrepresented groups. 

Job Summary

Reporting to the Manager, Psychological Health and Safety, the Psychological Health and Safety Lead serves as SWITCH BC's technical subject matter expert in psychological health and safety, psychosocial hazard prevention, and related occupational health and safety approaches. The Lead develops, implements, evaluates, and continually improves evidence-informed provincial resources, tools, frameworks, guides, learning supports, and implementation approaches that address shared psychological health and safety priorities across British Columbia's healthcare sector.

Working collaboratively with internal teams and external partners, the Lead applies subject matter expertise, partner feedback, system input, leading practices, and continual improvement approaches to develop practical, scalable resources and supports that strengthen psychological health and safety across diverse healthcare settings.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Provides subject matter expertise and technical guidance regarding psychological health and safety, psychosocial hazards, occupational health and safety principles, safety management systems, workplace wellbeing, prevention strategies, and the National Standard of Canada for Psychological Health and Safety in the Workplace.
  2. Translates complex concepts, evidence, and technical information into accessible, practical learning resources, tools, and supports that promote understanding and application across diverse healthcare settings.
  3. Develops and continually improves evidence-informed resources, frameworks, tools, guides, learning supports, and implementation materials that address identified needs and support psychological health and safety across diverse healthcare settings.
  4. Ensures resources and supports are practical, accurate, accessible, aligned with applicable standards and leading practices, and informed by partner feedback, evaluation findings, and lessons learned.
  5. Incorporates partner feedback, evaluation findings, lessons learned, and leading practices into the continual improvement of psychological health and safety resources, tools, frameworks, and implementation supports.
  6. Prepares materials and facilitates meetings, workshops, engagement activities, partner tables, or collaborative planning processes to gather input, support shared learning, and inform psychological health and safety program initiatives.
  7. Collaborates with healthcare partners, committees, working groups, and subject matter experts to identify needs, gather input, test approaches, and inform resource and program development.
  8. Develops high-quality reports, briefing materials, presentations, guidance documents, and knowledge products that communicate complex information clearly and are suitable for senior leaders, provincial partners, committees, and diverse audiences.
  9. Applies occupational health and safety, safety management system, change management, adult learning, and continuous improvement principles to support practical and sustainable psychological health and safety approaches.
  10. Collaborates with project, evaluation, implementation, and subject matter experts to ensure psychological health and safety resources, tools, and supports are practical, scalable, and responsive to partner needs across diverse healthcare settings.
  11. Develops and supports learning, engagement, and capacity-building activities that strengthen knowledge, awareness, and application of psychological health and safety practices across the healthcare sector in line with SWITCH BC’s mandate and approved initiatives.
  12. Applies research, evaluation findings, partner input, emerging practices, and subject matter expertise to develop practical solutions, resources, recommendations, and capacity-building supports.
  13. Monitors emerging research, legislation, standards, and leading practices to identify opportunities for innovation, continuous improvement, and future resource development.
  14. Fosters a safe, just work culture, encouraging and welcoming open identification of issues, non-violent dialogue, and practices for cultural safety and inclusion.
  15. Performs other related duties as assigned.

Education, Training, and Experience

A level of education, training, and experience equivalent to a master's degree in occupational health and safety, behavioural science, human factors, organizational psychology, public health, or a related discipline plus five (5) years of recent related experience. Experience working within British Columbia's healthcare sector and familiarity with collective bargaining associations is an asset.

Skills and Abilities

  • Demonstrated knowledge of psychological health and safety principles, psychosocial hazards, workplace wellbeing, psychological safety, occupational health and safety principles, safety management systems, hazard identification, risk management, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of the National Standard of Canada for Psychological Health and Safety in the Workplace and its practical application within complex organizational environments.
  • Working knowledge of British Columbia occupational health and safety legislation, workplace standards, WorkSafeBC requirements, collective bargaining association environments, and the ability to incorporate these considerations into resource and tool development.
  • Ability to build productive relationships and work collaboratively with employers, unions, physicians, healthcare leaders, joint committees, and other partners.
  • Proficiency in full cycle product development including design, development, implementation, evaluation, and refinement of resource materials, pilot initiatives, learning supports, and capacity-building tools.
  • Highly skilled in translating findings, partner input, and leading practices into practical, evidence-informed resources, tools, frameworks, and implementation supports.
  • Ability to prepare high-quality reports, recommendations, presentations, briefing materials, and knowledge products suitable for leaders, provincial partners, committees, and diverse audiences.
  • Highly organized and able to gather, synthesize, and document partner feedback into resource development and continuous improvement activities.
  • Proficiency in change management frameworks, continuous improvement, facilitation, and/or adult learning methodologies.
  • Excellent systems and critical thinking, analytical, and problem solving skills.
  • Proven ability to facilitate discussions, engagement activities, and collaborative processes involving diverse perspectives, interests, and priorities.
  • Ability to taking complex concepts and turning them into accessible, usable learning products and supports and proven ability to communicate complex concepts into clear and practical language tailored to diverse audiences.
  • Able to navigate ambiguity and support solution-focused approaches in evolving environments.
  • Able to work independently, exercise sound judgment, prioritize workload, and manage multiple competing priorities.
  • Commitment to equity, diversity, inclusion, cultural safety, anti-racism, and humility.
  • Advanced proficiency using Microsoft Office Suite, collaboration platforms, virtual engagement technologies, and project management tools.

Compensation and Benefits

In joining SWITCH BC, we are pleased to offer you a rewarding career. In recognition of your skills and experiences, and in alignment with our core values of building safe and healthy work environments, we are pleased to offer comprehensive benefits which includes, but is not limited to:

  • Competitive salary
  • Generous extended health benefits with no waiting period, long-term disability benefits, and Municipal Pension Plan
  • Paid vacation (20 days per year - prorated in first year) and sick leave allowances
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Professional development and membership opportunities

As a key organization within the BC healthcare sector, we also encourage current health sector employees to ask about pension and benefits portability options, which may also be available. SWITCH BC is committed to be an equitable, diverse, and inclusive workforce.

We recognize that there are a variety of experiences that contribute to the overall qualifications for each role. If you feel that you could excel in this position, but do not necessarily meet the formal requirements, we still encourage you to apply.  We wish to thank all applications for their interest and effort in applying; however, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Job Type: Temporary Full-Time (2-year contract), 37.5 hours per week.

Posting type: This is a backfill position.

Salary Range:$90,770.00 - $107,789.00 (Range 8) per year depending on experience

Typical Hiring Range:$100,000.00 - $107,789.00 per year depending on experience

The starting salary for this position would be determined with consideration of the successful candidate’s relevant education and experience as well as internal equity, and would be in alignment with SWITCH BC’s compensation framework.

Please note that this is a remote worker position (must reside in BC) and only candidates who live in BC will be interviewed. Travel for occasional in-person events within BC is required.

Application instructions:

In your cover letter, please describe your experience developing psychological health and safety, occupational health and safety, or workplace wellbeing resources, tools, frameworks, or initiatives. Highlight your experience working with diverse partners and how partner input informed your work.

Closing date: October 23, 2026 at 12:00 p.m. pct

Salary: $100,000.00 - $107,789.00 per year depending on experience

raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Leads and directs team responsible for enterprise infrastructure and information technology (IT) operations. Responsible for delivering reliable, high‑performing technology services across infrastructure, data, and operational support functions. Ensures service quality and performance by monitoring operational health, analyzing trends, and maintaining alignment with established service level agreements (SLAs) and organizational expectations. Partners with business leaders and stakeholders to define, evaluate, and communicate IT performance across systems, applications, services, and project portfolios. Drives process, service, and operational improvements to enhance efficiency, reliability, and customer experience. Builds strong business relationships to set expectations, proactively identify risks, and resolve issues with appropriate priority and visibility. Provides strategic oversight, guidance, and leadership to ensure IT services meet evolving business needs and support enterprise goals.

Essential Job Duties

  • Oversees team responsible for translating business needs into IT work product and project requests; assimilates and documents business needs, project requests and benefit value documentation including high level IT requirements, compliance implications and cost/benefit analysis.
    • Partners with IT leadership and IT project managers on key initiatives to identify dependencies/issue escalation from business participants and project management; ensures transition of projects into applicable tracking systems.
    • Provides technical and process knowledge within IT across silos and business partners to support consulting, problem resolution/facilitation and effective intake and solutioning; coaches and recommended solutions for project deliverables including business requirements document (BRD).
    • Analyzes, reviews and measures information technology (IT)-related service level performance against agreed upon service level agreements (SLAs) and operating level agreements (OLAs) with service providers (internal and external).
    • Identifies opportunities to increase efficiency through continuous improvement and process optimization with consideration to budget impacts.
    • Participates in IT service development and reporting of service level agreements (SLAs) to business stakeholders; champions IT service management (ITSM) processes, provides training and support for process rollouts, monitors processes, business feedback, and effective rollout of revised processes.
    • Organizes complex IT project requests into manageable approaches, and advises on project setup/structure based on proposed scope.
    • Collaborates with corporate IT leadership on key business initiative delivery; facilitates process improvements, manages SLAs, and deploys business communications.
    • Leverages knowledge of business processes, IT technologies and processes to inform appropriate project triage; consults with the business/IT on project scope, assumptions, development progress and estimation.
    • Strategically informs standard business case development method outlined by IT project team to support evaluation and prioritization.
    • Drives down the cost of development and support while improving quality by implementing standard processes (systems development lifecycle (SDLC), architecture, project management, etc.).
    • Recognizes, identifies and documents changes to IT services and supporting processes and or opportunities for service delivery improvement; facilitates groups for problem-solving and service improvement including definition/documentation, and business workflow analysis.
    • Develops effective processes, forums and tracking mechanisms to continuously improve process through business feedback, proactive handling of business complaints and facilitation of resolution.
    • Develops and maintains a service delivery plan (SDP) for corporate functions to include business strategies/needs with corresponding IT strategies/plans, IT projects, IT performance measurements, customer satisfaction improvement plans and other items as determined by IT senior leadership.
    • Builds, manages and maintains effective business relationships with key stakeholders across business domains and multiple corporate functions to support IT service delivery.
    • Collaborates closely with business partners and service providers to negotiate and define service‑level requirements for new IT services and changes to existing services.
    • Collaborates with business and service providers to define proper metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) in evaluating service delivery quality and performance levels.
    • Generates and distributes regular reports on service performance, trends and achievement to applicable stakeholders.
    • Organizes and maintains the service level review process with the business and service providers; initiates actions required to maintain or improve service levels.
    • Represents as a change agent to implement and manage quality improvement processes in service delivery management.
    • Monitors budgets and expenses within department and demonstrates accountability for meeting financial goals.
    • Provides recommendations and input into IT-related policies, procedures and governance standards.
    • Provides IT support and coordination to functions/departments to facilitate timely issue resolution and service restoration
    • Effectively manages business escalations within the IT organization by ensuring appropriate accountability, sense of urgency, communication and follow-through to closure.
    • Develops and implements reports using repeatable processes to satisfy key business stakeholders; supports continuous improvements of established reports in production to ensure optimal performance.
    • Maintains technical skills that can be utilized to solve complex IT problems.
    • Hires, trains, mentors, and develops a high-performing team, and demonstrates accountability for team performance and achievement of department-specific goals.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 8 years of information technology (IT) and systems experience, including advanced experience with IT service level performance, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
    • At least 3 years of management/leadership experience.
    • Bachelor's degree in IT, computer science, statistics, business, health care, engineering, etc.
    • Advanced understanding of IT operations and major health care technology applications that support business functions.
    • Experience providing IT support in alignment with state Medicaid contract service level agreement (SLA) requirements.
    • Knowledge of emerging technologies required to support business needs and project execution.
    • Subject matter expertise/knowledge of managed care organization (MCO) contract compliance requirements that impact IT services or processes.
    • Knowledge of health care payer processes/industry/trends.
    • Understanding of business management, operations, and strategy.
    • Understanding of key functions, application accountabilities and services performed by each area including knowledge of PMO, architecture and service methodologies (current or developing), and ability to train the business on applicable services, processes and technologies.
    • Experience in strategic planning, project scoping and planning and background/experience in project management and use of project management tools.
    • Strong data-analysis and critical-thinking skills.
    • Experience summarizing data and creation and delivery of leadership presentations.
    • Analytical ability to identify issues, solve problems and develop/facilitate solutions; includes alternative analysis and cost/benefit analysis/project value realization.
    • Experience facilitating change management and process improvement initiatives.
    • Strong organizational and time-management skills, and excellent follow-through.
    • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally in a highly matrixed organization, and influence stakeholders on scalable solutions.
    • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
    • Proficiency with the Microsoft technology stack (including advanced Excel) and working knowledge of SQL.

Preferred Qualifications

• Six Sigma black belt.

  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
    • Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) certification.
    • Understanding of health care industry regulations and compliance requirements, including those impacting Medicaid, MCO operations, and IT service delivery.

raw.description:
Sie begleiten Hoteliers als zentraler Ansprechpartner auf ihrem Weg in eine energieeffiziente Zukunft. In Ihrer Rolle führen Sie sie durch unseren strukturierten, mehrstufigen Beratungsprozess – vom ersten Strategiegespräch bis zur finalen Planung. Dabei übersetzen Sie technische Ergebnisse in verständliche Empfehlungen und schaffen so Klarheit und Vertrauen. Mit Kommunikationsgeschick, technischem Verständnis und Organisationstalent sorgen Sie dafür, dass jedes Projekt zielgerichtet und praxisnah umgesetzt wird.

Aufgaben

  • Sie übernehmen die Leitung von Energieberatungsprojekten – vom ersten Kundenkontakt bis zur Übergabe der fertigen Planung.
  • Sie führen Vor-Ort-Begehungen durch, analysieren den baulichen und technischen Ist-Zustand und erfassen relevante Details.
  • Sie erklären Kunden klar und verständlich, welche energetischen Maßnahmen sinnvoll und wirtschaftlich sind – auf Basis der berechneten Ergebnisse.
  • Sie führen Kunden durch unseren Beratungsprozess und begleiten sie mit verkäuferischem Geschick von Stufe zu Stufe.
  • Sie präsentieren Ergebnisse strukturiert, nachvollziehbar und überzeugend – sowohl im Gespräch als auch in schriftlicher Form.

Qualifikation

Erforderlich:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung im Bereich Architektur, Bauingenieurwesen oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten – Sie können technische Inhalte verständlich und überzeugend erklären
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Kunden, idealerweise mit verkäuferischer Verantwortung im beratenden Umfeld
  • Technisches Verständnis für Gebäude, Haustechnik und energetische Zusammenhänge
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Bereitschaft zu Vor-Ort-Terminen bei Hotelkunden (deutschlandweit)

Von Vorteil:

  • Erfahrung in der Leitung von Energieberatungs- oder Bauprojekten
  • Kenntnisse im Fördermittelwesen (BEG, KfW, BAFA)
  • Erfahrung mit Energieberatersoftware wie Envisys oder vergleichbaren Tools
  • Begeisterung für Nachhaltigkeit – besonders in der Hotellerie

Benefits

  • 100 % Homeoffice mit flexibler Arbeitszeitgestaltung: Sie arbeiten vollständig remote und organisieren Ihre Arbeit eigenverantwortlich – ideal, um Beruf und Privatleben in Einklang zu bringen.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum und Verantwortung: Sie übernehmen eine Schlüsselrolle in unseren Projekten, bringen eigene Ideen ein und gestalten die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden aktiv mit.
  • Verlässliche Weiterentwicklung: Wir stellen Ihnen ein festes Weiterbildungsbudget zur Verfügung – für Seminare, Coachings oder Fachfortbildungen, die Sie beruflich und persönlich weiterbringen.
  • Erfolgsabhängige Vergütung:
    Je erfolgreicher Sie unsere Kunden durch den Beratungsprozess führen, desto
    stärker wirkt sich das auch auf Ihr Einkommen aus – Leistung zahlt sich bei uns

aus.

  • Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit in einer zukunftssicheren Branche: Sie begleiten Hotels auf dem Weg in eine nachhaltigere Zukunft – und tragen damit aktiv zur Transformation der Branche bei.
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Bei gegenseitigem Interesse entwickeln wir Ihre Rolle weiter – mit wachsender Verantwortung und spannenden Projekten.

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die nicht nur fachlich überzeugt, sondern auch Freude daran hat, komplexe Inhalte einfach zu erklären, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Projekte mit Energie und Weitblick zum Erfolg zu führen. Wenn Sie gerne kommunizieren, strukturiert denken, pragmatisch handeln und sich in anspruchsvollen Aufgaben wohlfühlen, könnte das hier genau die richtige Stelle für Sie sein.

raw.description:
CircusTrix dba

Sky Zone


Senior Social Media & Community Manager

Full-Time

Hybrid in Dallas, TX, or Remote in O&O States


Department: Brand & Demand

Reports to: VP Brand & Demand Marketing

Travel: N/A

FLSA: Exempt


ABOUT US:

CircusTrix is the leading indoor active entertainment company in the U.S., operating and franchising over 270 parks with more than 500,000 members and 60+ attractions. We create fun, high-energy experiences for all ages while hosting thousands of memorable birthdays, team events, and school parties each year. Recognized by Franchise Times and Entrepreneur, our success is driven by a culture of curiosity, creativity, and growth. At Sky Zone, we empower builders, problem-solvers, and lifelong learners to explore bold ideas, challenge assumptions, and make a meaningful impact—creating a place where imagination thrives and people are inspired to grow.


JOB SUMMARY:

The Sr.Social Media & Community Manager will serve as the day-to-day owner of Sky Zone's social presence, bringing our brand to life through engaging content, authentic community interaction, and seamless execution across our owned social channels.


Working closely with the Vice President of Brand & Demand Marketing and Sky Zone's social agency, this role will help execute the social strategy by managing publishing, fostering community engagement, coordinating creator and influencer activations, and ensuring content is delivered consistently across channels. As the internal champion for social, this individual will play a critical role in connecting marketing campaigns, park experiences, and customer conversations to build brand affinity and support demand generation.


The ideal candidate is passionate about social media, understands platform culture, enjoys engaging with online communities, and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.


RESPONSIBILITIES:


Social Media Strategy & Planning

  • Partner with Brand & Demand leadership and agency partners to develop and evolve Sky Zone’s social strategy in alignment with broader brand, marketing, and business objectives
  • Help shape annual and seasonal social plans, including channel roles, audience priorities, content strategy, and key opportunities for the brand
  • Translate brand strategy, campaign priorities, and business objectives into clear social priorities and strategic direction
  • Bring forward proactive recommendations on emerging platforms, evolving consumer behaviors, and opportunities to strengthen Sky Zone’s social presence and relevance

Content Publishing & Channel Management

  • Manage the day-to-day publishing across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging social platforms
  • Execute the social content calendar in partnership with Sky Zone's social agency and internal marketing team
  • Coordinate publishing schedules, approvals, and asset management
  • Ensure content is accurate, on-brand, and optimized for each platform
  • Support the execution of seasonal campaigns, promotions, partnerships, and brand initiatives across social channels

Community Management

  • Serve as the voice of Sky Zone across owned social channels by monitoring and engaging with comments, direct messages, tags, and brand mentions
  • Foster authentic conversations and build meaningful relationships with our online community
  • Identify opportunities to encourage user-generated content and guest participation
  • Escalate customer service, operational, or reputational issues to the appropriate internal teams
  • Help cultivate an engaging, positive brand experience across all social touchpoints

Content Creation

  • Capture engaging photo and video content that brings the Sky Zone experience to life across social platforms
  • Create and edit social-first content, including Reels, TikToks, Stories, and short-form videos using mobile-first editing tools
  • Produce timely, platform-native content that supports campaigns, seasonal promotions, partnerships, and cultural moments
  • Partner with the social agency to supplement produced content with authentic, in-the-moment storytelling
  • Assist with on-site content capture during events, park visits, creator activations, and brand experiences

Agency & Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day partner to Sky Zone's social agency
  • Collaborate on content planning, campaign execution, creator activations, and reporting
  • Coordinate with Brand, Digital, PR, Operations, Partnerships, and Creative teams to ensure integrated execution
  • Partner with company-owned parks to support local content opportunities and community engagement

Content Production & Coordination

  • Coordinate content requests, approvals, and production timelines
  • Work with creators, photographers, videographers, agency partners, and internal teams to facilitate content creation
  • Identify opportunities to capture authentic in-park moments that showcase the Sky Zone experience
  • Maintain and organize the social content library to support ongoing publishing needs

Creator & Influencer Support

  • Coordinate creator visits, influencer activations, and content capture
  • Support creator communications, scheduling, logistics, approvals, and deliverables
  • Partner with the social agency on creator identification, campaign execution, and content usage
  • Help identify opportunities for user-generated content and creator storytelling

Social Listening & Consumer Insights

  • Monitor social conversations, audience sentiment, and emerging cultural trends
  • Surface actionable consumer insights, recurring questions, and content opportunities to the marketing team
  • Identify opportunities for Sky Zone to authentically participate in relevant social conversations
  • Share ongoing recommendations to improve engagement, content performance, and community growth

Performance & Reporting

  • Monitor channel performance and key social metrics
  • Own preparing recurring reports on audience growth, engagement, and content performance
  • Provide insights and recommendations based on platform trends and audience behavior
  • Support the development of reporting frameworks that measure social's contribution to brand awareness, community engagement, and demand generation

QUALIFICATIONS:


  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 6-8 years of experience managing social media for a consumer, retail, entertainment, hospitality, lifestyle, or franchise brand
  • Deep understanding of Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging social platforms
  • Experience with community management and social publishing tools such as Social, Sprout Social, etc.
  • Experience creating and editing short-form social content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong understanding of mobile content creation, including composition, lighting, video editing, caption writing, and platform best practices
  • Comfortable shooting and editing content using an iPhone or similar mobile device
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong understanding of platform trends, short-form video, creator culture, and social best practices
  • Experience working collaboratively with agencies and cross-functional teams
  • Experience supporting influencer or creator marketing programs·
  • Experience with Soci, Sprout Social, Sprinklr, Later, Hootsuite, or similar social management platforms
  • Experience working in entertainment, hospitality, retail, franchise, or consumer brands·
  • Passion for creating engaging content and building online communities

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This position requires the ability to remain stationery, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Compensation range is $105,000-$130,000 + bonus opportunity, based on qualifications, experience, and performance. Full-time employees at CircusTrix enjoy a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage along with a 401k plan with company matching. Eligibility for 401k is based on age and tenure requirements.


Application deadline: November 2, 2026

While we anticipate the application window will close on this date, Sky Zone reviews applications on a rolling basis and will continue to consider candidates until the position is filled. As a result, the posting may remain up beyond the stated deadline, but will not be removed before this date.

raw.description:
About the Company

Anza is a revolutionary platform that empowers solar and energy storage equipment buyers and developers to use advanced data and technology to compare more products and make confident decisions faster. The result is increased profit, reduced risk, and massive time-saving. With Anza, clients can focus on higher-value work without chasing down data or using manual tools. They can access real-time pricing and extensive technical, trade risk, counterparty, and contract term data from 95% of the U.S. module supply. Anza’s Effective $/Watt analytics enable users to evaluate modules based on production and installation costs. It provides energy storage lifecycle cost analytics across AC and DC battery systems. Anza’s vision is to help every utility-scale and DG buyer and developer make optimal design and procurement decisions.

Anza was born from internal tools at Borrego that maximized the financial value of its own projects. In 2021, Anza launched as a standalone application for broader industry use, furthering the company’s mission of accelerating the deployment of renewable energy.

At Anza, we don’t accept the status quo. We are driven by a culture of teamwork, a growth mindset and continuous improvement as we pursue our mission. Since its inception, we have surpassed our growth goals and are looking forward to continuing to build a great team and platform. We believe in having an ownership company culture, so we have implemented an attractive equity program. Join us!

Summary of Position

Anza is seeking a mid-level Content Writer to join our growing renewable energy software and advisory service company. This person will support sales growth and platform adoption through research-driven, compelling content. This role blends strong writing skills with analysis and collaboration across technical, data, and commercial teams.

The Content Writer will produce high-quality marketing, sales, and customer-facing content. They will help translate complex data and technical concepts into clear, insightful pieces.

This position reports to the Senior Director of Marketing and works collaboratively with the rest of the marketing team, as well as internal sourcing, engineering, policy, and other subject matter experts. It requires an excellent writer and communicator who is comfortable with the following:

  • Extracting information from internal subject matter experts (SMEs), external supplier contacts, and external data sources;
  • Synthesizing complex topics and data into compelling, insightful content;
  • Maintaining effective and efficient content writing and feedback processes;
  • Building & maintaining excellent relationships;
  • Communicating proactively and effectively; and
  • Generating new ideas and continuously improving.

We seek a candidate with experience in B2B marketing writing, covering technical topics, and conducting SME interviews, ideally in the renewable energy industry.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation:

  • Write ongoing supplier updates, supplier page content, and technology trend analysis for platform users
  • Write blogs, case studies, and quarterly reports to support marketing and sales goals
  • Author insight articles, whitepapers, and other content for Anza’s platform users
  • Produce slide decks for customer reports and marketing webinars

Research, Analysis & SME Collaboration:

  • Develop strong working relationships with Anza suppliers and internal data and subject matter experts to develop content
  • Sit in on relevant supplier and internal cross-functional meetings to identify insights and content opportunities
  • Develop a strong understanding of Anza’s products, services, competitors, value proposition, and target audiences

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Collaborate with strategic sourcing and engineering teams to stay informed on supplier data and updates, market and technology changes, and platform insights
  • Partner with the product marketing team to obtain data analysis, platform visuals, and customer insights for content writing
  • Partner with the marketing designer to identify and develop visuals that enhance written content
  • Partner with marketing team members for SEO analysis and to ensure alignment across campaign promotions and assets

Performance & Optimization:

  • Review content performance with marketing and product teams
  • Identify under-performing content and provide actionable recommendations to improve impact and engagement

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 3-5 years of B2B writing experience for a technical, business audience

Nice to Have

2+ years of solar or energy storage industry experience

Core Competencies

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to synthesize and simplify complex technical or data-heavy topics
  • Experience interviewing SMEs and conducting independent research
  • Strong collaboration and interpersonal skills; comfortable working cross-functionally, internally and externally, and with leadership
  • Excellent listening skills and empathy
  • Ability to receive and apply feedback effectively
  • Strong organizational and project management skills
  • Analytical mindset with comfort in interpreting data
  • Experience creating slide content for reports or webinars
  • Ability to quickly learn new industries, technologies, terminology, and concepts
  • A track record of generating original content ideas
  • Comfortable with using AI thoughtfully for research or early drafts

Application Requirements

Anza will reach out to you directly for the following:

  • 2 relevant writing samples (e.g., blogs, case studies, bylines, white papers)
  • 1 relevant slide presentation

Compensation & Benefits

Anza uses an internally equitable and externally competitive total cash approach to compensation. Our benefits package includes medical, dental, vision, health, life, and disability insurance; a comprehensive wellness program; 401(k) plan with company match and immediate vesting; continuing education and professional development assistance; and self-managed flexible work schedules and time-off policies.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Anza provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetics, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by state, federal and local laws. In addition to federal law requirements, Anza complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. EEO M/F/D/V.

A Note to Third-Party Recruiters

Anza's team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. Anza does not accept unsolicited resumes from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. Resumes are only accepted from third-party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies if a signed agreement is in place AND if external recruiting assistance is authorized by the Anza team for a specific position. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Anza. Anza is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

raw.description:
Position Title: FP&A Analyst (Healthcare)

Location: Remote

Travel Required: Less than 5%

Who we are:

US Health Partners (“USHP”) seeks to redefine high-quality specialty care in the United States and establish a high-performing, technology-enabled care delivery platform. USHP is partnering with the country's leading physicians to build a comprehensive, out-patient focused specialty care network targeting the nation's cardiovascular concerns. Our physician-led organization is passionate about supporting exceptional care and enriching the lives of patients across the United States. We envision the opportunity to create a scaled, cutting-edge, technology-enabled healthcare services platform that leverages a value-based delivery model.

Position Summary:

The FP&A Analyst is an experienced contributor to the finance team, playing a key role in the company's budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting processes. This role independently builds and maintains financial models, monitors performance against budget, and delivers polished reporting and analysis that inform leadership decision-making. This is a strong opportunity for an experienced finance professional to deepen their FP&A expertise and take on greater ownership within a growing, physician-led healthcare organization.

Responsibilities may include:

Budgeting and Forecasting:

  • Lead the preparation of components of the annual budget and periodic financial forecasts, working directly with department and business unit leaders.
  • Consolidate and validate inputs from cross-functional departments, ensuring accuracy and alignment with corporate goals.
  • Track actual performance against budget and forecast, identify variances, and develop clear explanations and recommendations for leadership.

Financial Reporting and Analysis:

  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements.
  • Independently conduct financial analysis to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement, and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • Build and maintain supporting schedules, dashboards, and executive-ready summaries for leadership review.
  • Prepare revenue recognition reports as part of the close process, ensuring accurate accruals, cutoffs, and reconciliations across all practices.

Business Partnering:

  • Serve as a day-to-day finance partner to assigned business units, providing financial insights and guidance to support decision-making.
  • Proactively respond to data requests from business units and anticipate follow-on questions from leadership.
  • Lead scenario analysis and ad hoc financial calculations to support business decisions and investment discussions.

Process Improvement:

  • Identify and lead opportunities to streamline financial models, reports, and recurring processes.
  • Maintain data integrity and consistency across financial systems and reporting tools, and recommend improvements where gaps are identified.
  • Document and continuously improve FP&A processes and procedures, and help train junior team members on best practices.

Ad-hoc Analysis:

  • Lead ad-hoc financial analysis and reporting as requested by the FP&A team or senior management.
  • Provide analytical support for special projects, business initiatives, and cross-functional strategic efforts as needed.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

Experience:

  • 3–5 years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, accounting, or a related role; healthcare or multi-site company experience is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of financial modeling, forecasting, and budgeting techniques, with demonstrated ability to work independently.
  • Strong proficiency with Excel; experience with financial planning tools or ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) is a plus.

Competencies:

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize large, complex data sets into clear, actionable insights.
  • Confident written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present financial information to non-financial stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy and the ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to build effective working relationships across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience with business intelligence (BI) tools and data visualization software (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) is a plus.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, use hands and fingers to handle or feel, as well as talk and hear. Macy’s is more than just a store. We’re a story. One that’s captured the hearts and minds of America for more than 160 years. What You Will Do

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Product Engineer to join our dream team and help us release the best web products for our innovative, industry-leading products.

If you're a highly motivated person with a real interest in tech, a passion for building cutting-edge products, and opinions about what gets built and not only how it gets built, we've got the perfect job for you!

A little bit about us

Leadtech has fostered and developed innovative digital businesses across various industries since 2009. We've now got a team of over 800 dedicated employees working around the world, especially in Spain. We're really proud to have more than 23 nationalities working together, and we love that millions of users around the globe enjoy our products and services every month. #LifeAtLeadtech

Key responsibilities:

  • Contribute as a main developer to one of our web projects, owning the stack end to end.

  • Work as a real counterpart to the Product team: define, shape and estimate new features and products, contributing to what we build and not only how.

  • Translate business and monetization goals into technical decisions, and explain the trade-offs behind them.

  • Contribute and implement software development best practices (such as CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews) with the Engineering Team.

  • Define and track a set of metrics to evaluate the health of the project: monitoring performance, stability, and code quality.

  • Enhancing the importance of team unity so that everyone feels part of the project and the company.

Your team

  • We’re team-first.If you believe in the power of collaboration and that the team’s success is your success, then you’re one of us!

  • Fun is fundamental. We believe in forming strong bonds in and outside the office. That’s why we have a team-building budget and organize activities to enjoy ourselves.

  • Positivity wins the day. Bring a positive attitude and communicate openly. Self-awareness and an openness to learn are always a plus.

Required skills:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field — or equivalent demonstrable experience.

  • You have solid previous experience (more than 5 years) developing robust and scalable frontend applications, backend applications, and APIs.

  • Strong knowledge of Software Engineering design patterns.

  • You have product and design instinct: you have opinions about the interface, you push back on specs when something doesn't make sense, and you care about aesthetics and interaction quality beyond whether the feature works.

  • You understand the business: conversion, churn, retention and margin, and how technical decisions move them. You can frame a trade-off in business terms and defend it.

  • You have demonstrable experience working with React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript in building web and backend applications.

    • Knowledge of other web and backend development technologies is highly valued.

    • You know web design patterns and how to adapt them optimally to mobile. Most of our users reach our products through a mobile browser, so you design for small screens and touch interaction from the start, rather than scaling down a desktop layout.

  • You use AI in your development processes, multiplying your productivity without losing control.

    • You can work through an unfamiliar codebase, explain what it does, and find the bug when the AI's answer is wrong.

  • You are familiar with and have practical experience with Google Cloud Platform and its relevant services for backend development (e.g., Compute Engine, Cloud Functions, Cloud Firestore, BigQuery, etc.).

  • You possess knowledge and experience working with both relational (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and non-relational databases (e.g., Cloud Firestore, MongoDB).

  • Data warehousing solutions like DataBricks or BigQuery are highly valued.

  • You master the definition and implementation of software development best practices, ensuring code quality and maintainability.

  • You feel comfortable and enjoy working in agile and dynamic environments, adapting to changes and actively contributing to planning.

  • You possess excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, to interact effectively with the technical team and other stakeholders.

Benefits

WHY LEADTECH

  • Diversified app portfolio with millions of active users in a high-growth non-gaming vertical.

  • Mature data infrastructure: BigQuery, Looker, AppsFlyer, and a proprietary analytics stack for fast decision-making.

  • Experimentation culture: real autonomy to propose and ship changes in production.

  • International team, dynamic environment, and the opportunity for direct P&L impact.

  • Competitive compensation package + benefits (flexible hours, health insurance, training).

Growth and career development

  • At Leadtech, we prioritize your growth. Enjoy a flexible career path with personalized internal training and an annual budget for external learning opportunities.

Work-Life balance

  • Benefit from a flexible schedule with flextime and the option of working full remote or from our Barcelona office. Enjoy free Friday afternoons with a 7-hour workday, plus a 35-hour workweek in July and August so you can savor summer!

Comprehensive benefits

  • Competitive salary, full-time permanent contract, and top-tier private health insurance (including dental and psychological services).

  • 25 days of vacation plus your birthday off, with flexible vacation options—no blackout days!

Unique Perks

  • If you wish to come, in our office in Barcelona you’ll find it complete with free coffee, fresh fruit, snacks, a game room, and a rooftop terrace with stunning Mediterranean views.

  • Additional benefits include ticket restaurant and nursery vouchers, paid directly from your gross salary.

  • Join us in an environment where you’re free to innovate, learn, and grow alongside passionate professionals. At Leadtech, you’ll tackle exciting challenges and be part of a vibrant team dedicated to delivering exceptional user experiences

Sounds good? Apply now! We’re looking forward to getting to know you.

Leadtech is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer, which means we encourage applications from people with different backgrounds, interests, and personal circumstances. Our team welcomes applicants regardless of their race, gender, age, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expressión and/or disabilities. All we need is your high energy, skills, and willingness to be a part of a great project!

Location

You'll have the flexibility to choose whether you'd like to come to the office every day, from time to time, or work fully remote. We want you to find the best combination for you.

If you prefer to be surrounded with amazing people, our exceptional office is in Barcelona’s Blue Building, located right on the city's seafront. Besides our stunning views, you’ll enjoy our office perks such as free fruit, snacks, and coffee and you’ll also be able to take part in our Mario Kart and table tennis competitions.

Our team is small, fast-moving, and AI-augmented — every member has an outsized impact on what we ship and how our users feel.

You will be the subject-matter expert ensuring everything Comfrt puts in front of users is grounded in real wellness science and genuinely helps people. You will shape the content strategy, design the wellness programs and challenges, and work with the team to make sure our gamification drives healthy outcomes, not just engagement metrics. This role blends content creation and coordination, program design, and domain expertise into one high-impact position.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, curate and collaborate on evidence-based wellness content: guided programs, daily challenges, educational tips, and motivational prompts.
  • Design the wellness framework that powers Comfrt’s gamification — ensuring challenges, milestones, and rewards map to meaningful health outcomes.
  • Collaborate with the designer and developer to integrate content seamlessly into the app experience.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in wellness, health coaching, health education, or a related field.
  • Strong content creation skills — you can write clear, engaging copy that motivates without being condescending.
  • Familiarity with behavioral science, habit formation frameworks (e.g., Fogg Behavior Model, habit loops), or health behavior change models.
  • Ability to translate complex health and wellness concepts into simple, actionable guidance for a general audience.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with product, design, or engineering teams.
  • A critical eye for wellness misinformation — you know the difference between evidence-based guidance and trends.

About First Due

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

Job Title: Cloud Security Software Engineer

Location: Remote - US Only
Country: United States
Department: Security
Reports To: VP of Cybersecurity
Position Type: Full-Time
Salary: $115,000

Job Summary:

We are looking for a foundational, high-performing builder, likely a recent graduate, with raw engineering talent, a relentless drive to learn, and a highly developed understanding of agentic AI frameworks. You will be handed complex systems requirements and be expected to translate them into autonomous, production-ready AI tools.

Key Responsibilities:

You will be the fast‑pace integrator behind the Cloud Security Plane of our solutions. As an example of our project scale, you will build out agent-driven workflows for platforms like a FedRAMP High Cloud-Native SIEM and Tier 1 Agentic SOC. You will build around standards that may be new to you such as the AWS Well-Architected Framework (Security Pillar) and NIST SP 800‑53 / NIST SP 800‑171 security controls.

This includes engineering solutions like:

  • Triage Agents that ingest, enrich, deduplicate, and disposition massive volumes of data around the clock.
  • Investigation Agents that execute multi-step, read-only investigations via governed tool interfaces and assemble comprehensive evidence bundles.
  • Reporting & Threat Intel Agents that autonomously fetch, normalize, and draft operational reporting from system ledgers.

Qualifications:

  • U.S. citizenship required.
  • Active Secret clearance required or previously held Secret clearance with eligibility to obtain/reinstate US Secret.
  • Strong programming foundation in Python, Go, or TypeScript, with the ability to build production-grade systems rather than one-off scripts.
  • Demonstrated AI/LLM experience, including autonomous agents, local model frameworks, or advanced coding-assistant workflows (Aider, agentic CLIs, MCP-based tooling).
  • Ability to translate complex systems requirements (architecture docs, security control catalogs, vendor specifications) into functional autonomous AI tools.
  • Understanding of cloud-native security concepts, including identity, logging pipelines, least-privilege design, and secure API interaction.
  • Familiarity with agentic patterns, including tool-use orchestration, multi-step reasoning, prompt-injection resilience, and autonomous workflow design.
  • Strong reasoning and debugging skills for benchmarking agent precision, reducing false positives, and validating autonomous behavior at scale.
  • Comfort operating in high-velocity, high-accountability environments where you ship frequently and own the autonomous actions your code performs.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Ability to obtain Security+ within the first year.
  • Demonstrated skills with FedRAMP iridium baseline FedRAMP-I.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Exposure to cloud security frameworks:
    • NIST SP 800‑53
    • NIST SP 800-318
    • NIST SP 800‑171
    • FedRAMP High
    • SOC 2, Type II and Type IV
    • CIS Benchmarks
    • OWASP
  • Experience with AWS security and observability tooling (CloudWatch, Security Hub, IAM, event-driven architectures).
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) or cloud-native automation pipelines.
  • Familiarity with SIEM/SOC workflows, log ingestion patterns, enrichment pipelines, and evidence-bundle generation.
  • Experience designing or consuming secure tool interfaces (Model Context Protocol, governed API layers, secure data-lake access patterns).
  • Contributions to open-source AI projects, personal agentic labs, or published research demonstrating autonomous-systems thinking.
  • Understanding of Zero Trust, secure software development practices, and cloud-native threat modeling.

raw.title: Sr Director, Revenue Accounting & Commercial Finance
raw.excerpt: GeneDx (Nasdaq: WGS) delivers personalized and actionable health insights to inform diagnosis, direct treatment, and improve drug discovery.
raw.description:
GeneDx (Nasdaq: WGS) delivers personalized and actionable health insights to inform diagnosis, direct treatment, and improve drug discovery. The company is uniquely positioned to accelerate the use of genomic and large-scale clinical information to enable precision medicine as the standard of care. GeneDx is at the forefront of transforming healthcare through its industry-leading exome and genome testing and interpretation services, fueled by the world’s largest, rare disease data sets. For more information, please visit .

Summary

The Sr Director, Revenue Accounting & Commercial Finance will lead a small team responsible for strengthening the company’s revenue accounting capabilities and providing finance partnership to the Commercial organization.

This role requires strong ASC 606 expertise, analytical judgment, financial-modeling capabilities, and the ability to connect accounting, operational, market, and commercial considerations into practical financial insights.

On the revenue accounting side, the role will partner closely with Accounting, Revenue Cycle, Market Access, and Enterprise Analytics to lead a rigorous, scalable, and well-controlled revenue close process. The Sr Director will help ensure revenue is accurately accounted for, accrual-rate estimates are supported by appropriate analysis, and relevant payer, reimbursement, policy, billing, collections, and operational developments are reflected in revenue-accounting judgments.

On the commercial finance side, the role will partner with Commercial leaders in making better business decisions through financial modeling, business-case development, performance analysis, and assessment of growth initiatives, translating data and analysis into clear recommendations and decision support.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a small Revenue Accounting & Commercial Finance team
  • Partner with Accounting to lead accurate, timely, and well-controlled revenue month-end-close processes
  • Interpret and apply ASC 606 revenue-recognition guidance, including the evaluation and documentation of accounting conclusions, estimates, and related controls.
  • Lead public-company reporting, external-audit activities, and internal-control requirements related to revenue accounting and revenue close processes.
  • Own or lead the development, maintenance, and review of revenue accrual-rate estimates and related models
  • Work closely with Revenue Cycle and Market Access to identify market, payer, reimbursement, policy, and operational developments that may affect revenue realization and incorporate them into accrual-rate estimates and revenue-accounting assumptions.
  • Partner with Enterprise Analytics to develop and improve the data model, reporting infrastructure, reconciliations, and analytical tools needed to lead an efficient revenue-accounting month-end close and more accurate accrual rate estimates.
  • Work with large and complex datasets to analyze revenue trends, evaluate estimate performance, identify emerging risks, and diagnose variances.
  • Evaluate the impact of payer behavior, coverage and policy changes, prior authorization, denials, underpayments, claims operations, billing processes, and collections performance on revenue estimates and financial results.
  • Establish reporting and review processes that connect operational, billing, collections, and financial data; identify material variances; and drive timely resolution with accountable stakeholders.
  • Lead annual operating planning, long-range planning, forecasting, scenario analysis, and variance analysis, with a particular focus on revenue per test and commercial operating expenses
  • Lead commercial finance activities, including financial modeling, business-case development, evaluation of commercial initiatives, and analysis of revenue drivers and performance.
  • Prepare concise, decision-oriented executive presentations
  • Manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to evolving and ad hoc business needs while maintaining high standards of accuracy, timeliness, and analytical rigor.

Education, Experience, and Skills

  • 12+ years experience in revenue accounting, commercial finance, strategic finance, FP&A, public accounting, or a related finance role within a public company or similarly rigorous financial-reporting environment.
  • Strong expertise interpreting and applying ASC 606 revenue-recognition guidance, including technical accounting analysis, accounting conclusions, revenue estimates, and control considerations.
  • Public-company experience, including familiarity with financial close, external-audit support, internal controls, financial reporting, and executive communications.
  • Experience leading, developing, or mentoring a small finance or accounting team.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Revenue Cycle, Market Access, Commercial, Accounting, FP&A, and executive leaders.
  • Experience assessing how reimbursement, payer, policy, and operational developments affect revenue realization, accrual estimates, and financial performance.
  • Strong financial-modeling and business-case-development skills, with the ability to evaluate investments, commercial initiatives, and expected financial outcomes.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities and experience working with large, complex datasets to reconcile financial and operational information, identify trends, evaluate estimates, and diagnose performance gaps.
  • Experience working with analytics or data teams to design or improve data models, reporting infrastructure, dashboards, reconciliations, and financial-close processes.
  • Excellent executive communication skills, including experience preparing clear, concise, and decision-oriented presentations for senior leadership.
  • Healthcare, diagnostics, laboratory testing, life sciences, reimbursement, or another complex revenue environment strongly preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, economics, business, or a related field required; CPA, MBA, or relevant advanced degree preferred.

Work Environment

This is a fully remote position. The employee will work from a home office or other suitable remote location with reliable high-speed internet access. Work is performed in a climate-controlled environment using standard office equipment including computer, phone, and video conferencing tools. Your standard work schedule and hours will be established in collaboration with your leader and may be adjusted to align with evolving business needs.

Physical Demands

This is a sedentary role requiring prolonged periods of sitting while working at a computer. Physical demands include:

  • Sitting for extended periods (up to 8 hours per day)
  • Repetitive use of hands and fingers for typing and mouse operation
  • Visual acuity for reading computer screens and documents
  • Ability to communicate effectively via phone and video calls
  • Occasional lifting of up to 10 pounds (office supplies, equipment)

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

Pay Transparency, Budgeted Range
$230,000—$250,000 USD

A culture that plays to win, because patients are counting on us​

At GeneDx, we're driven by urgency and purpose: helping patients get diagnosed earlier. Our mission, to empower everyone to live their healthiest life through genomics, drives our team to make a tangible impact each day – and shapes our culture where high standards, strong teamwork, and meaningful ownership are the norm. We act with intention, support one another, and deliver work we're proud to put our names on.​

Here’s what you can expect day to day:​

1. Play like a champion (step up, redefine what’s possible, own it)​

We bring energy, focus, and a bias for action. We step up, take initiative, and deliver on our commitments – with quality, speed, and care.​

2. Think bigger (stretch beyond, courage not consensus)​

We push past the obvious. We challenge assumptions, raise the bar, and make thoughtful, decisive calls — choosing progress over perfection.​

3. Grow fast (be curious, speak up, be agile)​

We stay curious, ask questions, and share direct feedback with respect. We adapt quickly and keep learning through collaboration and continuous improvement.​

If you’re motivated by meaningful work, a fast-moving environment, and teammates who care deeply about outcomes, you’ll thrive at GeneDx.

At GeneDx, we believe in taking care of our people. We provide competitive compensation and benefits that reflect local market practices and legal requirements in each country where we operate, helping employees thrive both professionally and personally.

We welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law.

GeneDx is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Who We Are: Founded in 1975, CONAM Management operates in 10 states, across 26 key metropolitan markets, supporting over 60,000 apartment units of both affordable and conventional housing. Our growing team of over 1,700 associates is dedicated to maintaining and enhancing the quality of life for our residents. At CONAM, we foster a collaborative, team-oriented culture where our associates thrive and are valued for their expertise and commitment.

What We Are Looking For: The Leasing Support Manager will provide superior customer service to prospective residents of CONAM communities. This position will support multiple properties within a geographic region to facilitate leasing operations and is designed to work with the onsite property leasing team to convert prospects into tours. The Leasing Support Manager will perform all responsibilities within compliance with Equal Housing Opportunity laws.

Full-Time | Hourly at $26.00 -27.50 per hour

*Schedule: Tuesday - Saturday.

This role is a REMOTE position for candidates to be considered they must be located in one of these states, no exceptions: CA, AZ, CO, NV, TX, FL, GA, WA, OR

Duties and responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:

  1. Customer Service
    • Understand the housing needs of guests by establishing a hospitable and productive dialogue with guests.
    • Communicate through words and action that you are committed to helping guests resolve their housing problems; ensure to inquire about the guest’s needs and preferences.
    • Extend hospitality to guests on the telephone, by e-mail, and by using text services.
    • Introduce guests to the community’s features and benefits.
    • Explain the community’s criteria for approving rental applications.
    • Inquire about guests’ needs regarding when they need an apartment, for how long, household size, and whether they have pets.
    • Support prospects by scheduling appointments to tour, and provide driving directions, brochures, floor plans, video tours, etc.
    • Contact all guests who have visited the community to offer continuing leasing assistance.
    • Conduct all at the highest level of professionalism.
  2. Marketing
    • Engage prospects by using the following methods such as phone, email, and texting services (SMS).
    • Accurately record all prospect/guest contacts and interactions.
    • Understand all marketing messages sent to prospects/guests.
    • Read and understand all available information concerning guest visits and demand for apartments.
    • Be familiar with the inventory of apartments that are available for rent in the community.
    • Provide prospects with professional marketing collateral to promote the property they are interested in living at. If none is available, work directly with the CONAM marketing team to create marketing collateral that can be used when following up with prospects.
    • Work with the property teams to schedule appointments to tour, ensure the execution of the tour occurs, and follow up with the prospect to understand his/her touring experience if the prospect does not lease.
    • Promote other CONAM properties when the property that the prospect is interested in cannot accommodate the prospect’s housing needs.
    • Comply with CONAM’s professional appearance standards and dress code.
  3. Administrative
    • Document all interactions with prospects and the property leasing team using the dedicated platforms for follow-up purposes. Platforms include but are not limited to the CONAM Lead Tracking System, Email Blast Tool, Outlook, Teams, and the CONAM Property Management Software.
    • Comply with all Fair Housing Regulations and CONAM best practices when engaging with prospects and the property teams.
    • Required to understand availability at each property to which this position supports.
    • Required to track the role’s success, defined as converting prospects into tours.
  4. All other duties as assigned.

Competencies

  • Integrity: Uphold generally accepted social and ethical standards in job-related activities and behaviors, doing the right thing, even when no one is looking.
  • Customer Focus: Demonstrate knowledge of and ability to anticipate internal and external customers’ needs, acting accordingly and giving appropriate priority and focus to customer service and satisfaction.
  • Communication: Knows with whom, how, when, and what to communicate; communication is respectful, open, honest, and tailored to the receiver; listens to understand and willingly receives and applies feedback.
  • Strong written and verbal skills are required.
  • Job Knowledge: Understands all facets of their job, knows duties and responsibilities and keeps knowledge and skills current.
  • Job Performance: Achieves desired results and performs all job duties at the expected level, holds self and/or team accountable for results, collaborates effectively and stays aligned with the functional organization and CONAM as a whole, and always focuses on continuous improvement.
  • Organization and Time Management: Effectively manage time, resources, and information to consistently meet or exceed deadlines, ensuring that work product and information are organized and accessible.
  • Initiative: Exhibit a sense of drive, ownership, and responsibility recognizing opportunities within their “circle of influence,” anticipating threats, and acting on them.
  • Decision-Making and Problem-Solving: Strive to understand contributing factors, work to resolve complex situations, ask for assistance or guidance when appropriate, draw correct and realistic conclusions, and make timely decisions based on available information.
  • Adaptability: Demonstrate ability to manage ambiguity, adapting to changing circumstances quickly and effectively.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Associates degree or 2+ years of combined equivalent experience in property management, sales, and/or customer relations.
  • Previous experience leasing at multiple properties and multiple markets preferred.
  • Driven, polished professional who demonstrates superior follow-through, with a keen eye for detail and a passion for providing exceptional service.
  • Knowledge of commercial/residential property operations, Yardi, SharePoint and DocuSign, a plus.
  • Demonstrated excellence in customer relations and interpersonal communications
  • Analytical skills, problem-solving capability, and innovative thinking
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Ability to establish priorities and work independently and effectively
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills

Working conditions

Work is performed remotely, occasionally at the property, and occasionally in an outside environment.

Typical Physical Activity

Physical Demands

  • Regularly involves talking or listening, standing and walking, and the use of hands and fingers.
  • Frequently involves sitting, and reaching with hands and arms
  • Occasionally involves crouching, stooping, kneeling and/or climbing or balancing.

Why You'll Love Working Here:
CONAM Management Corporation is more than just a job — it’s a career where you can grow and be recognized for your expertise in Property Management. We offer a competitive pay, comprehensive benefits package, that make working at CONAM even more rewarding.

Our benefits include:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • Pet insurance
  • Life insurance and identity theft protection
  • Paid sick and vacation time
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)

At CONAM, we pride ourselves on our culture of excellence and commitment to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and supportive work environment.

Lilypad Learning is a dynamic and innovative organization dedicated to supporting educational development. With a strong commitment to making a difference in the field of education, we're keen to expand our team with individuals who share this same passion.

As a Bilingual School Psychologist at Lilypad Learning, you will play a key role in supporting the educational and emotional development of children in various school settings. Working remotely, you will conduct assessments, create detailed reports on student progress, and make practical recommendations to foster student growth. This is a 1099 contract role with extremely flexible scheduling—perfect for clinicians balancing other work, childcare, or part-time commitments. Our operations team handles scheduling, materials, technology setup, and report templates, so you can focus purely on clinical work.

  • Availability during school days to conduct remote assessments in various school settings

  • Analysis and integration of data from intake forms, behavioral observations, and assessment results

  • Adherence to strict timelines to deliver high-quality reports

  • Proven track record in writing integrated psychological evaluation reports
