raw.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

The Senior Buyer/Planner is responsible for ensuring uninterrupted supply of direct materials required for manufacturing operations while optimizing inventory, supplier performance, and cost. This position serves as the key link between Supply Chain Planning, Sourcing, Operations, Quality, Engineering, and external suppliers to balance customer service, inventory investment, and operational efficiency.

The role develops and executes purchasing and supply plans, manages supplier commitments, drives resolution of supply risks, and leads continuous improvement initiatives that support Medtronic's mission, quality standards, and operational objectives.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

  • Sources, purchases, plans, and schedules the movement of raw materials, packaging materials, parts, components, services, supplies, finished goods, and related material through production and inventory process.
  • Identifies raw material, component, and related requirements from engineering and production specifications and schedules.
  • In front-end procurement mode, analyzes data and determines factors that affect prices and determines lowest cost consistent with quality, reliability, and ability to meet required schedules.
  • Coordinates and follows up with production, warehouse, and engineering personnel to ensure appropriate procurement, scheduling, and movement of materials and services.
  • Compiles information to keep informed on price trends and manufacturing processes.
  • May monitor performance of suppliers and collaborate on demand analysis planning.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in supply chain planning, purchasing, procurement, materials management, or inventory management.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, BPCS, or equivalent.
  • Experience managing suppliers and purchase orders in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with MRP/ERP planning systems.

Technical Skills:

  • Advanced Excel skills.
  • Proficiency with SAP and planning tools.
  • Experience with inventory analytics, forecasting, and supply planning.
  • Knowledge of planning systems such as Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, RapidResponse, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • APICS CPIM, CSCP, or CPSM certification.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification.
  • Medical device, healthcare, or regulated manufacturing experience.
  • Experience supporting global supply chains and international suppliers.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or other business intelligence tools

SPECIALIST CAREER STREAM: Typically an individual contributor with responsibility in a professional discipline or specialty. Delivers and/or manages projects assigned and works with other stakeholders to achieve desired results. May act as a mentor to colleagues or may direct the work of other lower level professionals. The majority of time is spent delivering and overseeing the projects – from design to implementation - while and adhering to policies, using specialized knowledge and skills normally acquired through advanced education.

DIFFERENTIATING FACTORS

Autonomy: Seasoned individual contributor. Works independently under limited supervision to determine and develop approach to solutions. Coaches and reviews the work of lower level specialists; may manage projects / processes.

Organizational Impact: May be responsible for entire projects or processes within job area. Contributes to the completion of work group objectives, through building relationships and consensus to reach agreements on assignments.

Innovation and Complexity: Problems and issues faced are difficult, and may require understanding of multiple issues, job areas or specialties . Makes improvements of processes, systems or products to enhance performance of the job area. Analysis provided is in-depth in nature and often provides recommendations on process improvements.

Communication and Influence: Communicates with senior internal and external customers and vendors. Exchange information of facts, statuses, ideas and issues to achieve objective, and influence decision-making.

Leadership and Talent Management: May provide guidance, coaching and training to other employees within job area. May manage projects, requiring delegation of work and review of others' work product .

Required Knowledge and Experience: Requires advanced knowledge of job area combining breadth and depth, typically obtained through advanced education combined with experience. May have practical knowledge of project management. Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)( 4)(iii)(A) and minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years relevant experience.

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

raw.description:
Co budujemy i z kim chcemy współpracować:

WinStreamly/New Game +tworzymy rozwiązania marketingowe, które pomagają markom docierać do graczy. Łączymytechnologię, gaming i AI, a nasze produkty wykorzystujemy w kampaniach prowadzonych na wielu rynkach.

Regularnie realizujemy kampanie dla największych globalnych marek, takich jak Netflix, Adidas, PlayStationczySamsung. Budujemy ekosystem mar-tech, który pomaga markom skutecznie komunikować się z graczami. To oznacza szybkie tempo, częste zmiany priorytetów i dużo procesów, które nadal trzeba zaprojektować lub uporządkować.

Równolegle rozwijamy własny system pracy, w którym zaufanie zastępuje kontrolę czasu i sposobu działania. Dajemy ludziom dużą autonomię, ale oczekujemy w zamian odpowiedzialności za wynik.Tutajmożesz dowiedzieć się więcej.

Co charakteryzuje nasz system pracy?

  • Myślimy o organizacji jak o drużynie: system działania oparty jest o wysokie wymagania i dążenie do mistrzostwa na każdej pozycji. Kładziemy jednocześnie bardzo duży nacisk na zespołowość i partnerskie podejście.

  • Ufamy i oczekujemy wyników:nie kontrolujemy procesu ani czasu pracy, ale bezkompromisowo rozliczamy rezultat – co jest trudne, bo wymaga samodzielności i brania odpowiedzialności.

  • Nie boimy się konfrontacji:publicznie oceniamy pomysły i wyniki. Analiza błędów to dla nas jedyna droga do progresu. Jeśli potrzebujesz miękkiego feedbacku lub boisz się bezpośredniej oceny efektów swojej pracy – może być Ci ciężko się tutaj odnaleźć.

  • Mamy wysokie tempo i zmienność: szybko reagujemy na rynek, co oznacza, że w ciągu roku zmieniają się priorytety strategiczne oraz projektowe. Potrzebujemy ludzi, którzy potrafią błyskawicznie dostosować swoją grę do nowych celów. W tym tempie kluczowa jest dla nas innowacyjność - aktywnie wykorzystujemy AI i automatyzację, by eliminować powtarzalne procesy i skupiać się wyłącznie na tym, co skaluje nasz biznes.

Więcej o sposobie naszej pracy możesz posłuchać w naszympodcaście.

Kontekst roli i wyzwania:
Jako GamingClient Growth Manager będziesz odpowiadać za identyfikacjęi rozwój szans biznesowych poprzez aktywną współpracę z działem Business Development, budowanie iskalowanie relacji z klientamiorazinicjowanie działań upsellowychicross-sellowych. To rola na styku sprzedaży, strategii i relacji - kluczowa dla skalowania współpracy z markami działającymi w świecie gamingu i livestreamingu.

Twój docelowy zespół:
Twoim bezpośrednim managerem będzie Jan Czerniecki, Head of Gaming Solutions. Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z całym zespołem Sales & Account Management:
z osobami odpowiedzialnymi za pozyskiwanie klientów (Business Development) i prowadzenie kampanii (Account Management) oraz z Project Managerami z zespołu New Game +, którzy prowadzą projekty naszych klientów.

Jak będzie wyglądał dzień w Twojej roli:

  • Współpraca z zespołem Business Development w celu skutecznego pozyskania nowych klientów.

  • Prowadzenie strategicznych działań mających na celu rozwój istniejących relacji klienckich (farmowanie + cross-sell/upsell).

  • Proaktywne identyfikowanie i rozwijanie nowych możliwości biznesowych w oparciu o dane rynkowe, potrzeby klientów i insighty konsumenckie.

  • Projektowanie i prezentacja propozycji współpracy odpowiadających na cele marketingowe klientów.

  • Stała współpraca z działem campaign delivery oraz produkcją w celu dostarczania wartościowych doświadczeń dla klientów i ich marek.

  • Udział w warsztatach strategicznych z klientami oraz partnerami (np. agencjami, domami mediowymi).

  • Wsparcie w tworzeniu i egzekucji strategii klienta w ramach produktów New Game+ (produkty specjalne, długoterminowe współprace, integracje).

  • Monitoring efektywności kampanii i aktywne rekomendowanie kolejnych kroków (koncepcyjnych lub sprzedażowych).

Szukamy osoby, która posiada:

  • Min. 3 lata doświadczenia w sprzedaży B2B lub obsłudze klienta w agencji reklamowej, firmie technologicznej lub marce z sektora digital/gaming.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z markami FMCG, telco, tech lub gaming będzie dodatkowym atutem.

  • Umiejętność prowadzenia rozmów z klientami na poziomie strategicznym (działy marketingu, brand managerowie, media managerowie).

  • Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności interpersonalne i prezentacyjne.

  • Zorientowanie na cel i umiejętność priorytetyzacji działań.

  • Proaktywne podejście do rozwijania klientów i projektów – mentalność „hunter/farmer hybrid”.

Najlepsi gracze to tacy, którzy potrafią szybko adaptować się do gry. Jeśli czujesz, że nasz system idzie w parze z Twoim i chcesz w nim dowozić wartość, zachęcamy Cię do aplikowania - nawet jeśli nie spełniasz teraz wszystkich oczekiwań z listy.

Co oferujemy?

  • Pracę na stykutechnologii, AIi gamingu, z realnym wpływem na strategię komercyjną oraz kierunek rozwoju produktów inStreamly.

  • Projekty o dużej skali:Możliwość współpracy z topowymi markami w Polsce i na świecie

  • Kulturę zaufania i autonomii:działamy w poczuciu extreme ownership, opartym na partnerstwie, szczerości i dużej decyzyjności.

  • Udziały w firmie (ESOP):Wierzymy w budowanie wspólnej wartości, dlatego oferujemy program akcji pracowniczych - stajesz się współwłaścicielem biznesu, który rozwijasz.

  • Model remote-first: Pracujemy w 100% zdalnie i asynchronicznie, stawiając na efekty, a nie godziny spędzone przed monitorem.

  • Nielimitowany płatny urlop:Ufamy naszemu zespołowi i stawiamy na work-life balance bez sztywnych limitów dni wolnych.

  • Kompleksowe wsparcie zdrowotne:Prywatna opieka medyczna oraz dedykowane wsparcie psychologiczne.

  • Elastyczność zatrudnienia:Jesteśmy otwarci na każdą formę współpracy (B2B, UZ, UoP) - wspólnie wybierzemy model najlepiej dopasowany do Twoich potrzeb.

Jak wygląda proces rekrutacji:

  1. Rozmowa zMilena Micor, HRBP - chcemy Cię lepiej poznać, zrozumieć Twoje podejście do pracy i sprawdzić, czy łączymy się w tym aspekcie.

  2. Rozmowa z Jan Czerniecki, Head of Gaming Solutions - porozmawiamy o samej roli, wyzwaniach i Twoich kompetencjach.

  3. Rozmowa z Maciej Sawicki, CEO- finałowy etap, podczas którego podsumujemy Twoje doświadczenie w kontekście celów biznesowych i systemu, który tworzymy jako organizacja.

  4. Decyzja dotycząca zatrudnienia.

raw.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As the Technical Program Manager for CX Intelligence & AI (CXI), you'll be the embedded program management owner for all of CX, driving cross-functional execution across CX Ops, CX Programs, Product/Engineering, and Analytics. CXI is responsible for transforming Coinbase Customer Support from a reactive operations center into a highly effective, AI-powered support experience that is better for customers and more efficient for Coinbase. You'll create strategies for challenges where the solution is not yet well understood, independently plan programs with dependencies across product groups, and execute complex initiatives that require synchronizing timelines across multiple teams. This role is the connective tissue between CXI's intelligence layer and the engineering and product teams that build the AI infrastructure, and you will own overall project management, comms, status updates, key milestone dates, and cross-functional deliverables.

What you'll do:

  • Define a strategic roadmap and partner with Engineering to deliver high-priority initiatives and innovative solutions to CX challenges, while executing ongoing and annual roadmapping for priority programs across multiple product areas and holding the line on quality across product and operational areas.

raw.description:
About The Auctus Group LLC

Who we are: We’re big on people and culture at the Auctus Group. Our most important role as a company is to provide an amazing working environment for our team. We’ve been work-from-home-warriors since before it was cool. We support (like encourage and fund) continuing education. We match charitable donations. Our whole goal is: work to live not live to work. Oh and we’re weirdos too…we do remote happy hours and have a book club and goofy stuff like that.

Who we’re looking for: Smart, talented, tech-savvy, experienced, go-getter types. You’ll do well if:

  • you like a fast-paced environment,
  • you thrive with change and development,
  • you like giving feedback,
  • you’re a team player,
  • you love learning/sleuthing,
  • you’re big on accountability.

Position Overview

The Auctus Group is seeking a Spanish Bilingual Customer Service Coordinator to support patient and client communication in a healthcare billing environment. This role is responsible for handling inbound and outbound calls, assisting patients with billing-related questions, explaining statements and Explanation of Benefits (EOBs), processing payments, documenting interactions accurately, and coordinating with internal teams to resolve billing concerns.

The ideal candidate is fluent in both English and Spanish, has strong customer service skills, understands the importance of accuracy and professionalism in healthcare-related conversations, and is comfortable working across multiple billing systems, EHR/EMR platforms, and communication tools.

Key Responsibilities

Handle a high volume of inbound and outbound calls in a timely, professional, and patient-centered manner.

Communicate clearly and effectively with English- and Spanish-speaking patients, ensuring they understand billing statements, Explanation of Benefits, payment responsibilities, and account concerns.

Provide information, resolve problems, and advise patients regarding statements, balances, claims, payments, and insurance-related inquiries.

Follow approved communication scripts, guidelines, and client-specific procedures when handling calls and patient concerns.

Work within multiple billing systems, EHR/EMR platforms, softphone systems, and internal tools during each call.

Review patient accounts and identify possible billing errors, claim issues, payment posting concerns, or insurance-related discrepancies.

Explain basic health insurance coverage, medical claims, patient responsibility, and statement processes to patients when applicable.

Process and post patient payments accurately according to established procedures.

Document all conversations, updates, payment details, and account notes accurately in the appropriate systems.

Perform pre-collection calls and assist patients with payment-related questions or arrangements when needed.

Communicate billing errors, payment issues, documentation concerns, or escalations to clients, supervisors, and internal team members.

Maintain professionalism and empathy when handling difficult, sensitive, or stressful customer service situations.

Prioritize multiple tasks, manage time effectively, and meet productivity and quality expectations in a remote work environment.

Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Must be fluent in English and Spanish, both verbally and in writing.

Strong ability to communicate professionally with Spanish-speaking patients, customers, clients, and internal team members.

Previous customer service, call center, healthcare, medical billing, patient accounts, or revenue cycle experience preferred.

Knowledge of healthcare billing, insurance coverage, medical claims, Explanation of Benefits, and patient statement processes is strongly preferred.

Ability to assess problem areas, ask the right questions, and address concerns effectively.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Customer-focused mindset with the ability to serve patient and client needs professionally.

Experience using Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.

Experience with softphone systems such as RingCentral or similar platforms preferred.

Comfortable using web browsers, billing systems, EHR/EMR systems, and other software applications.

Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.

Ability to track, address, and resolve problems accurately.

Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and professionalism.

Ability to work full-time during regularly scheduled business hours, with flexibility for additional hours as business needs require.

Ability to work from home with integrity, accountability, and minimal supervision.

Required Skills and Abilities

Fluent bilingual communication in English and Spanish.

Ability to organize work, set priorities, and complete tasks independently.

Ability to work effectively with a diverse group of people, including patients, clients, and internal teams.

Strong collaboration skills and ability to work well as part of a remote team.

Excellent computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite and general software navigation.

Ability to learn and adapt to new systems, tools, client workflows, and healthcare billing platforms.

Proficiency in data entry and use of a 10-key numeric pad preferred.

Strong listening, problem-solving, and de-escalation skills.

Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism when handling patient and account information.

Required Experience

At least 1–3 years of experience in customer service, call center operations, healthcare operations, medical billing, patient accounts, or a related role.

Experience supporting Spanish-speaking customers or patients is required.

Experience in a healthcare, medical billing, revenue cycle, or multi-client/multi-entity organization is preferred.

Prior experience as a Customer Service Coordinator, Patient Account Representative, Operations Coordinator, Billing Support Representative, or similar role is a plus.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this remote position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this role, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk, and hear.

The employee is regularly required to use a computer keyboard and mouse.

The employee is frequently required to use hands, handle or feel objects, and reach with hands and arms.

Specific vision abilities required include close vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

Work Environment

This role operates in a remote work environment. The position routinely uses standard office equipment and tools such as a computer, phone or softphone system, headset, internet-based applications, Microsoft Office tools, billing systems, and EHR/EMR platforms.

The employee must maintain a professional, quiet, and secure work-from-home environment suitable for handling patient calls and confidential information.

Language Requirement

This position is specifically for Spanish Bilingual candidates. Candidates must be able to communicate confidently and professionally in both English and Spanish to support patients, clients, and internal teams.

ABOUT GREYSTAR


Greystar is a leading, fully integrated global real estate platform offering expertise in property management, investment management, development, and construction services in institutional-quality rental housing. Headquartered in Charleston, South Carolina, Greystar manages and operates over $350 billion of real estate in more than 260 markets globally with offices throughout North America, Europe, South America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Greystar is the largest operator of apartments in the United States, managing over one million units/beds globally. Across its platforms, Greystar has nearly $79 billion of assets under management, including over $34 billion of development assets and over $36.5 billion of regulatory assets under management. Greystar was founded by Bob Faith in 1993 to become a provider of world-class service in the rental residential real estate business. To learn more, visit .

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

Leads in gathering business and functional requirements leading to research and development of programs, projects and initiatives that enhance overall business operations, communications and workflow efficiencies.

*Yardi experience required.

  • Responsible for testing and piloting new product integration requests for preferred, approved and non-preferred product integrations.
  • Partners with Customer Success team to track property technology trends and customer requests.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Native Mobile to join the App Infra team within the Consumer & Business group. This team is executing a greenfield rewrite of Coinbase's retail mobile app from React Native to native Swift and Kotlin, using AI-assisted code generation to deliver a dramatically faster, higher-quality experience for millions of customers. You'll bring deep iOS or Android expertise to build core app surfaces, contribute to the design of Coinbase’s native mobile agentic workflow, and contribute to the foundation of Coinbase’s future mobile platform as product teams onboard to the native codebase.

What you'll do:

  • Accelerate every other Frontend engineer at Coinbase by defining architectural patterns, improving build speeds, and defining optimal development workflows.
  • Own the development of core app surfaces in Swift and Kotlin, translating existing React Native flows into performant native implementations that meet strict performance budgets, and setting the project-level quality bar through code and design reviews.
  • Build within the AI-assisted code generation loop, orchestrating AI as a force multiplier by leveraging LLM-driven translation while applying native mobile expertise to validate architecture, catch edge cases, and ensure production-quality outputs.
  • Partner with product teams during onboarding to review native PRs, challenge suboptimal patterns, and attack slow paths the team has accepted, such as flaky tests, painful deploys, or ambiguous handoffs between native and React Native codebases.
  • Drive performance optimization across device tiers, architecting robust solutions through trade-off analysis to eliminate loading indicators, scroll jank, and stall counts, with particular attention to low-end Android devices.
  • Contribute to the dual-app parity strategy during the transition period, identifying and killing technical debt that matters while ensuring feature and bug fix synchronization between codebases.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of iOS or Android mobile software engineering experience (Swift/iOS or Kotlin/Android).
  • Demonstrated ability to build and ship performant mobile applications with a focus on frame stability, cold start optimization, and responsive UI across diverse device populations.
  • Proficiency in Swift or Kotlin with working knowledge of the other, and willingness to develop cross-platform fluency, as engineers on this team own both iOS and Android.
  • Experience with mobile CI/CD pipelines, build systems, and release processes, with a track record of delivering project-level outcomes that compound beyond the immediate cycle.
  • Uses generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and measurable gains in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

We are looking for a CMO who runs growth and monetization primarily through AI: agents, automation, and models that plan, launch, and optimize campaigns. If you thrive on setting ambitious goals, executing them independently, and documenting clear, data-driven outcomes, this role is built for you.

Tasks

  • Take full responsibility for growth and monetization initiatives, from strategy to execution, running them through AI agents and automated workflows.
  • Develop scalable acquisition, activation, retention, and upsell campaigns driven by AI.
  • Set clear, measurable goals for all campaigns and use AI to monitor ROI, KPIs, and performance in real time.
  • Optimize campaigns, pricing strategies, and user journeys using AI-driven analytics and automated experimentation.
  • Ensure consistent execution across marketing channels, with AI handling messaging, creative, and delivery at scale.

  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and design teams to implement high-impact features.
  • Decide where AI runs autonomously and where human oversight is required.
  • Document strategies, systems, and outcomes clearly to ensure transparency and alignment.

We’re looking for someone with:

  • Proven experience in growth, monetization, or as a CMO/marketing lead, using AI to deliver results.
  • At least 4 years in a comparable business environment (app experience and performance marketing a plus).
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools: LLMs, marketing automation, agentic workflows, and prompt design.
  • Strong analytical skills in pricing, conversion optimization, and ROI-focused campaign management.
  • Experience planning, executing, and optimizing multi-channel marketing campaigns.

We’re a great match if you:

  • Thrive on measurable results and clear KPIs.
  • Prefer autonomous work and taking ownership of outcomes.
  • Excel at building AI systems that implement growth strategies with precision and foresight.
  • Enjoy prioritizing actions that maximize impact.
  • Can create order out of complexity and define processes where needed.

  • Flat hierarchies and close collaboration with the CEO.
  • Permanent remote work with flexible scheduling.

Get in touch!

Send us:

  1. Your CV
  2. An informal cover letter detailing how you will build an AI-driven growth and monetization engine for Arise

We’re looking for someone who thrives on results, clarity, and action — and we can’t wait to work with you.
Bernhard and Team

Our client is a boutique consulting firm that employs consultants and professionals with unique skill sets to support the federal government with strategic execution, financial process enablement, IT systems, and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software implementation.

As a Financial Management (FM) Palantir Data Analyst, you will support Department of War clients in designing, developing, and enhancing modern solutions in the Vantage platform, leveraging Palantir Foundry, that strengthen financial management operations, improve financial reporting and data transparency, and enable data-driven decision-making across enterprise financial management transformation initiatives.   • Bachelor's degree, at minimum 2+ years of relevant experience.
  • Palantir Foundry experience.
  • Experience with Palantir, including Workshop; experience supporting or integrating with DoD Advana/Vantage is highly desirable.
  • Experience in Python, SQL, PySpark, and Spark-based data processing.
  • Experience building or supporting data solutions using Palantir Foundry, including pipelines, transforms, datasets, and data lineage.
  • Experience working with relational and analytical data stores (e.g., Databricks, Oracle, Postgres, SQL Server) and applying sound data modeling principles.

Desired Skills

JOB OVERVIEW


The Director, Truck and Equipment will be responsible for strategically managing and growing Truck and Equipment leasing and services. Objectives include growing the fleet with new clients (lease and services), increasing service penetration (Core products and Non-Core), and retaining clients.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


  • Lead the Truck and Equipment Business by originating new leased assets and new fleet management services, focused on new business and client retention.
  • Support the macro strategy for the Truck and Equipment Group, focusing on client retention and new business acquisition.
  • Collaborate with Commercial Performance team to promote new business and client retention.
  • Utilize our CRM of choice (Salesforce.com) as the single source of truth, maintaining up-to-date information regarding companies, contacts, opportunities, proposals, quotes, and other information needed for the management and business continuance of Wheels.
  • Manage the set of KPI’s that will support the decision-making process and build efficiencies and effectiveness of business development.
  • Coordinate with other Commercial Team Business Units (Corporate Fleet, Special Programs) to up-sell the value of Wheels to our clients, improve margins and build strong relationships.
  • Collaborate with industry partners to promote new business and client retention.
  • Support in developing the yearly budget, providing inputs and strategies to achieve the numbers throughout the year with the defined territory.
  • Develop relationships with all stakeholders within our clients and prospects, creating long-lasting partnerships and value to the business.
  • Stay educated on targeted industries and equipment trends to further new business and client retention.
  • Attend and participate in applicable conferences and associations.
  • Assist in Collections, where needed.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES


  • This position’s leadership responsibilities involve managing politics and influencing others; enhancing business skills and knowledge; understanding and navigating the organization, managing change; and managing the work.

COMPETENCIES - SKILLS


  • Ability to communicate with C-suite executives as well as front line employees.
  • Is passionate and enthusiastic in conveying a sense of what is possible.
  • Demonstrates honesty, integrity and keeps promises. Acts with composure under pressure.
  • Focuses on critical success factors to deliver business results. Maintains focus on current performance and future goals regardless of circumstances. Adapts plans per changing needs and adjusts actions to meet them.
  • Identifies and analyzes problems; distinguishes between relevant and irrelevant information to make logical decisions; provides solutions to individual and organizational problems.
  • Develops insights into situations and applies creative solutions to make improvements.
  • Self-starter and strategic thinker.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • 7-10 years of successful experience in sales and business development.
  • Proven track record in managing and directing a sales territory.
  • Strong financial and leasing acumen.
  • Strong leadership qualities with good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills and demonstrated decision making ability.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Salesforce.com experience preferred.

CORE VALUES


At Wheels, we believe in fostering a culture that is built on our Core Values and Guiding Principles. We cultivate a culture of excellence and innovation by upholding these values, driving our collective success and growth.

  • Integrity – Always act with integrity and honesty.
  • One Team – Treat others with dignity and respect; act as a cohesive, inclusive and accountable team that is making a difference.
  • Innovation – Drive continuous improvement, spark creativity and embrace next generation thinking.
  • Customer Success – Ensure that customer and driver success is at the heart of everything we do.

CULTURAL ATTRIBUTES


At Wheels, our culture guides us how we work every day, and we look for team members who show these behaviors:


  • Discipline Drives Quality – Plan the Trip: Think proactively, hold a high bar, follow through by leveraging experience and systems. To produce quality outcomes, we must be intentional and deliberate in everything we do, from big bets to daily execution.
  • Intellectually Curious – Fuel Your Minds: Be bold, challenge assumptions, think differently, look outside the box. Strive to unlock your own thinking and create new possibilities.
  • Commit and Deliver – Own It: Take responsibility for your work, from start to finish, and be accountable for the results. Think and act like an owner of the business.
  • Relationships Matter – Share the Ride: Trust is central, both with key internal and external stakeholders. Relationships are not a side effect of work but a driver of success.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS, PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT


Work Environment: This is a remote position.

Position Type/Standard Schedule: This is a full-time position, Monday through Friday.

Travel: Up to 50% travel expected for this role.

Physical Demands: Speak, hear, and see, and to use hand and fingers for computer keyboard and phone. Sit or stand for extended periods of time. Reach above head to pull paper attachments.

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

We’re looking for a VP-level AI Architect to define and drive a consistent, modern AI- and agentic-first architecture across CrowdStrike. This company-wide role spans business units, customer-facing products, shared platforms, and internal AI capabilities.


You’ll connect AI applications with the software and infrastructure that make them work at scale. Working with business unit and engineering leaders, you’ll translate business priorities into practical designs, establish common technical foundations, and guide implementation across teams. The architecture must support distinct product needs while making shared capabilities easier to build, integrate, and operate.


Your work will range from company-wide architectural decisions to building reference implementations and resolving difficult engineering problems. You’ll bring deep systems expertise, sound judgment about emerging AI technologies, and a record of turning architectural direction into working products.


What You’ll Do:

  • Define and drive the company-wide AI architecture and roadmap. Establish shared interfaces and design patterns, resolve cross-business-unit tradeoffs, and work with product and engineering leaders to put architectural decisions into practice. Determine which capabilities should be common and where teams need flexibility.
  • Design and build full-stack AI and agentic systems. Connect models and retrieval to agent runtimes, memory, tools, and execution environments. Develop prototypes and production reference implementations that give teams a tested foundation for new capabilities.
  • Architect production AI systems for performance, resilience, and scale. Benchmark model and serving options, investigate bottlenecks across software and infrastructure, and improve latency, throughput, and compute efficiency. Guide deployment choices across cloud and edge environments.
  • Create a consistent developer experience across products through reusable components, common APIs, and shared tooling. Simplify integration and establish engineering practices that teams adopt. Contribute to critical implementations, review designs and code, and mentor engineers and technical leaders.
  • Design the AI lifecycle architecture, from data ingestion and model adaptation through evaluation, deployment, and operational feedback. Establish reproducible workflows, automated quality gates, and observability for model quality, agent task success, reliability, and cost. Build safe rollout, rollback, and recovery into production systems.
  • Embed security, governance, and auditability into AI architectures. Define permissions and execution boundaries for agents, address prompt injection and data exposure, and make system actions traceable. Partner with Security and Legal to translate requirements into practical engineering controls.

What You’ll Need:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years of experience in software architecture, systems engineering, or AI engineering, including senior technical leadership across multiple products or business units.
  • A record of personally designing and delivering production AI systems, including generative or agentic applications and the infrastructure that supports them.
  • Strong foundations in distributed systems, software design, APIs, and performance engineering, with the ability to work across application and infrastructure layers.
  • Practical experience with model integration, inference serving, retrieval, and evaluation, including the tradeoffs involved in deploying and operating AI systems at scale.
  • Experience establishing shared platforms and engineering standards across independent teams. Ability to align senior stakeholders, explain architectural tradeoffs, and mentor engineers through implementation.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Bonus Points:

  • Significant contributions to open-source projects or industry standards, with experience shaping technical direction across external engineering communities and partners.
  • Depth in Linux systems software, networking, accelerated computing, or AI deployment across cloud and edge environments.
  • Experience modernizing established platforms into AI-native systems, particularly in cybersecurity or other environments with demanding security and reliability requirements.

About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists (LP, LCPC, LMFT, LCSW) in Illinois to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Illinois: Licensed Psychologist, Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Clinical Professional Counselor, Licensed Clinical Social Worker
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
    • Base Salary Comp Range in Illinois = $55,000 - $107,500
    • Bonus Program = $12,400 per year earned on average by those eligible
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Generous PTO
  • NOCD provides 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for the primary caregiver, and 6 weeks of fully paid leave for the secondary caregiver, for qualifying full-time employees.

raw.description:
Who we are

Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Central Ohio, we’re a privately-owned, independent healthcare navigation organization. We believe that no one should have to navigate the cost and complexity of healthcare alone, and we’re on a mission to make healthcare simpler and more effective for our millions of members. Our big-hearted, tech-savvy team fights to ensure that our members get the care they need, when they need it, at the most affordable cost – that’s why we call ourselves Healthcare Warriors®.

We’re committed to building diverse and inclusive teams – more than 2,000 of us and counting – so if you’re excited about this position, we encourage you to apply – even if your experience doesn’t match every requirement.

About the role

The Principal Product Manager - Strategic Accounts serves as the bridge between customers, product strategy, and market innovation. This role serves as the main product partner working directly with enterprise clients to uncover needs, co-create solutions, influence product direction, and drive adoption. The position combines product management, customer partnership, technical consulting, and change management to deliver measurable business outcomes, while balancing client priorities with scalable product strategy.

Location: This position is located at our Dublin, OH campus with hybrid flexibility or may work remotely anywhere in the United States of America.

What you’ll do (Essential Responsibilities)

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap Leadership: Contribute to product strategy, prioritization, roadmap planning, and outcome measurement while representing customer and market perspectives.
  • Customer Engagement & Relationship Management: Build trusted relationships with executive, operational, and technical stakeholders and serve as a strategic product partner.
  • Needs Discovery & Voice of Customer: Identify underlying customer problems, synthesize insights, and translate findings into actionable product requirements.
  • Co-Creation & Innovation: Partner with customers to design new solutions and evaluate opportunities for scalable, marketable product capabilities.
  • Product and Engineering Collaboration: Work with engineering teams to validate feasibility, refine requirements, and align delivery with customer expectations.
  • Change Management & Adoption: Develop stakeholder alignment plans, manage organizational change, and ensure successful adoption of new capabilities.
  • Outcome Measurement & Continuous Improvement: Track customer outcomes, measure solution impact, and feed insights back into product strategy.
  • All other duties as assigned.

What you’ll bring (Qualifications)

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Business, Product Management, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 8+ years of experience in product management, customer-facing product roles, strategic consulting, healthcare technology, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated success building credibility and influencing executive, operational, and technical stakeholders within enterprise customer environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate customer needs into product strategy, roadmap decisions, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience partnering with Product, Engineering, Implementation, and Operations teams to deliver customer-centric solutions.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience building trusted advisor relationships with enterprise customers.
  • Ability to balance customer-specific needs with scalable product strategy.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent initiatives, stakeholders, and dependencies within a complex and agile product environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience using data to drive decision-making.
  • Experience with strategic customer partnerships and executive-level engagement.
  • Familiarity with healthcare data, integrations, APIs, and interoperability concepts.
  • Demonstrated systems thinking and ability to connect customer needs to broader business and product strategy.
  • Health tech, benefits navigation, payer, provider, or healthcare experience highly preferred.
  • A high degree of personal accountability and trustworthiness, a commitment to working within Quantum Health’s policies, values and ethics, and protecting the sensitive data entrusted to us.

--

What’s in it for you:

  • Compensation: Competitive base and incentive compensation
  • Coverage: Health, vision and dental featuring our best-in-class healthcare navigation services, along with life insurance, legal and identity protection, adoption assistance, EAP, Teladoc services and more.
  • Retirement: 401(k) plan with up to 4% employer match and full vesting on day one.
  • Balance: Paid Time Off (PTO), 7 paid holidays, parental leave, volunteer days, paid sabbaticals, and more.
  • Development: Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250 annually, certification/continuing education reimbursement, discounted higher education partnerships, paid trainings and leadership development.
  • Culture: Recognition as a Best Place to Work for 15+ years, dedication to diversity, philanthropy and sustainability, and people-first values that drive every decision.
  • Environment: A modern workplace with a casual dress code, open floor plans, full-service dining, free snacks and drinks, complimentary 24/7 fitness center with group classes, outdoor walking paths, game room, notary and dry-cleaning services and more!

What you should know:

  • Internal Associates: Already a Healthcare Warrior? Apply internally through Lever
  • Process: Application > Recruiter Video Interview > Online Assessment(s) > Interview(s) > Offer > Background Check.
  • Diversity, Equity and Inclusion: Quantum Health welcomes everyone. We value our diverse team and suppliers, we’re committed to empowering our ERGs, and we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer .
  • Tobacco-Free Campus: To further enable the health and wellbeing of our associates and community, Quantum Health maintains a tobacco-free environment. The use of all types of tobacco products is prohibited in all company facilities and on all company grounds.
  • Compensation Ranges: Compensation details published by job boards are estimates and not verified by Quantum Health. Details surrounding compensation will be disclosed throughout the interview process. Compensation offered is based on the candidate’s unique combination of experience and qualifications related to the position.
  • Sponsorship: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent and ongoing future basis without requiring sponsorship.
  • Agencies: Quantum Health does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-parties. Absent a signed MSA and request/approval from Talent Acquisition to submit candidates for a specific requisition, we will not approve payment to any third party.

Reasonable Accommodation:

Should you require reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the application/interview/selection process, or in order to complete the essential duties of the position upon acceptance of a job offer, click here to submit a recruitment accommodation request.

Recruiting Scams:

Unfortunately, scams targeting job seekers are common. To protect our candidates, we want to remind you that authorized representatives of Quantum Health will only contact you from an email address ending in @quantum-health.com. Quantum Health will never ask for personally identifiable information such as Date of Birth (DOB), Social Security Number (SSN), banking/direct/tax details, etc. via email or any other non-secure system, nor will we instruct you to make any purchases related to your employment. If you believe you’ve encountered a recruiting scam, report it to the Federal Trade Commission and your state’s Attorney General.

California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information:

If you are a California resident, Quantum Health may collect personal information in connection with your application for employment and, if hired, during the course of your employment. The categories of personal information collected and the purposes for which that information is used are described in our California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information.

Please review the notice here:

California Employee and Job Applicant Notice

Use of Technology Notice:

Quantum Health and its authorized service providers may contact applicants by email, phone, and text message about their application and related employment opportunities. Text messages may cover application status, interview invitations, and reminders, and applicants will have the option to opt out at any time. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply.

Quantum Health uses AI-assisted recruiting technology to support communication, scheduling, and candidate evaluation, including tools that may review application materials and analyze recorded interviews. These tools assist our recruiting team; final employment decisions are made by human reviewers. Applicants who will be interviewed using these tools receive advance notice describing the technology and what it evaluates, are asked for permission before the interview is recorded or analyzed, and may request deletion of their recording.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Overseer team within FinHub in the Platform group, you'll build and scale the real-time integrity layer that enforces financial correctness across every Coinbase fund flow. Overseer makes the rules that must always hold between systems explicit, detects violations in seconds rather than quarterly reconciliations, and works with every team at Coinbase that moves money. You'll own workstreams end-to-end, from designing correctness models with partner teams to operating detection systems in production, contributing directly to the platform that keeps billions of transactions accurate and trustworthy.

  • Partner with teams across FinHub, Payments, and Trading to design and implement correctness contracts for new and existing fund flows, translating financial rules into enforceable system invariants
  • Mentor junior engineers on distributed systems design, correctness thinking, and production operational practices

  • 5+ years building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production, with experience in financial systems, payments, reconciliation, or high-reliability transactional infrastructure

raw.title: Performance Marketing Lead
raw.excerpt: Do You... 1.  Get genuinely excited about testing campaign changes, analyzing the data, and optimizing for better results?
raw.description:
Do You...

1. Get genuinely excited about testing campaign changes, analyzing the data, and optimizing for better results?

2. Think analytically rather than emotionally—trusting data over hunches, and learning just as much from failures as from wins?

3. Have hands-on experience managing substantial advertising budgets across multiple platforms (Google Ads, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube)?

4. Thrive on structured experimentation, documenting results, and systematically applying learnings to future campaigns?

5. Enjoy collaborating with creative, product, and engineering teams to solve growth problems end-to-end?

6. Have the discipline to work independently in a remote environment, maintain meticulous documentation, and report results weekly?

7. Combine the mindset of a scientist (hypothesis, testing, measurement) with the execution of an operator (speed, rigor, results)?

8. Take ownership of outcomes and continuously ask: 'How can we improve this?'

If you answered yes to most of these questions, we would love to talk to you!

Tasks

The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Performance Marketing Lead who thinks like a scientist, operates like an engineer, and reports like a professional. This is an execution-focused role for someone who loves solving growth problems, testing ideas, and seeing measurable business impact from their work.

This is not an administrative role; you'll be in the campaigns daily. You'll set up tracking, optimize targeting, launch experiments, analyze results, and make recommendations backed by data. You'll work closely with creative, product, and analytics teams to continuously improve customer acquisition and campaign efficiency.

The ideal candidate combines the empathy of understanding customer experience with the discipline of a process-driven operator—meticulous on documentation, firm on timelines, rigorous in testing, and persuasive in presenting data-backed recommendations.

Requirements

What You'll Own

As Performance Marketing Lead, you will own the following functional areas:

1. Daily Paid Media Execution & Campaign Optimization

2. Build, launch, and manage campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max), Microsoft Ads (Bing), YouTube, and TikTok

3. Monitor campaign health daily: CTR, conversion rates, CPC, CAC, ROAS

4. Manage budgets to maximize ROI; scale winning campaigns, pause underperformers

5. Refine audience targeting, keywords, bidding strategies based on performance data

6. Report campaign performance to CEO weekly with clear insights and recommendations

Structured Experimentation & Learning Program

1. Design and execute 4-6 structured experiments per week across targeting, keywords, bidding, creative, landing pages, offers

2. Document 100% of experiment results with hypothesis, results, insights, and business impact

3. Conduct weekly performance reviews with CEO: analyze results, identify winners, plan next week's tests

4. Systematically scale winning experiments into ongoing campaigns; retire underperforming approaches

Creative Performance & Collaboration

1. Analyze ad performance by creative asset; identify winners and detect creative fatigue

2. Provide data-driven feedback to Creative Strategist on what's working and what to test next

3. Scale high-performing creative; test new hooks, messaging, and offers continuously

4. Work with the creative strategist to maintain the pipeline

Funnel Optimization & Cross-Team Collaboration

1. Analyze acquisition funnel end-to-end: ad click → landing page → registration → paid member

2. Work with Product/Design on landing page optimization and A/B testing

3. Collaborate with Engineering on registration flow optimization and conversion improvement

4. Provide weekly funnel insights to Product, Engineering, and Sales teams

Analytics, Reporting & Data Integrity

1. Set up and maintain accurate tracking via Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, platform native reporting

2. Track all key metrics: impressions, clicks, conversions, CTR, CPC, CAC, ROAS, cost-per-registration

3. Prepare detailed weekly reports for CEO on revenue, ROAS by channel, CAC trends, and actionable insights

4. Ensure data integrity and troubleshoot tracking issues across all platforms

Qualifications:

1. 5+ years managing paid digital advertising campaigns at scale

2. Demonstrated track record of improving measurable business results through paid acquisition (revenue growth, CAC reduction, ROAS improvement)

3. Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max)

4. Experience managing campaigns on at least one additional platform: Microsoft Ads (Bing), TikTok, YouTube, or Meta

5. Proven ability to set up tracking (Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager) and analyze marketing funnel metrics

6. Experience with A/B testing, experimentation, and landing page optimization

7. Strong analytical and quantitative skills; comfortable analyzing data and making evidence-based decisions

8. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

9. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision

10. Highly organized, meticulous with documentation, and disciplined about process

Benefits

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate:

1. Thinks analytically rather than emotionally

2. Takes ownership of outcomes and learns quickly from both successes and failures

3. Is naturally curious and continuously seeks improvement

4. Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences

5. Thrives in a fast-moving environment where testing and optimization never stop

What Success Looks Like

Within your first six months, you will have:

1. Developed a deep understanding of our customer acquisition funnel

2. Identified the highest-impact opportunities to improve paid marketing performance

3. Established a consistent cadence of structured experimentation

4. Improved campaign efficiency across multiple advertising channels

5. Built strong working relationships with Creative, Product, Engineering, and Analytics

6. Reduced acquisition costs while increasing marketing-generated revenue

7. Delivered reporting that helps leadership make better marketing decisions

About Together Light Inc.

Together Light Inc. operates several online businesses serving an international customer base, including Christian Filipina, Filipino Visa, and related travel services. Every month, thousands of prospective customers discover our brands through paid advertising.

We believe exceptional marketing is built through disciplined experimentation, rapid learning, and continuous optimization—not opinions.

We're looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing Lead who enjoys solving difficult growth problems, improving advertising performance, and using data to make better decisions.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who loves testing ideas, optimizing campaigns, and continuously improving results.

raw.excerpt: The Agency Fund is a nonprofit innovation lab working to expand human agency — the capability for individuals to navigate toward the future that they want.
raw.description:
The Agency Fund is a nonprofit innovation lab working to expand human agency — the capability for individuals to navigate toward the future that they want.
We combine the agility of a startup with the reach of a global network, building projects at the intersection of technology, AI, and social science. Our small, distributed team brings together engineers, designers, researchers, and strategists who care deeply about using technology for human good.
We’ve partnered with 200+ organizations worldwide, reaching millions annually through digital tools, behavioral insights, and scalable interventions. We value curiosity, autonomy, and collaboration — and we operate more like a mission-driven startup than a traditional NGO.

We’re looking for a Business Operations Lead to join our Business Operations Team. In this role, you’ll be the primary owner and integrator of our internal operating systems, ensuring that every function runs seamlessly, measurably, and in alignment with our strategic goals.

You’ll design operational frameworks—such as new structures, processes, and systems—and move them rapidly from concept to fully adopted reality.

If you are energized by the full lifecycle of an operational improvement, from strategic design to implementation and training, this role is for you.

What you'll do:

  • Performance Leadership (90-Day Priority): Lead and execute the rollout of individual scorecards across the organization, influenced by the established organizational OKRs. This is the critical first initiative to establish performance visibility and accountability.

  • OKRs & KPIs: Own, design, and drive the organization’s performance management cycle, including the quarterly and annual process for Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Ensure consistent tracking, reporting, and review across all teams.

  • Strategic Alignment: Partner with the CEO and translate the organizational strategy into actionable, measurable operational goals for all team members.

  • Operational Frameworks: Develop, document, and embed clear, repeatable decision-making principles and operational policies that increase organizational velocity and efficiency.

  • Process Optimization: Identify key operational bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and risks across all departments and design and implement scalable solutions to streamline workflows and maximize efficiency.

  • Technology Management: Manage and optimize the organizational technology stack, ensuring our core business tools are integrated, utilized effectively, and adopted consistently by the team.

Who you are:

  • Experience: Bring 7+ of progressive experience in business operations, strategic planning, project management, or a similar strategic execution role, within a fast-paced tech/start-up environment.

  • Strategic Execution: Proven ability to not just think strategically about an operating model, but to personally build the systems, write the documentation, and do the detailed execution work required for full, organization-wide implementation.

  • Accountability Driver: Expert-level proficiency in developing, implementing, and managing performance metrics (OKRs/KPIs) and driving organizational accountability to those targets.

  • Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex systems and policies and influence adoption across a flat, non-hierarchical team.

  • Mindset: A curious, continuous learner who thrives in ambiguity, is comfortable operating at the CEO-level, and embraces a growth mindset and is eager to "Lever to Scale".

  • Location: This is a fully remote role, but candidates must work in the Asia-Pacific (APAC) time zone (e.g., GMT+7 to GMT+12) to ensure effective collaboration with the core Business Ops team.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience working remotely and across time zones.

Why Join The Agency Fund

  • True Flexibility and Remote-First Culture: We believe in results over rigid schedules. As a globally distributed team, we have built a culture that supports you doing your best work, wherever and whenever that is.

  • Global Collaboration: Join a small, talented, and mission-driven team distributed across the globe.

  • Collaborate with Bold Thinkers: Work alongside experts in software, AI, social psychology, and development economics who are solving complex global problems.

  • Mission-Driven Impact: The Agency Fund is focused on expanding human agency. Your work will directly contribute to projects that improve health outcomes, social impact, and expand the capabilities of millions through AI and data-driven technology.

  • Compensation & Growth: We offer salaries benchmarked to be internationally competitive, paying higher than local market rates in most regions to attract world-class talent, while maintaining the sustainability of our non-profit mission.

  • Global Travel Opportunities: Opportunities for team meetups and project-related travel, contingent on visa acquisition.

Head of Growth & Marketing
Location: Remote (UK/EU time zone preferred)
Type: Full-Time
About Us
We are a fast-growing, entrepreneurial healthcare investment firm headquartered in Dubai, operating globally. We don’t just invest, we build, scale, and commercialise healthcare businesses. Our focus is on identifying high-potential opportunities across healthcare (including care, clinics, and consumer health), then actively driving growth through operational improvement, strategic execution, and commercial acceleration. We work hands-on with our portfolio, from early-stage growth through to scale and exit. and are building a platform designed to become a leading healthcare investment and operating group. We are now hiring a Head of Growth & Marketing to take ownership of how we generate demand, build brands, and drive revenue, both for us and across our portfolio.
The Role
This is not a traditional marketing role. You will be responsible for driving growth, revenue, and brand presence across multiple businesses. This includes:
 Building our brand and deal flow engine
 Driving customer acquisition for portfolio companies
 Using content, social, and digital channels to sell, not just market You will operate with high autonomy, working directly with the founders, and will be expected to move fast, test aggressively, and deliver results.
Key Responsibilities
1. Build & Scale our Brand
 Own and execute our marketing and content strategy
 Position us as a leading voice in healthcare investing and growth
 Build a strong presence on LinkedIn and other relevant platforms
 Create high-quality, high-impact content (insight-led, not generic)
 Support investor communication and deal origination through marketing
2. Drive Revenue Across Portfolio Companies
 Work directly with portfolio businesses to increase sales and customer acquisition
 Design and execute growth strategies across multiple channels
 Use social media (TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, etc.) to sell products and services
 Identify and exploit high-ROI growth channels quickly
 Launch and scale campaigns that deliver measurable commercial outcomes
3. Execute High-Performance Growth Marketing
 Run rapid testing across channels (paid, organic, content, partnerships)
 Build funnels that convert from attention → engagement → revenue
 Analyse performance and continuously optimise for ROI
 Stay ahead of platform trends and apply them commercially
4. Lead & Build Capability
 Work closely with founders and operators across the group
 Manage and coordinate freelancers, agencies, and junior team members
 Build repeatable marketing systems and playbooks
 Help scale the marketing function as the business grows
Ideal Candidate Profile
 Likely comes from: startups, growth roles, or digital-first businesses
 Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building from scratch
 Obsessed with results, not vanity metrics
 Has likely built or scaled something before
 Lives and breathes modern growth channels

Requirements

What We’re Looking For
This role is for someone who gets things done.
Core Traits (Non-Negotiable)
 High agency — you take ownership and don’t wait for direction
 Commercial mindset — you understand that marketing = revenue
 Execution speed — you move fast and ship consistently
 Energy & positivity — you bring momentum to the team
 Accountability — you own outcomes, not just activity
Experience & Skills
 Strong experience across both marketing AND sales
 Proven track record of driving growth and revenue, not just engagement
 Deep understanding of social media as a sales channel (especially TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn)
 Experience working in startups, growth-stage businesses, or high- performance environments
 Ability to operate across multiple brands and projects simultaneously
 Strong communication and collaboration skills
 Experience managing people or external partners
Healthcare experience is a plus but not required.

Benefits

Why Join Us
 Direct impact — your work will drive real revenue and growth
 High ownership — no bureaucracy, no layers, real responsibility
 Portfolio exposure — work across multiple businesses and sectors
 Entrepreneurial environment — fast-moving, ambitious, execution-focused
 Career upside — potential to grow into a senior leadership role
 Equity potential — opportunity to share in the value you help create

A Pagaleve é uma empresa do setor de"Buy Now Pay Later", uma startup fintech inovadora e uma das primeiras empresas a oferecer pagamento parcelado no PIX, sem juros, e sem a necessidade de usar cartão de crédito. Temos como objetivo oferecer a lojistas um novo método de pagamento, para aumentar suas vendas de um jeito simples, descomplicado e ágil, mas também temos como objetivo oferecer às pessoas a oportunidade de comprar aquilo que desejam, sem se comprometerem com os altos juros do cartão de crédito.

Pessoas

  • Conduzir 1:1s regulares, dar feedback contínuo e gerir o ciclo de performance do time.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de carreira de cada engenheiro, usando o plano de carreira como guia para conversas de evolução e promoção.
  • Liderar a contratação e o onboarding de novos engenheiros, elevando a régua técnica do time.
  • Construir um ambiente seguro, inclusivo e de alta performance; mediar conflitos e cuidar do clima do squad.

Entrega

  • Garantir a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega: planejamento de sprint, capacidade e acompanhamento do progresso.
  • Remover bloqueios e gerenciar dependências com outros times e áreas.
  • Traduzir o roadmap de produto (definido com o PM) em execução previsível.

Saúde técnica e operação

  • Garantir o equilíbrio saudável entre a entrega de produto e o investimento em qualidade, confiabilidade e tech debt.
  • Liderar o processo de incidentes e os post-mortems do domínio do squad; assegurar on-call, SLAs e documentação adequados.
  • Manter base técnica suficiente para avaliar decisões de arquitetura com profundidade e apoiar o Staff e os sêniores nessas decisões.

Colaboração

  • Reportar status de entrega e riscos de forma transparente para a liderança e stakeholders.
  • Garantir que processos de engenharia e da empresa (calibração, treinamentos, pesquisas de engajamento) sejam executados no time.

Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência prévia comoTech Leadou liderança formal de time de engenharia (gestão de pessoas, performance e carreira).
  • Background técnico sólido em desenvolvimento de software (idealmente backend), com capacidade de participar de discussões de arquitetura e avaliar trade-offs — equivalente a um sênior.
  • Experiência liderando a entrega de times ágeis com previsibilidade e qualidade.
  • Vivência comcontratação técnicae desenvolvimento de engenheiros.
  • Excelente comunicação, gestão de stakeholders e capacidade de dar e receber feedback de forma direta e empática.
  • Familiaridade com ambientes demicrosserviços / cloud (AWS)e práticas modernas de engenharia (CI/CD, observabilidade, on-call).

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em fintechs, pagamentos, crédito ou cobrança.
  • Vivência com arquiteturasserverless e orientadas a eventos.
  • Familiaridade com a nossa stack (TypeScript/NestJS, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS; Rust é um plus).
  • Experiência conduzindo post-mortems e cultura de confiabilidade (SLOs)

Informações adicionais

Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo de Contratação PJ;
  • Remuneração Competitiva;
  • Pensando no seu bem-estar e de toda sua família, oferecemos plano de saúde com cobertura 100% do titular e 75% para o primeiro dependente;
  • Ifood Benefícios;
  • Day Off no mês de aniversário;
  • Seguro de Vida Coletivo;
  • Cupom de desconto nas nossas lojas parceiras;
  • Modelo remoto de trabalho.
